text: Call of Duty Mobile is not just a game for me, it has become a habit. I have been playing it for the past 3-4 years, and honestly, I haven't faced any major problems so far. I’m not saying the system is right or wrong, but perhaps they could make some changes to simplify the process.

I want to enjoy *Call of Duty*, but the frequent respawn-side changes during matches make modes like TDM and Frontline genuinely frustrating. It disrupts the flow of combat, so players end up coming from all different directions instead of it feeling tactical and consistent. Worst of all, it can feel like we lose not because of skill, but because the enemy respawn side suddenly changed in their favor. The creators really need to adjust this—respawns should be less random or more predictable.

​The rewards are good, but they are scattered across too many different menus. As a returning player, the interface feels overwhelming and cluttered, disrupting the game's core design. It is easy to leave rewards unclaimed due to this fragmentation and redundant navigation buttons. I suggest unifying all reward mechanics into a single, centralized section to prevent confusing navigation and visual clutter, especially for new players. Overall the game is good, but UX needs improvement.

Sometimes there are small glitches, one rn is that I completed one of the sections of a seasonal challenge, but it won't give me my reward or let me finish the rest of the challenge? Idk. Overall, pretty enjoyable, but please fix this bug.

So this game has provided me with extended hours of amazing gameplay. The controls are fairly easy to use, the levels are really well put together. You can even attach an external controller for those that have a hard playing the On-screen controls. Keep in mind, you can't play the tournament with an external controller so you better get good with the on screen controls.

Theme is really good. I liked it. I waited for so long for this game. All competitors are soldiers, it feels like in a battle. Great... But the game file is too big to handle in my phone may be. It's lagging too much. Whenever I enter, it doesn't show EVENTS, sometimes RANKS.... Frequently says, I'm not in a clan...!!! These are peculiar and forcing me to leave my most favorite game...😔

I love the game, the only issue I have is that the match difficulties are always changing(and I know that's normal) but I mean I'll go from one game where everyone is a bot and then jump in to the next game and everyone is pro level. I'm not complaining that I'm being matched with good players I just wish that the skill based matching would stay consistent and not be more bipolar than Arkansas weather. But other than that I love the game, the graphics, the maps, the modes, and the guns.

The game is fine, but why on earth did you remove Zombies? That game mode was so much fun, even if it didn't reach it's targets, there was almost no content! There was one zombies map, could you imagine how popular you could make that mode if you just ported maps from BlOps 1 i.e. Kino, Five, etc. It would be one of the most popular games let alone game modes on mobile, massive missed opportunity. I enjoy the game less now given that lost potential, please bring it back and add to it.

The game is good, don't get me wrong, but I do have some complaints. First off, there is some lag issues, I do experience them a lot. I stopped playing it for a while now. Also don't, and I mean it DON'T, spend your money on the special wheel draws they have, it is beyond too expensive you be better off getting an actual weapon you could actually defend yourself with. Also, this one is not that big of a deal but yet I'm extremely disappointed, they removed zombies from this game. Very sad.

Unfortunately, after the last update there are lots of bugs. The most important is the fact my game crashes, I mean is closing/restarting from 0 every 10 minutes.. Most of the time when I'm in the middle of a fight and.. ofc I die :)) And I don't think it's fair to cannot shoot zombies or people (down on their belly) if I play on simple mode, that's the reason why i play now on advanced, but not fair anyway.

If you want a mobile FPS, this one is the best. Smooth gameplay, skill based rewards, great controls for mobile. Honestly they could charge for this game and it would still be worth it. Only thing I've noticed, and it is INCREPIBLY minor, but if you are the fral death in a match, it can seem like you were killed unfairly, but it's just the slow mo catching up. But overall, this game is totally superior to it's counter parts. Highly recommend it. Almost as good as playing on console tbh.

Absolutely LOVE IT! Many, MANY of the features from all your favorite call of duty games in the palm of your hand! Not to mention that it is FREE! I cannot stress the quality that comes out of this game, because anything I say would be an understatement! It has BR, MP, RMP, and even has extensive customization options! I've never spent a cent on this game and already have multiple operators, weapons, weapon skins, kills treats, operator skills, and lethals/tactical!

Fantastic!! The game runs smoothly on a good device, the gameplay and graphics are great, and definitely dont feel like a cheap mobile game 😁. Overall I would highly recommend this game! To the developers: Is there any way that you could add the map "Jungle" from bo1? Also is there any chance there will be a Story mode added to the game? Overall it's a fantastic game 👍👍

In general... I love the call of duty franchise, even more with the new game coming out with the realism mode, I struggle to connect or some stuff on COD mobile and on my console versions I struggle with matchmaking, at first I thought it could be my wifi... but I already took care of that, so it's not my wifi. And on mobile I can't get to the main menu... it gets stuck on the homescreen where there's a moving picture.

It's amazing but inconsistencies with guns need to be fixed. I can kill an entire squad with a Lv3 AK47 but in the next game, I'd have to shoot multiple times at the enemy and still die. Also, I notice when I buy weapons, they are super powerful for a time! 20/12/20. Firstly as a big supporter of CODM, it's sad that our reviews are not addressed. I am still experiencing the same inconsistencies with BR mode. It's just common decency to have these issues addressed for loyal fans of the game.

Okay, I think this game is overall very smooth and cool, the graphics are amazing and it really does resemble Call of Duty from the consol. There are weapons and objects you can throw at your opponent, the objective is to win and win normaly not pay to win (This is my favorite feature). The only reason why I give it four stars is because the game gets really laggy sometimes, its discharges my phone, and it crashs in battle royal. I would really appreciate it if this game could fix this👍.

Great game. I've enjoyed and deleted this game on multiple occasions. My problem stems from the plethora of updates this game has. It's way too many. I'm currently re-downloading an update of about 2GB because it failed to reflect on the game itself. Giving it 3/5 star, because despite the fact I enjoy it. It's way too intrusive and takes up too much space with all the unnecessary resources it claims you need. Hell, I don't need 166 skins for my M16.

With your recent update it says that it can now support PS4 controllers. I was able to link up to my phone no problem, but in actual gameplay, I am unable to turn and am not able to look up or down. I can move straight forward and back. The other buttons to fire, jump, reload, etc, seem to be working fine though. Has anyone else mentioned this to y'all? Is it a bug that needs work? Game is still awesome, just like to try it with PS4 controller. Anyone else have this issue?

Fun game. Runs smoothly for the most part. You have to buy the best guns so it's basically pointless to play unless you plan on dropping money on season passes and everything they tried to push on you. Be nice if one of these games wasn't so greedy and made it fun to unlock stuff like the old days. Had fun but now I'm uninstalling like everyone else seems to do

It's one of the best mobile games you can get your hands on. You'll want to change the button layout to adjust to your hands and the device size you use. Once doing so, you'll notice the game is very fluid-like with its movement, and the graphics are as good as a console game about 5-6 years ago. For a mobile game... that's a pretty high standard compared to other games on the market. It's just like playing a console's version of COD. (Bluetooth remote capabilities on this game)

Best mobile shooter hands down! But there is a small issue. My ping is quite high. It's at 70ms on average and it gives me a huge disadvantage in ranked matches. It's probably because I'm far away from the server. I'm from sri Lanka by the way. I really don't want to stop playing this game. But the ping issue is really frustrating! Hope the devs do something about this!

Great game but bad bug. The mechanics are really good and I'm enjoying multiplayer. However, like many others I keep getting disconnected when I try battle Royale. Exactly as someone else posted, it took me three reconnects to get through I've game. I'm not about to eat the game fully until this issue resolved. It was honestly the only reason I wanted it. Might uninstall if not fixed promptly. 🤷🏼‍♂️

No headshots + headshot multiplier, one-shot snipers and shoddy hitboxes? I appreciate a Call of Duty entry coming to mobile but it's been far too dumbed down as an actual shooter to genuinely enjoy. Controls are... touch controls so it can't really get much better than that, it has decent graphics for a mobile game which is about the only real unique good thing I can give this to game. It just feels like a fundamentally inferior call of duty experience in every way, especially gameplay-wise.

Frustrating game. I actually thoroughly enjoy the game, but several issues keep it from being great: Voice chat is broken, which may seem like a non-issue to some but I want to enjoy this with friends. Also, zombies sucks, which is awful because its my favorite thing about the black ops series. With what the dev team has done with BR, there is no reason that zombies couldnt be fixed. I shouldnt be struggling to put a zed down with a full mag from an AR at round 4. Make it like the original.

Overall its a great game with awesome graphics and realistic effects. The downside is the app continues to grow larger and larger. If u want more apps on your phone than this game you jave to buy one with at least 64 gb of internal storage because anything lower than that this game is going to consume. Also the cache builds up super fast and when it gets around 65 to 70 mb u have to clear it or you will not be able to control your character.

It's a super good game! But the problem with it is that if you clear the cache or you redownload the game, the loading screen gets stuck and not just that. The battelroyale crashes all the time I try to play. Sometimes it crashes when I play multiplayer but not most of the time just recently. Can you please fix it so that I can play peacefully. I'm pretty sure I'm not the only one having this issue.

It's call of duty, right in your phone! Console/PC gfx right in your phone, controls are intiutive, (uses the easy to pick up difficult to master approach), matches are fast paced (as a phone game should be) wide range of settings to adjust... But more Importantly, it's a hell of a lot of fun! Game gave you more that 3 hours of enjoyment? Want to support them? Buy the battle pass, don't buy any crates (not even with the free cp), it's well worth it.

It's pretty good, could use a few more maps. Do like that you guys have taken older maps and brought them back. What I don't like it's the ranked system considering the way kills don't affect your points for both BR and Multiplayer. Also I don't like that Facebook is the only thing you can connect your account to considering all my stuff is allocated with Google.

I've never really been into first person shooter games, mostly because I wasn't very good at them. I thought I'd give C.O.D. Mobile a try just to check out the game play and graphics. For a mobile gaming app it's phenomenal! There is so much content and they keep adding more to. Bravo to the developers, everyone involved with the concepts, making and production of this game, is in my book a true pioneer! "Go over there and pick up my dog tags!"

Okay, This is dumb. Recently, I got a reward for this game. A pack to be specific. It was the "Dark light pack" (Rewarded from goggle play store gift card) But then I deleted the game for some reason, And my data didn't save? I used the same account so this makes no sense. What's the point in using the same account if the progress won't save. I wanna retrieve my data if possible. I really liked the skins in the pack. Kind of disappointed. But overall, Addicting game.

PROS: Graphics , alot of different skins for both character and weapons that look dope, the UI setup, teaming up is fun and easy, meeting new people is also fun and easy, pretty much everything about the game is great except for one big thing. CONS: The Ranked matchmaking! It's terrible.. it's really sad because it's has so much potential. If you use a controller you will never get a match after pro rank. If you don't use controller you play against ppl who do and get smashed.

The game is, overall, good. For a mobile game , in my opinion, it is very solid. One thing that I would say to anyone planning to play this: DO NOT buy anything other than the battle pass or certain specific bundles. Only pay for stuff when you KNOW exactly what you are paying for. Draws and crates are NOT worth it. Overall, good gameplay.

Its a great game - that I can barely play. The app crashes every other match, which makes ranked matches impossible as I keep getting banned for "leaving the match" when really the app won't run properly. The matches I manage to stay in glitch terribly, with the game controls being horrifically slow to respond and at times I'm unable to leave a room or house because as soon as I exit the door I'm back inside. Please address these issues so that I can enjoy the game again.

This game is so awesome! I've been playing this for almost 2 years now. This gameplay is really fun and there are so many thing to use for customize the weapon. But there is a slight feature where I am not sure if it is a glitch or not, it is about the perk "Cold-blooded" where enemy AI can't target you. What I don't understand is that while I wear this perk I keep getting the shot by the sentry gun. Please explain the feature of this or fix it if you can. Thank a lot for creating this game!!!

This is an AMAZING game! The only thing it needs that would make my gameplay experience alot better would be an analog style camera control for touch-screen players, as well as having it while firing your weapon, and the ability to have the Fast Mag & Extended Mag Attachments equipped at the same time. I mean, you can only have 4 attachments, and 1 of those slots forces you to use an optic, so it wouldn't be Overpowered.

This game is great!! Theres so much to do and lots of guns and skins to look forward to unlocking, and it's just a great free mobile FPS. Some problems are the size of the game. This is literally the largest app in my phone, and everything you unlock has to be downloaded making it evsn bigger. Although the setback, this is a great game and I highlt recommend dowloading (if you have enough space).

Game is great. Sometime lags but not to often, but can be bad sometimes, thought it was my connection but happens a little, not much though, even with good connection. I wouldn't deduct rating for this slight issue. I played this for a while without paying anything and as long as you play you can get good equipment without paying just not exclusive items. The "enable controller" setting doesn't work with the Moga XP5-A Plus controller using a Samsung Galaxy S6 Edge+ with Android 7.0.

I have played the game since launch and it's really good 90% of the time as long as you dont have people jumping around corners instantly locking on you. Even when you do have a "good" game as soon as you see someone the lag just kicks in and destroys the experience. I have spent a good amount of money on the game and I kinda wish i didnt the lag makes the game unplayable. It only started lagging this season. Fix the lag before adding more please!

It's alright for a mobile CoD game. I find it personally addicting, even though you need CoD points (paid currency) to get all the cooler cosmetics (without grinding for days for a single crate that just gives credit which is used for a handful of cosmetics.) Sadly, there's a lot of terrible players out there. I still love all the various gamemodes and weapons nonetheless, and the battlepass and ranking system makes you strive for something greater. Also, love the events!

Been playing since season1 and really enjoy the game. I tend to play daily for few Mos then take a break. I come back and all my characters, medals,and previous gifts are still here. I really miss original zombies. New ones go through regular Br places. I miss the swamp. It was by far the best zombie game before it was improved. Although I do like the purple shards... lots of ways to play. Alone, with group, lots of types of missions depending on what u want. Fun mobile game.

I hook up an Xbox controller and use my Moto mod projector to feel like I paid $60 for this. Obviously it's free. When they added gunsmith, it took out a lot of what I liked about this as opposed to a console version. For some reason, my account was lost and I can't log back in, so there went hours and hours worth of progress and all the rewards I had racked up from playing for months were just gone. And there was no account recovery option.

While it is a very entertaining game, it's a bit unfair in terms of equipment. I agree with some saying its pay2win but at the same time it also has that grindable aspect that all of us desire. It's not too competitive but its cod so idk what you would expect. I definitely wouldn't reccomend to new players as the grind is increasingly hard and is very laggy on older devices. Still a very fun and enjoyable game and pleasant experience once you get the hang of it.

I can't believe call of duty is finally in Mobile device format. Wow... How far technology has come in just a few short years. This is freaking insanely awesome and I love the game!! You just can't freaking beat Call of Duty for a FPS, in my opinion. Not only is the gameplay awesome, but the graphics are amazing, and it's just like the game console version, which means gaming has gone to a whole new level! Thanks guys!!

This game was great and I loved playing it before the update. I was so excited for the zombies mode and now I'm deeply disappointed and even mad. It's nothing like I thought I'd be. There's only one map which frankly I don't really like. The zombies are too hard and there are too many that come too fast. You can barely make it to round 10. And you can't lose. You die and you keep respawning. Even if you can lose, you'll quit out of rage before then. It's also boring and the rounds go on forever.

Overall extremely impressed, I have a grenerally low tier device and the game runs extremely smooth. The game play was extremely fun and exciting. Few small bugs here and there but its mostly nothing to bad. My biggest issue with the game is alot of the times upon opening the game it freezes up on the screen with "ghost" and the others with fire embers blazing and wont load the game at all. Other than that exceptional work and an incredible game! Love every moment of it!

Extremely disappointed. I've been waiting to get a new device since the day this game was released. Just so I could play it. I got a new device, and I'm so let down by the gameplay, graphics, lack of players in the game (I'm level 11, and it's matching me up with people in level 30s &40s). The graphics are among some of the worst for a FPS, you don't really run across. You just glide. Looks stupid. Everything is blocky and glitchy. Modern ops and gods of boom put this game to shame.

I like the game but there are some things I don't like. Like why are there points and items (crates) that give me stuff I can't use or two points systems for redeeming items and many modes of play that I don't use or maps that never get called up buy take a huge amount of space on my device. Should consider streamlining or downsizing the space requirements. Overall the gameplay is good but I think it's like 1 or 2 generations behind other systems and games. Sorry, I hop that helps!

It was FUN. I would say it is one of the best FPS for mobile and I had a blast playing it. There are just 2 problems with the game. 1.you need a Facebook account to save your progress but you can still play as a guest it just won't save your progress. 2 the new update that came out with zombies ( I assume ) is HUGE. I deleted every thing on my phone and it still was not enough space to get the new update. And I would suggest you have a good phone to play.

I LOVE the call of duty franchise, I've been playing ever since WaW, and now that I have a mobile call of duty that's really immersive? It's way better. The controls are very comfortable, the matchmaking is great, there are many great weapons, and the new zombie mode. All great aspects of this game that make it outstanding. Treyarc, you have really outdone yourselves.

Can't Play! Downloaded the game, and it is stuck on the updating screen. Have left it for 20 minutes and will not update. Awesome game when you download it, and you automatically jump into an update that won't update. Have unistalles and reinstalled it twice and still no luck!!! Update: the problem was that the server was down. Recommendation: put a notice on the intro screen when the server goes down.

This is by far one of my top favourite games to play on mobile. It's one of the only ones I always come back too. Not much to complain about.. except for how insanely expensive the lucky draws are.. If you want mythic weapons or extra cool skins, you're gonna be spending well over $100.. which is ridiculous when all I want is a character skin. There should be an option to just purchase the items you want, instead of gambling for it and spending a ludacris amount of money..

It was awesome, sadly the game kicks me out any moment (or towards the end of BR and also hangs more now. Tried all tips and tricks available on internet. And I can say it may be the game or the new Android version..but its happening in n many phones in many ways. Well, I would love to play it again one day. Installed for now. Previous review : Huh, addiction... Nice game, just not sure how to get rid of it lol

Just tried to use a PS4 controller. The right joystick did nothing, the buttons on the right side were all flipped around, like when i would hit the "X" button, it would hit the "O" button instead, and the Square button was switching weapons. The L&Rs were also messed up. The left joystick worked fine, and the left arrow buttons worked fine. An easy fix to this would be allowing us to map our own buttons to the controller. Tbe right joystick works fine when used on my playstation.

Great game for ppl who want to grind and get better stuff, the leveling system is a bit slow like you can get a gun that u get at lvl 60 just by buying it with credits(you earn these by playing and completing challenges) but if someone wants to level up real quick it takes a while. One other problem is why can't we just spray with the gun. Just allow us to press fire and not have to worry about pulling the gun up to aim. Other than that, this game is great. Addictive asf tho😭but still good job.

Great game! I have a low end Android smartphone and when I put the game on low graphics I was surprised to see that it ran very well despite how bad my phone is and the graphics were also good for lowest settings and Max settings is really good (seen on my friend's phone). Leveling up and gameplay is good and the game is quite quick. The weapons are pretty well balanced. INSTALL IF YOU WANT TO PLAY A GOOD MOBILE SHOOTER GAME(...).

Pretty good game, nice to see a good mobile game that has been advertised everywhere. However, the sprinting can be really glitchy and become unresponsive sometimes and I don't really understand why the aimbot and auto fire was ported over from other tencent games. It isn't a very CoD mechanic and it unfair to players who don't use it as it allows for cheap kills by players with little skill. Other than that, good game!!

Surprisingly good. A solid mobile adaptation. Has a slow curve to unlocking weapons and create-a-class slots but the gameplay is solid and controls are as good as they could be for a mobile shooter. They packed a lot into the game, including a solid mix of memorable maps, a Battle Royale, and plenty of mobile transaction opportunities (shout-out Activision). The game is a must-try. You'll be hearing M4's in your sleep.

Excellent gameplay! Yes, playing it with a game controller on a big tv is better. But if you want a game to play on your phone I do suggest call of duty. It is very fun and is not hard to play. There is alot of different gameplay on this like on the others. I really enjoy the maps they have on here. The gun control is pretty simple and aiming is not hard. It auto shoots with most guns when you lock onto to someone. Very enjoyable game to help pass time or if you dont have gaming system.

It's fun and all. Zombies player here, I enjoy the multiplayer and zombies, and BR mode. No real complaints except micro transactions are through the roof. Personally id never buy the crates, cause it's a rip off IMO. 1 percent chance for the gun they advertise. Other than that the zombies are a little to Tanky IMO again but this is a mobile game for a quick 5-10 minute match. But overall I like it and recommend it.

It is an overall great game, the only problem is that it is a Large game. Very heavy on storage. And the community can be a little too salty at times..Only actual in game complaint: there are crates that can be bought with CP. Wich can only be bought with real money. There is a lot of things to buy with CP but the item choice to buy with credit (the non premium currency) is very limited. And those items are expensive. Not to mention that we only earn 10 credits per battle.

It's good in the sense it allows the use of controllers. Sometimes the buttons press doesn't register. Takes a while to pick up dropped weapons and to throw tactical and lethal equipment. I DESPISE BS effects in the game. Bullets leaves a trail of insects and if you get near them, they will instantly kill you. Several ray guns, one creates a black hole that sucks you into it and another that can go through walls. Ballistic shield doesn't stop bullets like it should.

Each player wears BRIGHT red lights that signal your character to the opposition. This is the only thing that I dislike about the game. This should be removed, at least from ranked modes. It would be nice to see a HARDCORE mode where there are no red lights on players, no view from the peson who killed you, no respawn. Otherwise nice smooth play. VERY easy to get all of the weapons, why unlock the black versions through leveling up, when you get skinned versions of the same weapons all the time?

They really went all out with this game, it's straight Call of Duty, with everything you'd expect, on mobile. Yeah there are microtransactions but it's not Pay To Win and for the quality of the game and it being free, it doesn't honestly bother me at all. Great (yet small) map selection, good guns, a full blown Battle Royale mode, and a lot of the staple MP modes are already implemented. Overall it's a really solid package, and completely blew my expectations out of the water.

COD mobile is an extremely well developed game and continues to be so. The constant updates to rival that of the PC and Console are brilliant, so that the player doesn't miss out on new content. The only real issue I have is the killcam glitches as to make it look as a player is cheating. Hopefully it will be fixed. Overall a very good game.

I would rate 5 stars if the joystick doesn't deactivate if your finger moves too far away from it.You could let us change the joystick in the settings to make it stay still. Also the shooting has some weird mechanics. When I was shooting at somebody, the bullets didn't hit him even though my scope was on him. If you fix these mechanics, I would rate 5 stars.

I gotta say, I've played many FPS mobile games in the past and I believe this one's it. I run the Galaxy Note 9 with no attached controller or mods. Just my phone and my sweaty hands, might consider into investing in one though, depending how long this game is gonna last. I'm a hardcore CoD fan and I like to go crazy when it comes to racking up kills and spamming streaks and it's surprisingly handling it pretty well with no lag. And of course it's Activision, and you know how much they love emptying our wallets! Its either a pay to win or play to win but I like to stick with the o' play to win method to avoid spending any real money on a mobile app UNLESS the game becomes very promising in the future then maybe they can have my wallet but for the mean time lets not. There is zombies but it has not released yet and I'm looking forward for that! On the other hand there is BR aka BATTLE ROYAL. Yeah, no. Not for me...Anyways! Overall the game is great, if you had history of playing FPS on mobile then this game will be super easy for you to handle, if not, then this game is perfect for you to learn! I highly recommend this game to anyone that is a huge fan of the CoD series. Activision really did a good job in developing this game, can't wait what's in store in the future! Thanks!!

I one hundred percent guarantee that you should download it. I loved the game at first that i actually bought the season six battle pass( which I usually never do.) Now all of a sudden the game has really started to lag,glitch and do all sorted of stuff like that ,causing an advantage for the other players to kill me(battle royal.) Apart from that it 8s a good game.🤗

Works great! Beautiful and smooth graphics. Can't wait for zombies to come out. I do, however, suggest adding far more cosmetic items (that can be achieved without paying unruley amounts), but seeing as the game literally just came out, it's not a huge deal at the moment lol. Other than that, 10/10!

I absolutely love the game but there is a few problems I have with it. One being if I play for so long the game crashes and kicks me out of a match. Secondly I hate that to get the good skins and guns you have to have premium. I think if you play enough and good enough you should be able to earn the same things if you invest your time and hard work you should be able to achieve the same awards that one person that just downloads the game and automatically buys the game pass but never plays.

Very fun game! One of the few modern shooters that rewards good players. Currency system is a bit pricey but if you like buying weapon skins then the season pass is a fine deal. Overall gameplay is fun and battle royale is better than I thought it would be. Multiplayer is amazing but nothing beats zombies. Only thing I would change is the leveling up system. Feels slow, I had to play like 10 matches just to unlock zombies. Otherwise great game, keep up the good work.

I'm pretty sure I have a 90% win rate and 20.0+ KDR. 11/10 would wreck mobile scrubs again. Works perfectly fine, It's CoD. But on your phone! My only "real" complaint would be that it takes way too long to unlock a few simple things, like loadouts for some reason, but otherwise it's, well, CoD, but on your phone! Definitely recommend it for anyone looking for a good time waster that enjoys FPS games of any kind.

Game is worlds better than I'd thought it would be. I'm really just in into the COD titles for the zombies but I'm actually enjoying TDM and royale modes on mobile! Zombies is a lot of fun but very limited compared to the likes of BO4 zombies which I was well into master prestige before I decided to take a break lol. There's lag in zombies and often it's at the exact moment you don't want it to lag. Lately. Could be because sometimes I forget to turn off battery saver. Never lags in PvP though

I don't have much time to spend on gaming, but this mobile game gave me that console feeling and doesn't take much time to load and play a round or two with friends or online. I've set it up in my PC with the emulator and my same linked account and had the "master race" feeling (obviously is not the same) playing with mouse and keyboard, the graphics are good enough to get you immersed in the gameplay and the payed up options are not overwhelming thanks to the user leveling and pairing system.

It is just a portable version of the other Call of Duty games, but its only problem is that it takes up a lot of space, above 750MB or 800MB can become impossible for some people with low memory play it, anyways. The game is no different from others in the franchise, but its gameplay is good, and graphics can be a bit exaggerated even at the lowest resolution, and the controls are fully stable. You will hardly see a bug or a hack in the game. 4 Stars.

This is a great game on a mobile device, I have not found anything that I can play as much! The game modes are great there is so many to choose from it's hard to get bored. If you like pubg you can do that style of play, customize guns, characters, camo patterns, almost endless. It does does a fair amount of play to collect things, or you can buy which can get expensive. I have been playing this for about 6 months now and have tried other things and end up deleting them!!!

Nice game, love it. Kept on switching between different but similar games till I downloaded COD, it's almost perfect. I have a few complaints but my major complaints is the cost of playing it lol, the in app purchases are way too expensive and also the endless circle of updates is really draining and frustrating. Updated with 3GB+ a few weeks back only to come across a new update of 1GB+ some days back. The game is becoming too expensive for some of us, please do something about it🙏🏽🙏🏽

I stand by my original review stating it's an excellent, fun, and well made game with simple game play. But with all the recent updates, and like it's PS5/Xbox counterparts, the games dowload size is entirely too large. Not to mention the constant need to re-download skins, maps, and weapon camos. Enjoyable but still a pain at times

Call of Duty Mobile has its moments, both good and bad. The game is an excellent mobile experience and very fun competitive play. Currently, there aren't any pay walls that are too high to get through with grinding but there are some things on the horizon that look a little worrisome. All in all I play a ton and keep coming back for more.

Best adaption of the call of duty franchise for mobile gameplay wise. Only issue is just how predatory the microtransactions are, u dont necessarily have to buy them. But its only a matter of time before its becomes necessary. But if u lookijg for a nice mobile multiplayer game to play in 5 minute bursts, and blackout is pretty rad, so the positives outweigh the negatives at least for now.

This is the best mobile shooter I have played. It's just like the console and PC version, but it has weapons from across different call of duty games in 1. For example, it has the kar98k from cod ww2 and the MP5 from Modern Warfare. It has insane master craft bundles in the store. The game play is smooth, and the controls are easy to use. But if you don't like the controls, no problem, you can hook up a Playstation controller if you want to. This game deserves 5 stars from me.

Well, I play it on and off and the space it needs just keeps getting bigger, how about deleting some old files like maps that aren't used anymore, it is over all a great game, but it'd be nice if you could give more free items instead of having players spend so much for just little skins? Me being a player who does not have extra cash to throw around cannot afford to just keep spending money for skins. Please? It's a good game though and I have enjoyed it.

As good as it could be on a mobile platform. Graphics and sound are top notch as expected from Activision. I just can't really get comfortable playing an FPS with a touchscreen. The controls are never 100% comfortable. But that's not the games fault, nor the devs,it's just part of the platform, and that's why I give CoD mobile 4 🌟

Overall good game, but with some major bugs, such as weapons not loading in gun game, bullet pentration through walls they shouldn't be able to, and black screening in the middle of a fire fight during battle royal a couple times. Also, the submit button disappears once you start typing the description on the bug report page. How idiotic is that?! Also, camo guns that you buy with real money give small advantage to paying players... Not cool!

Game is still very buggy. Can't reconnect to games, when I'm literally walking around with the match updating behind me. Another problem is that the game isn't very responsive. I sometimes wait 10 seconds just to load into multiplayer or battle royal, when I have very fast internet and a phone which is strong enough. Some guns are a bit too overpowered for their class aswell, like the PDW: Has the range of an AR, fire rate of an SMG and the damage of an LMG. That is just one of a few examples.

Writing as last resort, I've been messaging the in-game help, emailing for a few days but got no response. I had one day left to complete the last few levels of previous battle pass, 24hrs was showing on the in game clock. next time I logged in, some 8 hrs later, it updated to the new battle pass and I didn't get a chance to earn the final skins or COD points. If people paid for the battle pass, you shouldn't take it away prematurely. That's real world money. I'd like a refund / credit pls.

I really like it, although I find the controls a little clunky, I use the simple mode because I think the fire button is a bit hit and miss which gets me killed when using the specialists weapons. Not sure why but pubg mobile has it better with a larger or more forgiving fire button, not sure if you can customise controls but that would be a good thing if you can. Also I managed to find the score streak settings once, they should be in with your load out if you ask me.... other than that, GREAT!

I never really liked playing call of duty that much on console. Kinda cool, but I usually found it to be boring. And I dont mean to sound like an elitist, but I really did prefer battlefield a lot more. However, I will say that this game really comes into its own when put on mobile, and I think that suits call of duty well. Very easy to start up and just as quickly start down a match when you're on the go and need to kill some time. Very addicting and very fun. Approved by a former BF fanboy !!

I'm not usually one for mobile games, but I must say, this is truly a fantastic game to have on my phone. I'm usually against the mobile marketing scheme that most do, but this feels minimal. You get a lot for just playing the game, and mostly the cosmetics are the only thing purchasable. Though some items can give an advantage, all I've seen is an exp boost. I play on poco f1 and it's great on multi-player, but an annoying bug on BR that frezzes the screen but not the actual game.

I've been legendary for 2 season, and I got to say it's been fun, but the rank matching is broken, you can be masters and face a full team of legendaries, not even fair at that point, certain guns are to op, but can only be used if you've payed for it, but other than the the game is great, graphics are perfect for the phone, has a variety of maps and modes, and overall it's a 4/5

Great! I don't play battle mode but multiplayer is fun, I lag (wifi/lte) from time to time, but it's not very often. Overall, I like it, I'm happy it's free. I am tempted to buy some coins though for some cosmetic micro transactions. I'm not a fan of the price of a premium pass though $9.99usd...a month, I don't buy for that reason....$2 - 5.00 would be ok I think. But if this something you play in spare time and just want to pwn, get it!

The game is still great👍, exactly what you would expect from a Call of Duty game. Unfortunately, I've had issues with space recently, and didn't notice how much extra stuff this game downloaded after installment. While it says around 2 GB for installment, it then needs a few hundred MB during setup, and then all the skins and maps take up another GB or so. This could be solved if I get a device with more storage, but not everyone can afford tablets to play 1 game. Maybe make a lite version? 👍✌

Great game, honestly . Been playing for almost a year now. Just received a problem where I can't log in or load into my account. On the load screen before starting up the game it keeps saying 'timeout' before finishing the load, and also says 'update error'. So I can't start the game. My wifi is connected, nothing wrong with the network speed. Is there any way I could have assistance with this please?

It's how a mobile game is supposed to be! The entire game is free to play with based off what I can tell no pay to win aspect, even though there are some special camo weapons you can't get unless you purchase the advanced premium pass. however those weapons stats match with its free to obtain counterpart. As long as this game continues down ths route, it is definitely paving the way and setting an example for how other mobile games should be developed.

I love playing this game with my friends and is a great alternative to playstation and xbox if u don't have one. I love the game types it has from the console version like sticks and stones,free for all,team death match and such . But I find the controls a bit hard and I recomend u buy a bluetooth controller for better controls. It's available on Amazon for about 20-50 $ it would make the game that much better. This recent UPDATE HAS TAKEN OFF ZOMBIES and that has shocked me .bring back zombies

It's too easy. I don't know if other people aren't trying or what, but I'll easily carry the team win by getting over half of the points by myself. Maybe I'm just a try hard. Other than that this game is really awesome if you got all dlc and fast internet. The controls are easy to use if you have a medium sized phone. All dlc exceeds 10 gb so beware. The people on their are nice. They seem chill 8/10 would recommend.

I love this game right? It's awesome, you don't have to pay £60 to play it, But it's starting to become unplayable, it's not anything about the space or anything, my phone that I use is really good but I'm facing prominent lag issues when my setting were high, I've now reduced them but it's still annoying for when I'm in a ranked game, they also need to sort out the matchmaking cos I'm getting sick of enemy teams being godly, while my team's can barely co-ordinate where they are going. 4 stars.

Not a bad game in general, but too many glitches now. The game has a lot of lag and glitches that require a high end device to play properly. On top of that, the game takes an extraordinary amount of storage to the point that I had to uninstall it, even if the storage was lowered from 5gb to even 1 or 2, I would consider playing it again.

So I played on a Samsung Galaxy J7 V for a while, and I noticed that there is an option for ragdoll, but it won't let me toggle it for some reason. What's the deal with that? Also, BR is really laggy, and it takes soo long to kill an enemy. Overall, not bad, but I just can't see myself playing this over COD on console. If you have time to spare and have a phone that isn't outdated, or you don't have access to console or PC, this game is pretty high-tier for a mobile game. 👍

The game is too heavy, my phone is good but, is lagging when I play the game. 3 months ago the game was great, when this new update showed up, my phone ( it has a snapdragon 645, 4G of RAM, and a CPU octa-core max) started lagging. But, the game itself is good, the controls are simple, and it brings the game mode from COD console's version.

I never thought I'd enjoy mobile gaming but this game made me comfortable and competent with it. The developers are continually adding new things so it doesn't get old and it keeps you working to unlock the next things available. My only criticism is with the paid content gambling system (you pay for a crate and can get a variety of new characters, weapons, etc from small to big value.) One crate always gets you the cheapest prizes, forcing you to buy more. Not really randomized at all.

Good, fun game in the familiar style of prior COD versions. Once mastered, the interface is easy and smooth. There are occasional glitches such as trigger lockout, etc. Good content, graphics and game play. Way too many young kids playing. Listening to them squak is irritating. Yes, I know they can be muted but that's not the point. They're too young for a game like this. Anyhow, thanks to COD for a great mobile game.

Love the game, HATE the issues!!!! I constantly get kicked off the game, lose rewards, lag, glitch, cant shoot, get kicked from matches, freeze, have to constantly reconnect to the game.. And there are alot more issues. I would love to buy some of the exclusive gear but not with all these issues. Im very disappointed. Its fun when it works though!

It's an awesome app even if you don't want to spend any actual money to advance in it. For free game it's quite close to the gameplay of the actual call of duty game. It didn't run so well on my older phone which was a cheap model obviously with a was a slower processor and only 64 GB mory compared to the 128 GB I'm now using. I surprise myself often, each time I check my progress and realize I've been playing for 2-4 hours and the phone is within 5 or 10% battery remaining.... 2 thumbs up.

I've been playing this game for a good month and a half. This is hands down my favorite game!! And a FREE game with NO ADVERTISING?!?!?! Heck yes!!! The only videos you watch is if you want to get "coins" so you can purchase guns and other things from the store. Also its very easy to play and you can personalize the reload, jump, and sprinting buttons ect. To make it easier for you. If you grew up playing the call of duty's and loved them then this is the game for you!!

Has a few issues but pretty good for a mobile version of call of duty. Dieing for the zombies part though... still says coming soon. I had to undownload it for awhile my phone memory got too full, in my absence they finally came out with zombie's & then took it out of the game before i even got a chance to play. I was really looking forward to & am very dissapointed, as said above it was one of the only reasons for downloading the game.

Perfect Game. I've been playing it for 6 years now. And I can tell Activision puts a lot of effort into their games. Especially when I comes to the map designs and the weapon skins. Only issue that I have is the skill based matchmaking. One game your playing against bots, drop a ton of kills, Next game you can't win at all because your playing against people on the leaderboards. It's frustrating sometimes. Especially when you play ranked. Other than that. Game is top notch.

Surprisingly competent in the gameplay department for a smartphone fps, but gameplay can't save the fact that the monetization is horrendous. They have a skin store, XP boosters, a battle pass, loot boxes, and even loot boxes in the battle pass. What's worse is that this game has some of the lamest cosmetics I've ever seen. The final reward for the non-premium battlepass is a skin for 1 gun and it looks like a throwaway uncommon skin. Also, there are not very many weapons and most feel the same.

Console games converted to an app normally monotize the hell out of it and lose the fun factor. CoD is not one of these! Free game with no ads with plenty of game play to be had. Yes you can pay but F2P can enjoy this game plenty. Controls take a bit of getting use to as mobile screens are small by design but I think they've done the best they can do with it. Would recommend in a heartbeat.

This new season is so frustrating. It lags too much, especially whenever enemies come closer. Many times, I see invisible enemies killing me. And also it's so fake. I used to use igniter class and a short gun. I can shoot an enemy many times with a short gun BY15 plus igniter class, but he will not even die. But they are knocking me down just by one shoot. I hope you fix that problem for me. I am a long-time player. The past seasons were okay and interesting. It is only this season, not working

I've always been the first in line to play the Call of duty Franchise. From the first game. When I heard the news of this game releasing on mobile. I was very excited. I installed it the day it got released globally. Initially no bugs occured. But after the first day, my game started crashing whenever I'm in battle royale mode. I overlooked, cuz I understand how hard you had to work to come up with such a game. But today, it's just stuck on the loading screen. I'm really hoping you fix it soon...

It's a COD game, on mobile. The play experience is pretty much the same. Weapon balance is fairly solid too, since no one weapon is better than another. Separating the lobbies for controller and non controller players is a very welcome thing. If you're looking to play COD on the go, and don't mind the touch interface, or bluetoothing a controller, then this will hit the spot. My only gripe: Snipers. Why am I hit markering someone point blank with stopping power rounds? Game is 4/5 due to that.

I like Call of Duty Mobile and have found I'm actually alright at it, better than I am on the full console game anyway. Graphics etc are all very good. There are obviously some people playing this with mouse and keyboard or controllers giving them an advantage. What I don't like the micro-transactions, but that is the way everything is going anyway. The game is "free" and there are ways of earning some cosmetic things in game without paying for them. Overall, recommended if you like shooters!.

I used to rate this game five stars but that was before I realized everything there is to a game. It's got amazing qualities graphics if you want to spend the money on crazy looking things you can. But like every game it has problems there might be some lag sometimes but it might also be your device. Overall this game is definitely worth your time.

Great game but not for everyone. Still most definitely the best FPS/BR game in both the App Store and the Play Store but I wish there was more controller support to make it a bit more like console gaming as I have an Android controller but doesn't seem to work and I'm pretty sure that's because the only controller support it has is for dual shock 4 and Xbox (in which I have neither). That being said, the touch controls are still playable once you get use to it 👍

I honestly believe that this game will hit #1 game of the year for our mobile platforms. Excellent graphics, excellent shooter game mechanics, beautiful guns, loads of extra nice perks. The real deal! Just like the Call of Duty game on the PlayStation but transferred over onto our Android powered mobile devices, it infiltrated itself into that little device in the palm of your hands. ..finally.

It's really good. On par with the console and pc versions, it I wish they would add controller support. The developers did say it would be available but quickly removed it a few hours later. Wished they would implement it back, and make it to where only controller users compete with one another. Along with touch users only compete with one another. Similar to how fortnite does it now with its separate input system lobbies.

I love the game but I can't sign out and log in to another account. If I wanted to switch I'd have to delete the whole game which is a long process to wait for everything to download,ect. :( And the AD thing is good but using melee is hard for some reason. I also have a hard time moving which is unnecessary.😐 The game is good otherwise but I'd appreciate if you fix those things. Thank you.

Played this game from the start, loved it at first, even met my husband through the game.. however, I had to spend almost £100 just to get a legendary weapon, the prices are far too high for a game that is now laggy and glitchy, I often have black screen too. My phone had good ram and memory and I always have ping around 15 so it's obviously the game. If only you cared about your customers more than money.

I've been playing COD for a while, and it's a great game. Although I honestly believe they have bots in the game... but my one pet peeve is when an item expires, you don't get anything for those expired items, not just that it's not organized enough so that you can just find these items. Or it could also give a warning on when items will expire. Also, when I'm in a match, sometimes it lags as soon as I'm about to shoot someone and I die. Hopefully these things get better or fixed down the line.

If you are a true die hard COD fan, especially playing with and against other people you will love this! I was skeptical it wasn't going to have the same feel as playing on the console. And of course you can't expect the controls on your phone to work the way your controller would. Yet, it has the same layout for the most part, not much lag, and some new features! Truly COD on the go! Best fps I've played on my phone.

The game itself is just like battlegrounds! I do love the multiplayer experience though. Something different aside from just a BR. It's been extremely laggy, but since it just dropped and there are a TON of people playing that tends to happen. All in all it's still fun though. And I'm looking forward to them fixing the lag and hopefully making it a little easier for those who dont use money to actually have cool stuff ;)

Great game. They make the hit box big so it takes into count of it being a mobile game. They always got an event to have a goal for. They have many chances of getting a cool gun. Sniping is easy to use because they make the controls easy for it. Controls are customizable so it can be easy to get used to. I usually don't like phone games by I'll make an exception for this one. It amazes me that we used to play these games on the old 360 but now we can play this with your friends anywhere now.

The gameplay is quite enjoyable. Multiplayer has a great selection of game modes, which are fun, and can be quite intense. The weapon options and customisations are pretty good too. Zombies was a fun addition, and I hope to see that return. Attack of the Undead was great, and I enjoy the newer special games too. Battle Royale is great with the full map, and the options for weaponry and classes is pretty extensive. Overall, this is my favourite mobile game. Easy 5/5.

well... what can I say? you guys almost nailed it. aside from the occasional lag spikes, inability to give more to the 'free to play' players, and succumbing to the battle pass wave, CoD Mobile is the game of the year. seriously, do more for the people who play for the game the old fashioned way: FREE. give more options for the credits store. make more guns more available. BRING THE ZOMBIES ! ! !

great game, they put the effort in and utilised all the capabilities of a phone for a game. My only problem is Battle Royale. I feel weapons should be waaaaaay more scarce and generally the other players are really bad and there are too few of them, so it's just way too easy. I'd like the games to be longer and more scavenging, instead of everything given to you on a plate. make it a proper survival sandbox

One of the rare good mobile games. Finally something that isn't just a city builder that forces you to buy gems to actually play. The controls are surprisingly usable considering I hate using touch screen for controls too. Great game with several modes available and popups only happen upon login and after matches. You are not forced to buy anything in order to play.

I've got to say this is comparable to pubg and really has the feel of Call of Duty. The controls although comfortable, are very jam packed, you need to know where your fingers are or you might hit a wrong button. With that Sai dive been playing a lot lately and it is truly a really fun battle royal style shooter. The massive amount of internal ads gets annoying and I knocked it a star for that. You have to close 4 to 5 pop up windows everytime you start, plus there are a million things to buy.

Shockingly good for a mobile game, addictive and even if I take breaks (1st downloaded when it 1st came out in 2019) I always end up coming back to it and always new (even if small) updates/game modes/maps. Don't pay for upgrades or guns or anything and it's still fair in my opinion and really fun. I would love to see more maps added more often, but it is a mobile game and the maps they have are good and there's plenty to choose from.

finally a console game comes to mobile! i'm not a fan of "idler" or "clicker titles". i prefer to drop in and play something more engaging for a moment while i have spare time. this is perfect for that! while the engine is obviously different from the console games' IWtech, meaning a learning curve for COD veterans, tencent really killed it on this game!

Like playing the Call of Duty game of old. I would like to make a suggestion. In the Battle Royale gameplay, it would be a refreshing sight if you could add another map besides the ISOLATED map. Another point I would like to share is if you could allow the customization of the character's gender and ethnicity (this minor expansion may require you to hire voice actors). With the expense you will incur now if you undertake this suggestions, the long-term benefits outweigh it all. I assure you.

Took a bit to get going when first released. Some bugs here and there as to be expected. But the team got it together and honestly I have no complaints about this game. Play consistently more than I ever did in PubG mobile and if I'm honest, pubg is not on my phone anymore. 😏 highly recommend this game. Smooth play and always doing some new event. Plus zombies soon! 10/10. No crashes or voice problems.

COD Mobile is the absolute leader in the FPS Shooter category, this game is easy to pick up, even if you can't get the hang of using the screen for controls you can connect a controller from your console (xbox/playstaion) easily and use it just like the console version of COD. There are also attachments you can buy from certain stores that allow you to turn your phone into a controller itself that works really well with this game. This game is a serious must have for every mobile gamer!

5 stars down to 1 star and uninstalled. I've played this game since launch. It is garbage now. The game lags nonstop. Emulator players on PC have a clear advantage. No lag, god like accuracy with mouse. Controller players on mobile like myself deal with major input lag issues not to mention a ton of analog deadzone. It's useless to use a controller. This game runs horribly. And zombies was removed, the only fun decent thing. It's frustrating to play this game on a phone. Would not recommend.

I LOVED playing COD, but the laggg!!! I feel like it works better for people who make purchases through the app. There would be times when I had an accurate aim but the game itself would move the gun so that I wouldn't kill the premium players. Sometimes I would shoot them 10 times and the player wouldn't die, but if I got hit once it was instant death. I eventually stopped playing.

I would give this game 5 stars. It has wonderful graphics and modes. All the weapons are good and also the camos. But I also kind of want zombies back because I never got a chance to play it. So can yall bring that back for me please. Battle royale is kinda cool I just think we need more classes like medic,defender,and the grappling one. I would also like if yall have more events to earn in game rewards. That's it. I highly recommend playing this game to anyone. ❗❗❗

I was a little skeptical at first just because its a mobile game and i wasn't expecting much but this game slams. The only complaint I've got is that i wish there were more zombie maps. I feel like one of the first WAW maps or Kino would be good since they're still pretty simple. Anyways the game is great. Its a full fledged call of duty game. Full of great classic maps. Loadouts, killstreaks, the full 9 yards.

As a previous pubg player, I was keen to download. I enjoy the use of the helicopter and the wingsuits when playing battle royale. It's great that you can use merits whilst moving. I do think the map could be bigger. And I think the supply boxes could also be way better. Its only the arctic .50 exotic that is of any use when playing this game.

Very good. Just a couple of bugs, but won't count those off. One complaint I have is how much storage this game takes up. With downloaded content and the game itself, it takes up 10 gigabytes. That is a lot. People say how this is pay to win, when that's not true. The mythic or legendary guns are literally the same as the base weapons. It's just that since it is a blueprint, it comes with certain attachments. You can view these and put them on the base weapon and stats would be the same. No PTW

Games good. Mainly played it for the battle royal which was fun till they put a tank in it. Kinda defeats the point of gearing up and battling it out to be the last squad standing. Now its about who gets the tank first. If I wanted to battle with tanks I'd find a different game. Graphics for a mobile game is good, controls not to bad to use and other modes good if you like TD. Id prefer BR tho.

This game is great and has a lot of potential. It brings me back to black ops days with firing range, nuke town, and summit. I enjoy the game a lot but it seems like the people who would play the sniper don't have many options for snipers other than the DL Q33 and the Arctic. I also think that you should add some more map variety. I understand that this is just a mobile game at the end of the day but having a larger variety for maps would make the game much better.

I've been playing this game now for a little over 3 yrs (give or take) and it still is exciting to me and is hands down my number 1 favorite game. Love how they are always changing things up and bringing in new rewards. The only downfall to the game would definitely have to be how much phone storage it uses. Once you install it and get in the game then you have to go (well it's not mandatory, but certain things are for certain games & whatnot) and download all the maps, guns, characters, etc..

Game is fun and well developed the modes that are currently out (Multiplayer and Battle Royale) are pretty fun and pretty simple... However, I tried to log on just a little bit ago and couldn't (My reason on not giving 5 stars). The game simply loads and pops up an error saying connect your device to the internet and restart the application... The game keeps doing it over and over again. I don't know if this a game glitch or something to do with my connection but I hope it's fixed soon

I hope most people realise that the game, because it's so large, it really requires a higher-end device to play. I'm afraid yer regular iPhone 6 may barely be able to keep up anymore which is why it may be more frequently laggy than it should be. That's just the nature of it, because we don't have as much of that issue. Ours are way deeper than that 😂 Although the game can be frustrating, you can't argue it's still the best mobile game out there in the market currently.

A terrible excuse for a Call of Duty Game, as a veteran of the series. I can say it's nothing like the Console/PC games. Multiple problems some I can't even mention due to their quantity. Such as the terrible unplayable performance on devices with 2 Gigs of RAM and under. Although this is the the apparent "requirements" for the game. Plus the "Lucky Draws" that the game have to offer are somewhat of a scam.

Its a very good game, but im only giving the 4 star because gameplay feels very slow. When there is a larger game mode added that doesnt end after x amount of days i will purchase a battle pass. 5v5 on mobile is not enough, the games end way too soon, domination for example, ending at 100 points. This takes 5 minutes to do and i like to rack up kills in an intense gameplay experience. Will rate 5 stars once they add something like ground war permanently.

The game is amazing, the graphics looks astonishing, everything about this game looks great. I'm looking forward for more content and more updates. The only thing I think is bad is the skins taking place of the weapons, and that adds a bit of pay to win in the game. But the matchmaking of the game seems to balance the things out. Good game, and I think everyone should at least give it a shot. Keep up with the good work!

Had problems getting passed the load screen. Finally got past that after 3rd reinstall. It's pretty fun. Would like to see my icons for ur profile and more clan icons. Sometimes it lags a bit while playing. But this game is a work in progress. Definitely recommend.only thing now is the lag. It lags me more when I play ranked . Then if I choose not to reconnect after 6 times and quit it takes away my points.

I love this app. Since my PS4 messed up I've had 0 games to play then I found cod mobile. I absolutely love it. I'm not sure why all the people are complaining about the controls tho. If it's that big of an issue connect your PS4 of Xbox 1 controller to your phone boom problem solved. This is the best shooter game out there. Love how you guys incorporated all the old maps from previous games as well! If your iffy about this game just go ahead and download it. You won't regret it.

It's great gameplay, and there are only 2 things I could really complain about: fix the hip fire, and let us be able to get rid of the guns we don't use. If you aren't using the sight, the bullet spread is ridiculous. If someone were farther than three feet from you, it would take forever to kill them using hip fire because half the bullets would go sideways. And in this game when you get a skin for a gun, it's a separate gun, which is why I have 5 of the same gun and it clogs up your inventory.

Gameplay is wonderful, however there is one thing you need to fix before I can rate this 5-stars. Fix the "Fill My Squad" part on BR. I've tried getting put in a match with 2-4 players and 95% of the time I go in alone. At the end of the round, I'm always in a 1 vs 2, or 1 vs 4 scenario. Doesn't make sense to check the box, for it not to fill my squad. Thanks.

It's good, really good. A true Call Of Duty experience jammed into an app on your phone. It's definitely worth the gigabytes, believe it or not I had a file of memes on my phone that was larger than this game. So the space to gameplay ratio is 1:100. My only reason for not giving it fine stars is the lack of a zombies mode, which was the reason I installed it on the first place. 200 years ago in 2019 I saw an advertisemen for zombies mode only to find a lack of it. Disappointed and mad!!!!!!!!!!

Paid for 2 seasons and throughout I experience lag. The game now shuts off my phone. Love this game so I bought a new phone today. My game still freezes and turns off. What's the point of being a loyal member again? I don't see any anymore. SMH. NOT A HAPPY CAMPER!
