I'll be honest. I enjoy call of duty on Xbox. I have always wanted to find a good shooter on mobile. Every other one is laggy, and doesn't give you the feel you want for a shooter because the controls are always hard. Now this is still a mobile shooter, but it's the best one hands down. I love the controls and I love the game play. I have wasted slot of time playing already lol.

Clean game! When I saw a CoD to mobile I was expecting waaay less then what it actually has to offer. The gameplay is very smooth and easy to adapt. The graphs are OK, but there is only low quality available yet, so I think that they will be beautiful soon. There are 2 game modes, with at least one more on the way. Lots of weaphons with skins and add on's. Now tell me; what the hecc can you ask more from a mobile shooter?! NOTHING! Congratulations to the dev's, this is a console/pc worth game!

Ive been a call of duty player for years now, and the one thing that bugs me the most is, i spend my money to buy a skin and yet people cant see it, like,WHATS THE POINT. I think in the matchmaking room, there should be a button to let you download your teammates skins. It's so frustrating. Aside that, its a lovely game and i dont think I'll ever leave.

Best mobile COD out there! This is the first mobile FPS that has given me a near console version in terms of graphics and controls. Gameplay is great and the game is overall just a blast to play while on the go from my phone or tablet... The only issue I have is that I don't do FaceBook so I can't link my account. Allow me to link to my XBOX Live account instead please so I can keep my stats from phone to tablet!!!

It's Call of Duty. On mobile. Edit: The lootboxes are a massive scam. It forces you to pay to roll the box repeatedly, and will give you every single common item before it moves to the items that made you want to try the box to begin with. If there are ten items and one is rare, it will go through every item before the rare one. The lootboxes are rigged.

I loved the first edition even though it's form of zombies was a bit under developed. Once they took zombies out I completely stopped playing. personally I want zombies to be on mobile (not the battle royal style of zombies). What made me start playing again was the marksman rifle man that thing is amazing. What I am trying to say is this is a great free to play fps on the market atm. There are a few other notable ones but nothing like cod. Give it a try and you shouldn't be disappointed.

First of, kudos to activition for COD. The game is good. But player get to experience server glitches, especially in battle royale matches, when there are lots of opponents in a particular map or area. And as such you can't get to kill your opponent. Which allows them to easily kill a player's avatar. It seems that people cheat in the game, by distrupting network or other means. The developer should ensure everybody play on level ground. I hope they get it right in COD warzone on mobile platform

The game is extremely awesome. With the graphics and game play was very smooth. Enjoyable, playing with experience players, communication in the game is amazing. There is no more than I can say. But, I hope I can invite my friends into the training ground to train together. By the way, the game was very great and amazing 👏 thumbs up for that Call Of Duty.

An amazing fps game where you can play with your friends. However I cannot download it for few days, since I remove COD Mobile for some personal reason. I've got an efficient wifi and data, then the storage of my phone is large. Maybe the matter comes from the Play Store App. Yet, this matter isn't fixed I'll let a 2 stars (same if the game deserves 4/5 stars).

The multiplayer and Battle Royale is nice. It's really nice. However, the fact that you took out Zombies is a bit of a bummer. At first, my rating used to be five stars, but now it's four. If you do bring back Zombies, which you say is possible, please allow it to be playable when players are offline. Other than that, great game.

It's pretty fun but lowkey pay to win. There's a bunch of game modes and they all distract me for hours but the problem is the battlepass. You have to buy it for more than most console battle royales and it gives you rewards like skins and camos and that's fine, but it also gives you new guns which can be more powerful than any gun you have. So it's a little unfair that you can buy more powerful guns.

The game is fun aside from the P2W elements on weapons and cosmetics (that's supposed to be purely esthetics). Lots of glitches, can't reconnect to the game as of now. I tried reinstalling the game (by the way, 23 GB of storage is ridiculously alot for a mobile game it urgently needs optimizations) been playing since 2019, but it's getting too much to handle, please fix it...

I think we can all agree that most mobile games are garbage. Even most of the ones that are good tend to get bland and boring after the same type of gameplay those games have. The exception to this is of course Call of Duty Mobile. In my opinion, this might be better than Modern Warfare, Warzone, and Cold War combined. My favorite thing about this game that the console versions struggle with is the match setups. You will always play with people at your same skill as you. Good job CoD. Thank you!

I now give 2 stars since the issue is still not fixed. (updated) The game is amazing, there's a few things that makes me give 3 stars instead of 5 though, there's a huge gap in the game, like when I am shooting a player I find that I am not shooting it at all.. Plus the game is always crashing.. I hope you fix the issues as soon as possible..

Alright game has gotten better over the times I'll admit. The only problems I keep encountering is my teammates and opponents, you could get matched by a team out balancing power and skill than your team because your teammates have no idea what they are doing, please fix this, without it being fixed, it is just being random and I will have to do all the work with my team or even be the one that is lazing around. Other than that it is a great game, perhaps add the RPG and the Glock 19? Thanks.

The game is as good as console! It's got everything you'd expect in call of duty, except for some reason it is missing out on the zombies game mode. That's strange. I'd rate 5 stars if it wasn't missing one of the most played modes in COD history. Edit: Uninstalled because of lack of Zombies. (Considered spending real money on this game)

Would be 5 stars the team death match feels a lot shorter due to the 40 kill cap this means it can be reached by 2 people on your team while the rest do nothing. Mobile data players good addition but it appears that they lag around the map and you can't kill them because they've appeared out of nowhere, the credits feel like they have no use in the game as it takes ages to gain enough just to buy 1 item from the store would be better if you could buy crates with them. still a very good game

The tutorial is ridiculous. For the first minutes after starting the game I had no freedom at all. I was guided through different menus and the second thing I was shown was the store. Why did the devs assume tyey have to hold your hand over the simplest of options is beyond me. Probably a good game but I've never uninstalled anything so fast.

Absolutely, love this game. The guns, the outfits, and the challenges. I did the survey, but wanted to add that, the "draws" are way too expensive. I've already spent more money than I care to admit, but for the draws to jump from 30 to 80, to 140 to 300 then 1300 CP, is a bit extreme. I already spent enough buying CP, it shouldn't break me to get the draws. And maybe be able to have more than just five attachments. But still play it several times a day!

I hate call of duty. But I love phone games. I said let's give it a try. I love this game. Amazing and smooth game play with no input delay. Quick, crisp, and smooth aiming. The mechanics of the game run smooth and true. This game was worth the wait and register. I dont often spend money on games but I want to on this one. Good job developers!

The old version of the game was fun, but the devs made the game way to expensive to play in the latest update.I put all my xp cards into one gun (45 purple, 41 blue, 10 green) and it only got it to lvl 42/50. If i had gotten those with money that would cost $300 usd. For one gun that i didn't even get all the atatchments and perks to!?!?! i have been saving those for over two years.

Definitely worth it, I've spent countless hours in this game and even bought the battlepass. I grind this game everytime I have a little spare time on my hands. I would recommend this game to anyone since it's very fun to play! I love this game so much that I have unlocked legendary rank in it! There's one issue, the controls could have a little more work put into them. Just make it more responsive. So players, like I, can make flick shots in game more easily. Thank you! @callofdutymobile

EXCELLENT GAME! It's been a few years since I edited my last comment and I'm also very busy. Um, I like the characters kinda simple a bit, But over all, It's a game where you can hang out with friends and like I do, I call my friends and over the phone tell them to play call of duty with me, and they are always open to the challenge. But this game is really really, Excellent. Amazing job, Call of duty team.

Peace. 1st off allow me to gush over how great to finaly be playing a cult favorite in android. Couldnt be better... Ahh... Well almost. The only problem i have is when playing any format, whenever enemies get close the game starts glitching and minor freezing... If i weren't soo good i'd really complain but i haven't. This game is too good to put down. Thank you all who were part of the process. Note: I haven't paid a single dime, yet i have some of the dopest weaponry on the game.

Game is absolutely amazing up until you have a great connection of about 40ms ping. Then ranked becomes unplayable. You don't even have time to pull your weapon up even with extremely fast reaction times because of lag comp in game. You die before you can even shoot. Otherwise this game is absolutely amazing. This only happens in ranked games by the way for some reason.

At first I was so sure the performance and graphics would be laggy on most devices that aren't top rated. But tried it on my Moto e5, and it's not laggy on the slightest. There's a low battery mode to save battery and play, which isnt bad. Guns, loadouts, operatives, are all really fun. I'm already at lv.9 and I'm definitely enjoying it. Of course there's still micro transactions for premium pass for all the Pay 2 Win Players, so be wary of that. Overall, it's fun tho.

Honestly, it's an amazing game. I love the Call of Duty franchise, and this respects it well. Everything is made for players to feel like they're playing on console or PC. There's help for everything, there's a complex and detailed statistics system for your guns to understand their behavior etc, there's a load of game modes to play from. A lot of settings for everything are included, so you can customise your game as you want. Definitely recommend it for any true Call of Duty player.

This game is one of the best on the play store, I mean free CoD? How much better could it get? Developers, I love this game, keep up the very fantastic work. Onto the initial review, the controls are great, the optional customization to said controls adds a sense of personal skill to the game. The game modes are great, very team based play. I could go on and on, but overall I say 10/10. I recommend this to everyone I meet and you should to. Although I do wish zombies came back in action.

The game is good but when it comes to the 100 play mood the icons are too big and confusing. Hope you will fix it on the nest update. If you guys can make the icons and the description smaller on the loot box would be much more easier to select what we want from the loot box. Anyway what an awesome game. Always love call of duty games. The best.

It's a really good game, especially since I started playing it after quitting PUBGM. I kinda wish, though, that it wasn't quite so expensive to buy and then fully upgrade any mythics you own in the game. Even so, It's beginner friendly and quite easy to get to grips with the playing style, and the number of possible loadouts are impressive as well as the sheer amount of guns that are available to the player which they can use to beat enemies. I definitely recommend it!

Lovely game. Amazing as it is, I feel like it needs work on this one singular part. The name fonts. See I was making my brother an Activision account, and he wanted it to look cool. So I chose some fonts for him and to my surprise I see that it has invalid characters. So we went for a regular name with just numbers. And turns out, it also had invalid characters! Because of a zero I believe. I seriously think this needs help on I an pretty sure many others might agree with me on this one.

The best game but the worst price deciding. If you will enjoy the game you have to buy the characters and weapons, it is totally ok and we know they will make money but it is too expensive to have more characters and weapons. You can pay more than 1000$ and you have just a few weapons. It is really abusing the customers. Instead making more things and cheaper they make less and more expensive. I hope all players ignore their offers for one month and force them to chang their way.

Great game, really first class when looking at other mobile games. Updating my last review. It has turned into a cash grab. We all know the featured skin or the gun will always be the last 2 rolls.been playing since the beginning, lost first account

However, there’s one major issue that keeps bothering me: the frequent updates. Yeah it's not random. If you want the weapon you will have to spend over 100.00 bucks to get it period. There is zero chance of receiving it prior to the very last draw. The other which I feel is getting worse and activision doesn't do enough to stop it is the hackers and using hacks during game play. Ruins game!!

The only thing I can say. Is if you want something bad, it costs a little bit. Besides that it's good. Oh, and this is for the group that built this game. It's not letting me back in it says that it needs an update, but there's is no update available. And even tho I have a full, I still aren't allowed to enter.

Look, I never thought they'd be able to pull off a COD game on mobile but they did. This game has taken over my spare time and breaks the way modern warfare 2 did at launch. Please, for the love of all things holy, add controller support. And when you add it take the on screen controller off or at least allow them to be hidden in settings. How about the biggest pay-to-win market I've seen. And there use of bots for low level players is something else. Along with the ability to play the game thru a pc, this leaves mobile players with a huge disavantage when it comes to "fair" play if you can call it that. Good graphics for mobile, not the best, but good. Crashes too often though.

Call of duty on mobile...anything more to say? I took this down two stars because a gun i thought i won from a loot box was only available to use for 4 days...i had to dig and dig for an explanation...the game is a great time waster, i have alot of fun with it. The variety of weapons, perks, kill streaks, game mode options, maps, etc is worth it. Just dont spend money on it. Far to many "gotchya" moments within the gambling system they have in place...just horrible for those who do wanna spend..

This was a 5star review to start with. It's steadily dropping due to the game logging me into someone else's account and not letting me log into my own. I don't have a lot of money invested in the game but I have bought a few things. The majority of what I had was earned over nearly a year of playing. I have reported the issue, sent reminders of my report and have checked back regularly. ZERO RESPONSE

I have been playing Call of Duty on console since the first game came out. I have stuck by ever since buying and dominating each game that got released. I have played in clans, game battles, scrims and I am a YouTuber. This game for the mobile is one of the best. I am by far no mobile gamer but the controls are easy, the game play is smooth and so far I have not experienced any issues with how the game runs, connection nor how the game mechanics work. Keep up the good work.

Update working, but you need to fix your ads. Feels like I get thrown up on by the loads of notifications that won't allow me to just jump into the game. To all game makes, I can see the pay tabs they are shiny, and you can't miss them. If you force me to look at them more than I want too, I'm less likely to buy it. I do like the game when I can finally get to play it.

It was a great COD experience, going from pvp game play, and a battle royal mode. BUTTTTT they took away zombies. That is why I gave this review a 3 start review. I would love it if you all gave us a mobile zombie experience. You had one at the beginning of the launch of COD mobile, but was later removed. Please add a zombies mode back or create a new game. Other than the removal of zombies, its a great game.

As a longtime CoD player since CoD 2: Big Red One, I've been playing CoD's multiplayer since CoD 4. Surprising to say, this actually plays really well on mobile devices and has a lot of the series' iconography and gameplay. The player and weapon models are well made. I wish there were more options for some of the attachments from other CoDs and use them on the current guns, but what's here is good. Also if there are more content updates coming, it would be awesome to see weapon kits like in MWR.

Great everything. I only have 2 complaints. My first complaint is the shotgun. It is so bad in this game. It gets outranged and out damaged. The KNIFE is a one hit kill but not the shotgun. Yikes. My second complaint is the difference between tablets and phones. On a tablet, you can see way better. I know this cannot be fixed, but I think that getting a unfair advantage based on what you have is a bit bogus.

It's a great game but it has a few problems. The weapons aren't very customisable since you could have the same type of weapon but different camo. And these are two separate weapons even though they are the same type (say both are AK-47s ) but need separate upgrades. Now that is because they didn't put a camo option for the weapons on the normal multiplayer (they have done it in the battle royale mode). Also, there aren't many weapons in the first place so I think they should add some.

Brilliant game, everything is exceptional, my only issue is the amount of money needed to be spent to get mythic or legendary weapons, in Amerika it might not be bad, but in south African currency it's extremely expensive, as in more than R5000 for basic stuff. which gives other players a big advantage. And 1 other problem is the bots that infest the game, for instance search and destroy the idiot bot picks up the bomb and does nothing with it, or if your entire team are bots, it's chaos.

Pretty fun mobile game. I play Warzone on console, and this is a pretty faithful mobile representation. Battle Royale is fairly easy here, though. Not a complaint, but still, too hard and too easy are kind of the same problem. Multi-player is where it's at here for me, so I play it almost exclusively. Plenty of gimmicks meant to get you to pay, but I ignore them and it's still really enjoyable.

This game is hook, line and sinker ADDICTIVE!! I love it. I literally play non-stop for hours on end. The graphics, maps and characters are awesome. But as with anything you love , there's always a gripe about something. For me, I have 3 gripes. 1) Expand the weapon type inventory. Just when you think you've earned a new weapon, you find out you already own the same weapon, it just has an "add on" to the name and camouflaged in some ridiculous color. 2) Give C bucks some value and buying power. Right now, it's just a waste of "earned reward money. You can't do anything with them but buy a can of spray (really?...) 3) Add more gear to the inventory(uniforms, boots, mask etc..). Everyone player character looks the same and I, frankly, don't care for any more backpacks from the crates. We should be able to customize and personalize our characters. Other than those, I'm a fiend for the game. It's pretty dope!

Amazing game, but pls optimize the game for low to mid range phones to play smoothly without lag or over heating. too much of all this legendary and mythic resources (skins) are stressing my phone's CPU and GPU, if you can reduce render distance and effect particles in BR to reduce lag. having mythics and legendary is useless when you can't even use or play with them. pls ACTIVISION TAKE THIS INTO CONSIDERATION

Well I got things to say! First of all, let me just clear this out, this game is indeed the best game on mobile right now! The game was really fun, etc. But after the major update, I couldn't play any gamemodes for most of the time! I clicked on a certain gamemode and joined the lobby, but I got stuck there! It didn't take me into the game to start playing, instead it just loads for a few moments and says 'unable to connect to the game, please try again." I tried again and still didn't work.

Good graphics, good sportsmanship from the players and you can tell they put a lot of work in the game. My only complaint is they sell overpowered weapons to people and those players dominate every single game they're in. If you sell specific or special items then if they have those acquired they should be in a different group of players. Not just in ranked. It's ridiculous how much of a difference there is between using guns that are in the base game and the ones they sell. Change that.

Fantastic mobile FPS. Love playing. It's free for the most part, except when cool stuff comes out. Items can be really expensive. It would be really awesome if there was a skip all button function when a game ends, so you just go back to your lobby right away. Instead, I have to wait and press at least half a dozen next buttons, if not more until I can get back to the lobby. The COD Mobile team needs to address the inappropriate gamertag's. A censor filter would be good when choosing names.

If you were expecting a halfway-done mobile game with sub-par controls and bad graphics, you arent alone. When I actually gave it a try, i was astonished. The game feels amazing. Combat feels fluid and simple across Battle Royale and classic multiplayer, and guns behave exactly how you think they would. Its not a 1-1 CoD game ported to mobile, but its definitely the best shooter on the play store. Besides, it's free. And that's a great price.

really quality mobile game. I'm sure some will complain, but that's because they're probably not good at it. I'd love to see a way to play with a console controller via bluetooth, and for that to be able to run headset for game chat...but otherwise it's as good as I could ever expect from a mobile version of a full console/pc game. (to the devs if they read this, there's some sort of glitch that makes me uninstall/reinstall about once a week, because it gets to a point where it wont load.)

One of the best games for mobile I've ever played! I played most CoD games and this brings back good memories. I'm sure there will be more in further updates but I would like to have a hardcore option soon as well as other game modes like gun game. A thing that I would like is if for our rank it used military symbols instead of just a star with a number, that's kinda lame. Also you cant buy much with credits so it seems kinda forced to make purchases which I get because it's a free to play game

I see mine revive had been deleted, nice! I will write it again. Game is good but only for few hours. It lacks in everything, only two game modes with few maps which repeat all over and it's getting boring. There is not much content in game. Prizes are hilarious as well as prices in game shop. There are few weapons you can buy and the price of it is soo high compared to what you can earn in game. Prizes for lvl, ranking up or daily are a joke you could as well give nothing at all. Game is boring

All in all, the game is good but it could use a few changes. For example, the announcements in the Clans shouldn't have a limit, and should be posted directly to the top of the clan chat. There should also be a separate part of the clan chat for people who've been promoted. I believe that the option to automatically shoot when aiming at a person makes the game a little too easy, and is unfair to Skilled players. The game could also use some updates to prevent lagging during games.

This game, this game is the only game that's cracked me to spend money on a mobile game because in reality, it's a phenomenal gaming experience. The re-release of zombies let's there be a pve mode, the abundance of bots in casual matches let's you feel good no matter your skill level, and ranked is there if you really want to sweat on a mobile game. If you want short, fun matches of CoD on the go, Warzone mobile isn't going to be that... that's all this game. More to be said, but limited space

The game is very fun, and I've spent a good time on it. But then I just got an annoying problem that I can't link to my Facebook account. When I link to it, it logs in another account instead of my old one that used to log in when connected by facebook. Well, I just got upset and unnistalled the game, despite all the fun it is still very frustrating. I lost some time on that account. The account still exists when I search for it, but there is no way to connect to it.

Monetization is all over the place, and most of it is basically gambling for the items you want. The listed percent chances for any valuable item from a crate are extremely low (0.5-2%) and can only be obtained from those crates. Crates are around $2 USD, odds are you'll spend around $50 before seeing one. Blue and purple rarity items have a small buff that normal and green items do not. Core gameplay is extremely solid and intuitive but the monetization is predatory.

I'm not going to lie, I thought this was going to flop. Most mobile versions of big titles either are okay or not fun at all. But COD Mobile has proven to be a really fun game and the progression system feels really good. Though I feel the massive influx of people really is screaming that COD Online needs to come out soon. The Battle Royale mode is pretty fun and I think I'll find myself playing this when I have nothing else to play. Though there are some moments that feel a bit unfair.

There is a lot of details in this game. Many ways to have fun. The gameplay is not bad. But there is too many update. Servers are not great. AND Tooooooo many baits for spending money! THIS GAME IS ONE OF THE MOST ANNOYING "PAY TO WIN" GAMES TODATE!!! The difference between players who payed for weapon upgrades and players who just progressed with no payment is massive!

I loved this game before. Now it's an absolute nightmare to play.. It takes forever getting into BR...that's if you get a match. I am really disappointed that it turned out like this. I had some great times on CODM but if they dont improve all the glitches , slow loading times and so many other issues then I believe a lot of players will stop playing the game. It's disappointing that it came down to this. Let's see in the future ...Maybe it goes back to being great again!!

Good game, primarily works out well for wealthy people! I've played this for 5, almost 6 years and have spent hundreds and hundreds of dollars with one goal in mind....collect a Mythic(even Legendary) Gun. I'm telling you, I've spent 100$ at one time twice and have never gotten one! And I'm a lvl 250, meanwhile I'm playing against all these mythic guns owned by lvl 109 or 114 or whatever. They will literally enjoy the game to it's fullest simply because they have the money to blow. Deleting

Tons of fun. I'd never played any cod games before being more of a Halo fan, but Halo lost me when they got rid of local Co-Op. This game looks smooth, plays smooth and it's remarkably cheap for the quality imo. Unless you're a sucker for micro transactions. Haha. ^^; They got me there. As of writing this, nothing's pay to win though. It's all cosmetic and completely optional. They have decent reward systems and weapons are fairly easily earnable. For a few bucks I'd say it's worth a try.

First of all, the skill match making in this game is horrible. And the servers are laggy as hell. I can enter a game, and then before it even renders, I'm already dead. And people with higher levels are put into games with others with lower ones. I can't even make it five feet without being spam killed over and over again. This also goes for all the people try harding way too much for a damn phone game, the developers need to level the playing field a bit, or else players won't get better.

It's actually not bad lol. Could use a few more free guns. It is really pushing you to purchase stuff. I know they need to make money but maybe introduce more rewards to the ad viewing caches. Maybe after you watch 30 of them you get a gun? This is a multi-billion dollar company that could get a lot more rich off this P2W app if they give more free stuff to keep people happy.

I love open world type games so I've played heaps of games on my phone and have really enjoyed a few of them. I always loved playing COD on PS4 but I don't play it anymore. This is hands down the best game on a phone ever. It's awesome, constant updates and always keeping it fresh. 1 negative: In game purchases are WAY TO EXPENSIVE! I suspect if you made things cheaper you'd have more people buy it which means although lowering the cost upfront the volume would be higher thus a bigger turn over!

I don't rate apps at all. Especially games. However, this game deserves it. The developers did an AMAZING job at creating a genuine call of duty (multiplayer) experience on your phone. It's so much fun! I play every day. I play this more than my console. Me and my fiance are able to play anytime, anywhere and that's truly fantastic.

This is a great game, but some of the reviews are bad for some reason, like money spending! So many people are upset about how much money is spent on crates and coins ect. but we are lucky to have this smaller version of call of duty!! For free too! Yes there may be bugs and glitched but the operators work on them and test them, it's hard to get a perfect game from such a larger one and for free.!! And you aren't being forced to spend your money, spend it how you want.

Remembering back to when I saw that Call of Duty: Mobile was still only letting people "preorder" the app, all I can think about was my excitement. I've always enjoyed CoD gameplay, and I have to say, they really did a fantastic job with the layout of the game. With new content, and many different game types, this is the FPS that ALL mobile gamers should be playing.

I give the game a 1 star. It's fun, relaxing and worth playing, but the in game purchasers are to expensive for most who have the game, hence the lesser stars. The zombies mode isn't permanent either which is a downside, and there is almost no creativity in the game. As soon as a gun gets buffed it gets nerfed next season which is unfair in my opinion. I have so much to say but so little space so I'll leave my complaints at that.

The game is all good ,fun and competitive but I have a major issue. I recently bought samsung A 37 and started playing the multi-player mode even in low graphics + max fps settings i am getting 60 fps. for the same mode i get 60 fps in very high graphics + very high fps so that means my device can easily support upto 90 fps in low graphics +max fps I like this game a lot and I am playing this from 2019 and I want to experience this wonderful game in 90 fps for a smoother gameplay refreshrate=120

Love this game . Dedicated to playing it . During the season update I did something wrong . It won't let me in my account . 800$ worth of gun skins on there all gone . My mythics all gone . I can't get into my account . It was a guest account , but I had it linked to my Facebook . It just doesn't give me the option to log in on that account . If this didn't happen codm would get maximum stars. Kills my vybe for the whole game.

I've been playing this game since the day it was released. I have a mid-range device that completes all the requirements they recommend. First, It was good at handling the game very well. but as the large updates came by it was not enough. Now the game is laggy and can't handle the game very well. I love this game. ❤ Please consider fixing these problems. 🙏 And south asian players can't play competitive games as their ping is above 100ms. We always get thown into some japanese servers.

I would do a 3.5 star rating, this would be a 5 star but, as your battery gets low, the games stop working correctly, battle royale is just laggy in general, and sometimes you get spawned in matches that are already in progress, and if it's a match with 2v2 or 1v1, you'll die right when you spawn. Other than that, this game is still my favorite, there's a lot of good things that outweigh the bad.

You really need to fix the game, I am over being killed by people, who are across the map going full auto, there's no way they can be accurate and have no recoil over a long distance. Also, how the hell can someone slide through fire with no damage. It seems like people are invincible while sliding and jumping. I am also being killed by people who aren't even aiming at me. Some of the attachments stats need to be reworked. You should also make a night mode with permanent night vision.

This is call of duty. The soul of the game is here, but in your pocket! Downsides, FB sign-in ONLY, IAPs abound here, though they do in the console games too. Zombies isn't out yet, so if Battle Royal isn't your thing, you've got standard 5v5 to fall back on for now. I'm one of the last few that really plays CoD for campaign and not MP, so I'm a bit disappointed they didn't at least slap SOMETHING together, like a greatest hits levels through the ages thing, but I can't ding it for that.

Well I only got this game to play the zombies but then found it has been discontinued, I don't understand why because quite a lot of people enjoyed it and had a lot of potential because now there is no way to play COD: Zombies on mobile anymore because the other game has been removed from the Google Play Store. But the multiplayer is decent at least, would be better if it wasn't as 'pay to win' through all the loot crates would be better if it was like a standard game where you unlock them.

Everyone has heard of Call Of Duty, and this game keeps up the high reputation. The game isn't as good as it's console and PC companions, but they still put a lot of effort into this. Although it does cost lots of money for fancy skins, everything else about the game is great. Paying money doesn't grant you a clear competitive advantage or anything. And the game is mostly balanced. You can either play this game casually or go and sweat in ranked. This game is a must have.

I like the game, alot. It's CoD on mobile. That being said there's a few draw backs, the main one being file space. Over 10g that's almost excessive for a mobile game seeing as I've had others of the same quality sit between 2-5g I get it, a quality game comes with a price. That being said it's 2022 files can be compressed. Even if I could transfer or download to an external SD card would resolve the issue but you can't. The game is fun, but any bigger I will be forced to drop it.

I had an account that I was lvl 150 on with almost every epic skin in the game, so I spent a lot of time and money on it. I had linked it to a fb account that I deleted for various reasons. I forgot to link my Activision account to it. I emailed Activision about this with proof it was mine and it has been 3 months without a response. Overall it is a good game with a lot of bugs but they can be worked around. This total lack of customer service or care; however, is pitiful. I am out of space now.

Fun, fluid game play in COD tradition. However, in game purchases are made through a "lucky wheel" system that is absolutely infuriating. Instead of simply buying the item you want, you are forced into a roulette wheel of sorts, containing many unwanted items. You pay to spin and you get what you get. Not what you want. The price goes up with each spin. I spent $30 trying to buy a gun that never got. So congrats to the devs. You made $30. You also insured that you won't make another dime from me

I've played this nearly every day since I first started playing the game back in 2019, & I have had no issues until the latest season update. I can play the game no problem, but I am missing quite a few of the main sound effects, including the countdown into the matches, so I sometimes miss the start which isn't always a good thing. So if anyone who actually makes the game reads this, any chance you can sort this issue, because as it stands the game for me is more about watching the clock.

This game is call of duty for the phone. Like seriously!!!!!!. How did they put everything on mobile. It's amazing kill streaks, grenades, knifing and running. Nothing is missing from the console. And it's FREE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Wow just amazing. You can purchase the premium if you want unlocks faster but that's all. I think I'll be playing this game so much I deleted all my games.

Okay I just wanted to say this is so hard to control. And I hate okayed this game in console many times. For me aiming is hard moving around is hard shooting is hard. And sometimes when I move the joystick I don't even move. I play this game fro not even 10 minutes and I was already regretting on downloading the app. If you have patience and you're going to sit there and learn the controls go for it it's an amazing game. I just don't have the patience for that.

Really nice game, love the gameplay and graphics. But something really annoying about COD, the fact that other players have to download my skin and 'EMOTE' before they can see it! I don't see any reason to make any more in-game purchases due to this reason, it's really frustrating and takes out the fun of owning skins and emotes. Please do something about this, developers. Other than this, the game is a 5 star for me.

I absolutely love the game, loving the social side, and diversity of the game. I do have an issue with the updates though. 5GB updates every 3 or 4 weeks becomes a bit of a chore. Weapon camos alone was 1.5 GBs! Hopefully the programmers can come up with a way of compressing this in future as it can take over an hour to upgrade which is a bit of a buzz kill. Great game though 😊

Awesome but it lags from time to time..thank you for taking the gamers comments and suggestions into consideration and making a game on mobile phone that everyone can really truly enjoy anywhere at anytime. However there are so many hackers in the game. It would be nice to take them out. Also the tank is a feature I'd like to see removed or maybe adding a chopped with a submachine gun mounted to it could be a cool feature to add so make up for the tank addition.

Gameplay wise, this game is great! A lot of customization for the many weapons in the game, and most weapons are well balanced. Key word, "most". There are a few pay-to-win weapons that add extra damage to your weapon that arent able to be acquired via normal gameplay. You'll mostly only be seeing these weapons in higher level ranked matches, that is if you can get into one. After the rank known as "Elite", the matchmaking becomes iffy, putting you in matches after extensive waits in que.

The only thing that forms a discontent is me is the weight of the game, which are 3GB (almost 4) and more the secondary downloads that it sends you to download in the game such as the camouflage of weapons, maps, characters. That is, literally once you download all the data of the game you get to weigh 10GB and a little more. In my opinion to be a game dedicated to the "mobile" line weighs too much, only people who have a cell phone of the gamer type could play.

Game is good. However, the support is useless. I had mistakenly set a wrong name for my ID therefore I wanted to create a new ID. But there was literally no way to unlink the current game from my Facebook Account. When told support about this the only option they gave me was to continue with the game or purchase a very expensive name change card. It would've been good and I would've made in-app purchases if I knew I could count on the support team. It's a good game btw.

The game as a whole is pretty much what you'd expect from Activision. The ( multiplayer is challenging to an extent ) there isn't any sence of team work. And even though your able to talk freely between your "team" i have yet to hear anyone else talk. Now for the Battle Royal i like the terrain and that you can climb latters unlike the other battle royal games out there and the vehicle options are nice the controlls need work and that goes for the player movement to turning to the left and right

I love this game, but like two months ago it has a bug on my device that makes it impossible to be on a call (like using discord) while playing because the game's sound gets trashy and low. I literally have to end the call and call again, play with the volumen, try different configurations, until it finally starts working. This only happens with this game, tho. And it's impossible to play a fps game without hearing where the bullets and enemies are coming from... I have an Infinix Gt20 pro

This game, while being made by the same company as PUBG Mobile, is horrendously boring when it comes to the Battleroyale mode. The first person traditional CoD mode is pretty awesome, and a perfect port of the consoles. The Battleroyale mode is such a slow paced slog, with janky controls and empty world. There's 100 players, but somehow you never run into them. I can sit in one spot screwing around not paying attention and be perfectly safe. Needs a lot of work honestly.

Awesome game, nothing wrong with it, except that the game takes up too much space & I've done everything to free up space but it just doesn't work. Seriously though, you need a bit over 1 gigabyte of space for just one update? I understand that adding fun things to the game is good, but people who're dealing with a similar problem but wanna play your game, well, if it matters to you to maintain or increase the number of downloads, could we somehow balance the amount of fun & storage plz?

Multiplayer is better than Battle Royal. I'm agree that best gameplay . But there are several issues that has to be fix immediately by developers. 1) Game ping rising up to 199 & keep quitting players from the on going game. 2) THERE IS NO SUBMIT BUTTON IN THE BUG REPORT SCREEN & they ask for a description of the bug . Then i typed one and immediately the "SUBMIT" button didn't show.

It was awesome until it made me update. It goes from 99% updated right back to the "update" button, so I can't even play it anymore. I'm just glad I didn't spend a single penny on the riduculous scam that is the "in-game loot." Other than that, and the fact that every new season means even more downloads, it was a cool time waster. The loot is 100% more expensive than on console as well.

For all of the non-believers, CALL OF DUTY: MOBILE is the TRUTH! This game is an action-packed adrenaline rush of dynamite compressed into your hand. CALL OF DUTY: MOBILE incorporates some of the best features from the wide catalog of CALL OF DUTY games. The graphics, game play, and gun skins are Next Level. It has been 2 years since the game launched and the game play is only getting better. For PC and console players, it will be an adjustment to get used to playing on a mobile device, but Stop whining and just Download It already! I love this game! Thank you Devs!!! If you are on the fence, its time to get in the game! Strap In, Strap Up, And I'll see you on the battle field!!

Very fun game. Easy to pick up, pay to win just doesn't exist here. From what I'm seeing, purchases are cosmetic based. I very much enjoy the game. However, the weapon skin equipping is troublesome. You have to open your weapon, open skins, and click rare/uncommon to find hidden skins you've unlocked. I spent 2 days unlocking a purple skin but there is no purple option. Google is telling me, I get it from a drop crate. Problem is, that gives away my location and I die before I can open it.

This is the first mobile FPS game I have played in a long time and actually enjoyed. Then you ruined it by dropping controller support. If it wasn't meant to be in the game in the first place than it shouldn't of been there at all. Now that players like myself got used to the idea of using a controller, it's gone. You should of just left it there. Uninstalled.

Great mobile port for cod, but the lootcrate rates are displayed as deceptive as possible. I'm very familiar with gacha/lootboxes from other games, but at least other games give the actual odds of winning something. The way the odds are displayed here is they just they you the possibilty of getting a certain grade, but not the rates for individual drops. The unwanted drops, eg credits, are much higher then the featured items of same rarity.

Very impressed. I was honestly expecting a total mess. My only complaint is i cant save to my google account. You HAVE TO LINK TO FACEBOOK. Good way to get all the data and personal info for resale they could want. But thas the call of duty way. Slam you with dozens of offers upon launch, most wont buy so they will focus on facebook data permissions. I wont buy anything on this game because there is no way to save progress except facebook. Loss of funds on your end.

It's a good COD game for mobile. Kind of impressive, tbh. Only complaint would be that you play with/against bots when you're a low rank. It's extremely annoying when you have bot teammates and there's one guy on the other team absolutely dominating them getting all his scorestreaks easily while you're literally the only person on the team that can deal with him.

I was reading the latest reviews as im updating the game. All of them are bs to a point. This game is fun, but can be better. For example, BR is one of my favorite modes. No matter what phone or service I use, there is always a random lag. For matchmaking, its okay,and I'm happy they are bringing in the classic maps like high rise. My biggest problem is the bots. When the game can't find enough people,they fill the holes with bots. It's annoying. I had a whole team of them. Pick it up Activision

The game itself is great, but to take up 18 gb's of someone's mobile device just too much. Although it is glitchy, it is fun and a great game to play but it's hard to sacrifice storage space, most phones just simply don't have it. Although I love it and have played a long ways, I got to delete it simply for the storage, are there things run like s*** because there's no space left .

Used to be a great game. Now it is pay to play. If you spend about $250 US and get the legendary and Epic weapons you have an advantage. A lot of cheaters in this game and the developers do nothing about it. There is a reporting system that does absolutely no good at all. They keep recycling old weapons, camos, and characters instead of creating new ones. The servers are terrible and lag in the game is out of control. Since activision took over the game has gone downhill.

So far really enjoying this game. It's basically Black Ops 2 multiplayer with fan fav maps from different games. The BR mode is almost too similar to PUBG, but I also quite enjoy PUBG Mobile, so maybe that's not a negative. Really looking forward to controller support. Game feels like a solid free to play CoD title. Would be a 5 star, but the heavy handedness of them constantly asking you to buy micro transactions is a bit much. $25 is too much for the battle pass. $10 and I'll buy it plus more.

They have made so many "updates" since the game release that the graphics now are not even close to what it was. Gameplay is laggy and glitchy, players just "disappear". Sorry, but I have tried it various different time and it just seems to be getting worse every time. Now it is just a pay to play game. PUBG is a better battle royale, call of duty is a better single match team play.

This has been my favourite game the whole year. It deserves a praise. It has so much to offer. So many different game modes. Like it was a lot of games merged into one. Everything works smoothly. Each detail of the game is thoughtfully created, from moves of the characters, precise aiming, personalising the weapons... I have never played such a detailed, rich, well made game in my entire life. This game is not play to win. You can spend 0 and still be the best player. THANK YOU ACTIVISION!!!!!

Look, when this was released I enjoyed it. But recently it's hasn't been playing well, ps4 controllers dont work on this game even though it advertised, and it just blacked out in the middle of a multiplayer match. When the game works was fun but whenever there is even a minor problem, it completely ruins the game. Either fix this game or pull it and refund players, but dont expect us to pay for 1/2 finished garbage Activision.

It used to be good, as you had for long time players the skins that they could earn for achievements, or even a store to buy certain items, now all you have is a casino, roll the dice, spin the wheel, this shouldnt be available for kids either. Maybe this review will be now deleted aswell, as mentioning "leave the kids alone" will get you into trouble with the CallOfG.

Call of duty did the one thing it always messes up on. And usually it's not a problem but on mobile it is. The game is amazing but as always, I can play 10 servers while I get used to the game. But once I reach level 5, I'm playing with people three times my level and they have the best guns while I've only just now unlocked the shotgun. It's a great game but STOP PUTTING NEW PLAYERS IN EXPIERIENCED LOBBYS.

Overall pretty solid Mobile adaption of COD. I've been playing for upwards of four years and overall it's been ok with a few bugs, the game will crash now and then but it's not too unbearable. Servers will unexpectedly be down though with the new update, and some games will even take an entire day to boot up and allow me to play. The differences aren't very prevalent between this and console except for the players. Annoying middle aged men and thirsty nine year olds. Let us girls vc in peace!

Usually don't chime in on these too often, but I read a review, and although it may have been only a couple, it said it was pay to win. Honestly, I have bought a couple of the 99 cent deals they have every week or so, and that's it. The only reason like this game is bc it let's you grind to get an advantage, but you do have to a Lil bit. But out of all the shooters I've played, this is hands down the the most equal opportunistic game I've played on Android. 👍

Could not invite friends on Facebook because only suggested friends are showing. Search doesn't work, just typing name on it works. Accounts could not open on both Android and iOS platforms or even just to add friends with their UID or username. Nothing works. Useless. We can't play together. Anyone wanna enlighten me? Gameplay is great. Adding friends is the worst.

No ads, a collection of characters, competition...who could ask for more? It's a great game if you're competitive or like to vs the AI, and u can have a dog. The only thing that drops this to 4 stars is COD points. There is no way you can earn any without real money. So I ask of the developers to put in ways to earn COD points for the skint people like me! Note: I also would say that the game doesn't take too much data away from you if you play with 4G etc. GOOD GAME OVERALL WILL RECCOMEND!

Just like console! I've always loved the call of duty games and when they came out with it on mobile i was sceptical because I didn't think it would do the games justice. I was totally wrong. They did a fantastic job of bringing the console game to mobile and I'm very glad they did! Has the guns, the ranks, and my favorite maps!100% would recommend!

I'm more of a Call of Duty Warzone player with a group of friends please keep that in mind. I really like this game for mobile, but one thing bothers me and it's the loot boxes. At least in warzone I can buy the pack up front not gambling for 10 to 20 dollars a pack. In here loot rng boxes are a no go. For COD I'm here for the game play and I love it. Simple touch screen controls you can edit. I won't use a controller in public though since it will be easier for someone to steal my phone.

I liked CODM in past when it has released, it was a real military war, but now I don't like as I do in the past. It contains a lot of colourful skins, weapons, characters, cars, etc. We don't want these skins for anything, just return the game to its basic -Real military game-. Now, I'm playing with stock weapons without any camo or skin. That's how we need it.

I love Call Of Duty it's fun, an entertaining. You can play with friends add, meet new people, and lots more. You can join clans, and make your own. You can text and call with friends. I love it, but I kinda don't like that they add new seasons all the time and on each one they take up more data, and space :/ But other then that it's a very fun game!

I'm glad to see that cod is disappointing on all platforms now. like when you connect your controller and it says that you have external devices and will be playing with people with external devices or what they don't tell you is that you'll be playing it against them anyways it doesn't matter and you never go up against people that are in the same level as you go into a game in 5 minutes later or some guy with the glowing skin and glowing gun killing everybody and you report them and nothing.

Call of duty mobile is a great game, good graphics, good skins and many more, although there are some bugs, I still consider this game great, I love the fact that you can get cod points for free, overall amazing game!

An amazing game for your mobile, especially if you're like me, don't have the time or money for a games console. There are options to invest money in the game, but with a few of the wide variety matches it's so easy to build up your class. Play it while chilling at home, at your desk on your break or on the go. To say it's for smart phones the graphics are fairly good, though the 5th star would be for better ones

I love this game, even though it can be frustrating at times. The game isn't quite a pay to win game, but it runs on people purchasing cp. The game match making is ok, Although you will always get a few bots in your game. I've spent around $20 on this game, to get skins and weapons, which don't really affect game play. The main problem is the lagging of the game, it lags out all the time, but its never seemed to bother me but I've read alot of these reviews, and many people struggle with the lag

It's Call of Duty on the go. What more could you possibly ask!? For a f2p game, it's fairly balanced and has plenty of content to offer. I highly recommend this game to any FPS fan looking for a great mobile FPS to play. Update (07/23/2020). The game is still great but it's disappointing that Zombies mode was removed. Also, remove the tank from BR. The vehicle is a noobish buzzkill.

Is the "Void" arsenal a RIP off? I spent over $70 drawings" to get the Cordite gun, and out of the 10 items how is it possible that the last 2 items left are the good guns? And I win the inferior weapon. I won everything, except the final gun... but now I gotta spend $40 for another "drawing" to get that last item, the best gun. Great game, but smells like a scam to me. Anyone else having this problem? For a great game obviously made by a great company, seems extraordinarily shady.

Love the game. Gameplay, graphics, it's all amazing. Runs super smooth. I'm really sad Zombies got removed tho. That was really fun. I also find it kind of bumming how all the good stuff is only bought with CP coins, which u can only get by buying with real money. I get you have to make money, even with a free COD game, but it's a bit expensive and you have to buy a lot to get some good stuff. Other than that, great game.

This game is hands down better than the others. After a week of play I can finally give a review. Pros are smooth game play, weapons aren't over powered, groups matches map size, multiple maps and multi player games. Cons.. even though this game is great I hope they come up with a way to keep kids from playing.( the other day almost every lobby we entered was over run with little kids!), maybe seal off some of the upper stories of houses, more open alley(a little too much clutter) GREAT GAME :)

GREAT GAME! I honestly thought this was gonna be a cheesy auto shooter…but this is about as close to console as you can get! I play CoD on PC and haven't played since mobile dropped just because it the convenience of having it with me all of the time and the quality of play. Plenty of Double EXP so no need to spend money unless you want instant unlocks. FANTASTIC GAME!!

Great game, but every time there is a good legendary gun you can buy. Its the LAST THING you get. You will NEVER get lucky and win it. Meaning you'll have to spend over $150 for a gun smh lol. That's crazy, yall need to fix that. It happens every time man. I've tried to get like 3 or 4 different guns. And the gun is the last thing they give me. Which I never get bc that's insane . Done spending money if that's going to keep happening. I know I'll be looking to spend $150 for a gun in a game smh.

Sick game with hands down the best mobile FPS multiplayer mode. I've played many games like this but none really compare. And for all the COD fans out there they brought some of the best maps from the previous console versions (such as "crash" from COD4, nuketown, and others.). The ONE real reason I didnt give 5 * is because the battle royal mode is fun but could still use some minor tweaks. And that's from someone who's player PUBG religiously since it came out so I may be a bit bias. THANKS

Game is awesome!! Only thing that is irritating is when you pay for a chest and you get an item that you already have, you receive a miniscule amount of lower tier in game credits (C) not the (CP) credits. If I spend $10 on something at least me give a top tier item! I also keep trying to unlock a character but for some reason all I keep getting is shards for other things I already own.

It hasn't been long since I downloaded the game,like last month,but I must say I'm enjoying the game. I like how you're able to team up with people and also go solo and do your own stuffs, it's really cool. And there are also a lot of modes in the game as well which makes it fun. But one major thing the game ain't good at is how it consumes storage. Like it literally sucks all your space gradually and if your phone ain't got like more than 20GB storage, I wouldn't recommend you download it.

I signed up for this app before it came out. I've been playing random shooting games but they all looked and played cheap and poorly made. I really enjoy this game. It's pretty fun to relax. I hope they come out with a story mode to keep it entertaining and engaging. The controls are pretty easy, but feel a bit sluggish sometimes. The layout is great. Update: I've been playing this game since it came out. It's October 2020 now. Still enjoying it! A true f2p game.

The game is awesome for what it is. Gunplay feels great and rewarding and it actually feels like cod. My biggest issue are bots. I'm not sure how many of them there actually are in games but it seems like there are only ever 1 or 2 real players on the enemy team, casual or ranked. Also it's nearly impossible for me to find a ranked game. Just times out after 1 minute of searching. Been trying to find a game for almost a half hour last night

This game is the best mobile game you can get in my opinion. But there is a few things that disappoint me. 1. The price you have to pay for the legendary guns. These guns found in the "Lucky Draws" cost &116.93 USD. That is realy expencive. The new holiday redux draw costs $129.25 USD to but the entire darw. 2. Featured game modes should have a longer play time. Some game modes people like me and my friends I play with would love to have around for longer. Plz fix these things.

Overall the graphics are amazing, gameplay is so far so good. Controls are something to get used to but still easy to play. Eould give a full 5 star rating if matchmaking was better, been top of my team every game 15-20 kills with 3-5 deaths with the rest of my team going negative and causing me to lose the game. Other than that really good job on the game been enjoying my time playing

I love the game but when you spend money, the odds of getting the good weapon are very slim. They'll make you purchase everything else first. When you purchase the battle pass, you get good things in the beginning and even in the middle. But near the end, you don't get anything. They want you to purchase an additional pass. That's not fair... As the other review stated, matchmaking isn't exactly fair. It should really include skill level as well. Aside from that, it's fun and addicting!

Honestly if this doesn't get game of the year award, i don't know what will. This is the best thing that's ever happened for a long time for mobile gamers and those lacking a console or pc decent enough to play those games. But now, connect it to a tv or controller support, that would be like playing actual COD on a console knowing the quality isn't that amazing but its pretty good so far in a Oneplus 6T.

Despite being a mobile game, they managed to get the complete cod experience on your cell phone. I'm amazed how much detail they put into the game and how well it plays, same addicting gameplay and a ton of content to play with, lootboxes can be a little pushy but are not that bad compared to other games that actually limit your gameplay. Played on my Samsung Galaxy s8

You could have added a control support, I've waited several months to download the game and even bought a controller for it, but there's no gamepad support. I understand that it's a free AAA mobile game, but you also could've added more items to buy via in game money. It is an excellent game though, one of the best movies fps out there, I'm eager to rate 5 stars when you add gamepad support!

Edit: new updates have become very disappointing. From glitches and loading issues to 347 seconds waiting time for a match on good, Fibre Optic internet. I play on my Huawei Y9 Prime and have never had problems with other games. Been discouraged with the amount of "questionably legitimate players" and the match making has become a free for all. This is my favorite game and I'm hoping these issues can be sorted out so that it stays this way. And yes, I spend money on it.

I have played many shooter games. most of them are low quality and encourage you to spend more more more. I play this with my Ldr boyfriend. he has not spent and still is level 350+. Me.... I have spent a lot. what I like about this. is even though you spend $200-$300 for mythic characters or weapons, it still really relies on skill. you don't HAVE to spend to be successful, it's more about style and cosmetic. Graphics aren't as good as on console or PC, controls aren't perfect but are reasonable, which is more than you can say for most ports. Voice chat is rarely used, and normally by people in another language, but you get the same thing on console. You get online MP, battle royale and zombies, with no P2W elements, all for free, and it's still being added to.

Game ran surprisingly well on older devices. What all mobile games should aspire to be like. Top tier gameplay that is easy to grasp yet hard to master, options for insanely good graphics or potato ones, clean and efficient social systems and ui, added features like timelocked comic strips, offline play, and wacky game modes, and most importantly, no pay to win or pay to play mechanics. Wow! Honestly one of the best if not the best mobile game out there. I would rate this game 10 stars if I could, extremely well done all the way around.
