While certainly playable from a non paid standpoint this game really pushes you to spend money with upgrading weapons and opening loot boxes. The game still remains playable with all the nonsense but may be a bit annoying to navigate every login. Playing from the 1st Asus ROG phone I notice no real problems with perf. But could see lowerend phones having issues but the game has lower graphic options. GG

Yes it is pay to win better guns equal better perks. Add controller support back people still find ways to play even of you remove the option. Battle pass is a joke buying single tier costs $1.50, 120 cod points it costs $1 for 80 points and I'm not sure if you can max it out without having to play BR. When zombies is added will that count towards battle pass and the only way to level up pass is through the missions playtime counts for nothing. Great gameplay smooth graphics add more MP modes.

Great game, however it is very pay to win in 5V5 matches. In BR and zombies mode this is not a problem, however they are, as you may have noticed, *SIDE* games. They're not part of the main game so most people play 5v5 (which admittedly would be fun if level 30s didnt go against level 170s) and it's not really balanced 90% of the time. Though, the graphics are great and its damn easy to level up. You can also get weapons and skinsbasically free of charge if you play the game enough- nice concept

Call of Duty mobile is a great fps game. I love how smooth the game play is and the graphics. Each season brings new gun camos and new skins. It's competitive and challenging but still fun. The only problem I have is when you start the game. Usually, when you start the game, it shows the Activision logo, but not for me. And when I'm at the sign in meun, it's has no animation even when I go to the rank meun. The would be a small cut scene of the rewards when you rank up.

Its ok but there are a few issues, mainly ive both killed and been killed even when the crosshairs werent even on target. The hitboxes arent accurate and it takes away from the game. Also theres slight lag issues between when someone starts shooting at someone and when the damage registers. I got called a hacker for killing someone, because even though i shot at them for 2 or 3 seconds on their screen it just showed them dying, not me shooting at them.

At first I thought this game was actually bad at running smooth but not until I got a good device, it's so cool man. Graphics and frame rate are on point. The best thing about the game is the friends we make in random lobbies,it makes it so entertaining and I sometimes feel like I'm in an actuall war when I'm playing with friends in Battle Royale. Call of Duty Mobile over all Mobile games. Can't wait for warzone mobile. Gonna be lit!

Call of Duty Mobile: is the best and most popular realistic game, for some of the most iconic CoD maps. This, it further combines, with gameplay mechanics that focus on the realism of elements such as closeness to bullets and gun recoil, along with new age technologies such as augmented reality crosshair scope, and the added control of drone strikes at your disposal. What I basically mean is, there is a lot for you to explore, win and own in what is a seemingly straightforward shooter.

I am totally fed up now😠.. I gave this 2 stars, not 1 because i have always loved COD and the gameplay is beautiful.. But now, I am fed up of the same thing that happens over and over and over and...again!!! Everytime in mid-game it has SERVER issues. At first i thought my wifi was the problem, but after testing it numerous times, I have realized that the package itself is the issue. Since this issue got worst, my kills dropped drastically😭..And now I am giving up on this game..FIX THIS PLZ!!

It's worth the download and play time. I would have given it five stars, but there are some control issues that need work. Sometimes I have to hit the knife button 2 or 3 times to get a reaction out of the game. The button to fire while you ADS sometimes doesn't work immediately after you stop turning your screen to fire at an enemy. I have the S10 and got it brand new about 3 months ago, so I know it's not my phone being outdated. When will we be able to use controllers again?

Really fun game. I love that I can Bluetooth connect my PlayStation controller, makes it way easier to navigate a match. However, I have to tap and touch the screen for everything else in the game. Still, I have been addicted to playing every chance I get. Great graphics, great seasons, great weapons, great UI. Just download it, you'll see.

The game is good, just that thereare a lot of glitches. To start with, when you are in a team and match ends and you goto lobby, voice of every teammate is disabled automatically. Me and my friends have tried a lot of stuff but in the lobby voice chat remains disabled. Furthermore many times when you search for your friends name, it just says no player found even when the IGN is written totally perfect. And plus, there be an easy shortcut that takes you report game errors

I truly love this game, the only reason why it's not a 5 star call of duty game is because of the zombies. On Shino they're so easy in survival. It gets so boring for me. Can you add more maps or possibly add more quests inside of the zombies game? I appreciate the game and time if you read this @development. Keep up the good work.

Good graphics for a mobile game, includes many things the regular cod's have, and has the ability to customize your controls. The only problem with gameplay is the usual campers and glitches are continuosly being used however, they are usually fixed quickly. The controller support recently added back is in need of more customizable controls. If you choose simple controls you can aim but it takes to long for you to begin shooting while using the second mode doesn't allow you to aim in at all.

I genuinely love the game but I am also genuinely frustrated at the fact that you make me watch things for 5 seconds or even the whole time before i can leave. Surprisingly i do no want to watch the final kill every time, especially if it is me, and I also don want to watch the first 5 seconds of the top 3 and my death every single time. It would be nice to just let me leave those screens immediately so I dont have to watch things forever. The game is incredibly entertaining if you look beyond.

game features a diverse range of maps, modes, and weapons from the iconic Call of Duty franchise, allowing players to engage in thrilling combat across various game types. One of the game's strengths lies in its intuitive touch controls, which, while not as precise as a controller, are well-optimized for mobile gameplay. The graphics are impressive, showcasing detailed environments and character models that rival some console titles. However, the game's free-to-play model introduces challenges.

The game play is a 5 and so is everything else but my problem was accounts. It just kicked me out of my account. That may have been my fault but I remembered... guest token. I typed It in multiple times and even copied and pasted. Nothing worked. Typed in emails, passwords, and the same token over and over. So all my work is gone because of it

Great graphics and attention to details. However, I can't understand the reason this game is over 20 gigabits of space. I had to give up a lot of apps that I enjoyed playing just so I can update. The operators and gun skins take over a lot of space. Really unnecessary, I want to play something whenever I am bored not wait for it to load for an hour just to get all maps, operators etc downloaded. It makes me annoyed and extremely sick.

This game is the best game of this year. (10/16/19) now the game is extremely hard to play because its lagging 24/7 no rebirth just battle royal and the same only modes and yes different maps ok thanks for that. But to many hackers and to many op guns. And another problem I have is that I didn't realize that the season was almost over and bought the battle pass if I knew the season was going to end I would buy the next one and now I can't get my money back or anything. FIX IT!

This game is my favorite game, it has everything I could ever ask for and more. But it has too many skins, wepon camos and maps for multi-player that just take up space. Like, a quarter of all of those would set someone for life. I had to delete the game because it took up too much space. Just delete all those skins that are just ugly and don't add any more, we have enough.

The game is heavier on microtransactions than most other mobile games, with adds constantly popping up, it's not even just cosmetics it's p2w, then there's the connection issues constantly disconnecting you from games even though your isp is fine the problem is servers there's not enough of them, there's only a couple and all are half way across the world for me. Apart from all this when you can get into a game the gameplay is amazing, could go on a lot more but limited to 500 characters.

Not as good as it used to be, but it is still one of the only good mobile games out there, also they always try to get you to spend money on everything, I am surprised they haven't made you pay money for each single game you play, also I think there should be a way that you could get the the currency cp or cod points without paying for it it is not fair to all the free to play people I have a lot of really good skins that you get from ranked and trust me you dont want to make a guest account bye

Update: So me being a nerd went to go buy a controller for it. Got a xbox one for it. Well , I noticed a lot of lag when playing. Is there anywhere in the settings I could fix that or an update of some sort for those issues? Major comeback guys. I'm totally impressed with the COD mobile. It brought me back to when COD, was COD. It may lag now and again but nothing is perfect. From the weapons,maps and overall feel of it you guys went above and beyond for the mobile version

It's the worthest on the life, because it has many glichs as firing through the wall and the iron objects and you are starting firing before the enemy and the enemy killed you and I was out of the zone and I was trying to heal my self by taping on the bandage and it doesn't work,and the problem doesn't from the phone, because it makes a sound that it is sound of the healing so, that's coming from the game, and must be all guns are equal in killing. yes, they are different in control and damage

I love this game, first you start playing with players that are the same levels that you are the it gets harder and herder. You can upgrade your weapons and put different attachments on it and stickers. You can buy game characters and weapon camo from the store using the free credits you get for free by just playing the game and level up.

The game is very fun and cool especially when playing when friends. My only complaint is that I cannot turn on the mic to talk with my friends during multiplayer. I checked that my microphone was on in settings but the button to turn it on while in game and in the lobby wasn't there. Maybe it is my phone type, LG K10, because my friends can all see there mic buttons when on their phones. So plz fix this bug so my game experience can be 5 stars.

Awesome game to play! Having a blast with my girlfriend and just won on my first try in battle Royal. Reaching level 7 is also easy, so dont worry about unlocking battle royal mode. Would recommend the developers to include more classic maps.. but for it being free, I can't complain. Hands down definitely my favorite game on mobile.

I have been waiting on this game for so long, and I'm just gonna say it WAS worth the wait. When the game first came out, it was great, 3-4 seasons in, great. However I had to stop playing the game after one of the updates because I had no more room left on my phone. And not only that but all of the lags I experienced while playing the game, I heard are still happening...so yeah...

Still need to work on the final touches, specially in battle royale mode. Looting is not as smooth as pubg mobile. But it has significant potentials. P.S. TenCent keep up the good work, but also avoid making the product worse for the sake of adding something extra. Right now pubg mobile servers are so bad. Two players from the same team driving cars are always desynced. First 10 seconds after landing is just random since it's laggy af. I know this is another product. Just giving you a heads up.

Amazing game, Amazing match making, Amazing balance, no pay to win b.s, no adverts...so many modes. So many levels to choose from. This game gives so so much to the player like guns, equipments, skins, characters. Level selection. we are spoilt... thank you developers you guys are AMAZING!!!!! Keep it up!!!!! I'm lvl103 and loving it. Sometimes I win and sometimes I lose, but 99% of the time I have a fantastic game.

If you want a game that you spawn in to excited to fight and then proceeded to get killed from behind by a enemy that spawned in the exact same place seconds later then this is the game for you! On top of that the hackers are insanely common. Most times it's a ok game to play but when you join into a game just to get killed from behind or by someone using the exact same load out who started firing almost four bullets after you. It loses its touch very fast

Daily Logins are broken. I miss them while logging in every day. Time reset can't be 24hrs. It's on its own made-up time. Been enjoying it quite a lot. Finally had a match where it was a fair fight (level 50+ I'm level 10 but.. yeah). If you find PUBG mobile easy, the first few matches will be a slaughter. One bug I noticed was that the sentry gun will deploy with a message it's been destroyed.

I have been playing call of duty on PS2 all the way to PS4 I really like this game. That's the only game I am looking forward to every year to buy. On call of duty mobile brings me back to the old school days I like that 👍🏽. But I just wish they can bring zombies back cuz it was fun playing it on mobile. And it gets boring playin BR and MP you just need something else to play lol. But it's a great game I've been playing since first season on mobile and still playing it everyday great job team

I play on the Moto g5, everything works almost perfectly. Controls work pretty dang well ( should make the controls more customizable though). Hoping it just gets better. Zombies is here but it's way to hard to even play, I literally had to empty clips into the zombie heads to kill them. Need to tweak that a bit. Guns, perks, ID LOVE TO SEE A TON MORE PERKS, as in like perk 1 2 and 3 greed, overkill, etc. Thank you so much Activision!!! Will be buying the pass soon too.

At first, I couldn't find any faults with this game. The gameplay is very enjoyable, but the updates are too much. I personally have no troubles since I play on pc, but those with mobile devices have a hard time with every new season of codm. Other than the amount of storage space, codm has been a worthwhile experience (despite the 3 star).

Game crashes 2 or 3 times before it finally loads. Reported issues to devs multiple times with different methods and got no responses back. You can buy up to 7 customizations without spending real money but you need to play so much for very little in game money. Games lags a lot and pressing reload will actually reload 50%of the time. Graphics are pretty good for a mobile game. Just clunky and a huge money grab.

Finally, a game that's come to mobile from other platforms, and it's ACTUALLY good!! Honestly, this was worth the wait, imo. Sucks you have to spend money on it, and matchmaking isn't too good right now. But to be far, the game runs good, I don't get any lag, and SO FAR...it hasn't become one sided with the matches. Good job guys, keep it up!

Been playing this game for a while now and have been impressed by it's quality. I won't lie that I thoroughly enjoy playing, I've purchased the battle pass amongst other things multiple times: 1. Most of the time you watch an Intel briefing it doesn't credit you the correct amount if any. 2. Often I will play games where I don't receive any XP or the items I received in the post game screen. 3. Draw rates on paid items are so low $75 won't even get the items you are after in a box, it's a joke!!

Great COD for on the go play. This game feels like a console worthy game that you can play on your mobile device, best mobile game I've experienced when compared to its console counterpart. Gameplay and graphics are smooth. Touch controls can be moved around to fit your style which is a nice feature. Overall a great COD edition! Can't wait for zombies to be released!

I loved it, and honestly still do, but I can't keep taking these crashes and updates that go nowhere. I've deleted and redownload this game so many times, just because of technical issues, and the game not allowing me to login. It takes for freaking ever to download. I've even been logged out of my account twice and had to delete the app because I couldn't logout, and the login was connected to a Facebook account with another COD acct. Fix the bugs and we're good. And lose the bots.

Whatever you do don't participate in the weapons drawings all you will do is spend about 80 to 100$ to receive the weapons you want,it literally is a money pit.i spent about 50$ before realizing that I'm not getting the gun until I purchase the rest if the equipment that I will never use,we should be able to buy these virtual weapons ,at a reasonable price ,without the "drawing" facade.

Not worth the t/s time. Can't connect controller, account won't connect, constant network drops (server side), and costumer support might as well just say "f*** off" instead of "check the faq". Oh and a heads up if you need to reinstall a few dozen times in some vain hope it will work, you can't skip the tutorial, so have fun loosing another 5 mins of life to an unnecessary function. Difference between a work of craftsmanship and a knock off is usually in the small details. I.E. "Skip" feature

Used to be the best game ever. Now they're trying too hard for stuff they shouldn't try for at all. Plus to update the game every season you have to clean up your whole phone just for a fraction of the space needed. And for what?! Bots and glitches. Dont download it'll be a(fun at first) kind of game. Too bad I realized after I game them over 500 dollars.

Almost always playing with nothing but bots. Even in ranked. Once you get to a certain rank you'll rarely be able to queue for a match at all but when you do there's like 1 other real person and a 50% chance they're on your team so there's no real challenge even at higher ranks. It's so rare to get queued with people even in unranked. Is the game just dead? The paid items are a complete rip-off too. It literally took these guys like 2-3 months to give me a $0.99 VIRTUAL crate after I paid for it

Really enjoyable, I see a whole lot of similarities with pubg mobile, probably because they're both tencent games, but that's not a bad thing. I think your stuck with bots until level 5 or so, the battle Royale seems a bit easy but that might be just cause people are only starting to come play the game. I will give five stars when controller support comes out. 👍🏼

The game is amazing in every way, but ever since the new update with zombies and season 2, I'm unable to get in the game. It sends me straight to a white screen then crashes. Not sure if it's my platform of phone I'm using, but the game was working just fine before, and I was able to play without any problems. Please fix this, I'm really anxious to get back in and grind with friends again.

Is a great massive multi-player and i have high hopes for the new update. But my issue is bots. The new update makes the so bad. The bot spawns in your line of sight, which was okay. Until your shooting an enemy team and a bot spawns right next to you, which is also fine i can work over that. But is seems like they dont miss now and do a huge amount of damage. Which is a huge downside and can sometimes ruin a good game.

Offers many different game modes and types, all available to all types of players. While this game does simulate monetisation, the vast majority of it is cosmetics. Everything is unlockable through progress and isn't a huge grind and I find little things like that to be a great importance and will keep me coming for more. The control layout could be a little better, maybe allow more customisation options and something that explains what they do, like hybrid ADS. Still unsure on how it differs.

Literally one of the best games I've played. Seems to be a lot where you assume your going to play 1st person mode but then when you go into it, it's a strategic mode looking down at an area but not this. Get a shotgun & go looking for somebody who's p*ssed you off. Simple. Completely free & a proper old school shootout!

I'm a day one player, and I absolutely loved the CoD franchise, and I got excited when they made a mobile version. It was so nice to see all the new stuff they added, but of course things change. My favorite game mode was the old zombies, BY FAR the best game mode, but then the devs got rid of it, because it was "not perfect." They did add a new version, but that version is litteral bullcrap. The story is too confusing, and it doesn't really pose a challenge. We need the old zombies back!

I really enjoy the game in all honesty. The multiplayer is fun and balanced, and the controls are easy to grasp. My biggest drawback is that anytime I enter Battle Royale at some point the game will crash. Then I have to restart the app and maybe I get to rejoin the game, sometime after that it crashes yet again. The point simply being that for whatever reason the Battle Royale mode causes it to crash and seriously detracts from the enjoyment of the game. Other than that I haven't had any issues

Best mobile fps, P2W is essentially non-existent in this game, and the game itself looks amazing and weapons customization is wicked, from the gunsmith to camos. Only downside is that it takes up a lot of space, but to be fair other games just don't have the kick codm does. The game runs smoothly and have very minimal lag, I can go dozens of games without having any. The game also has a lot of graphics settings, so if you are trying to play on a toaster you could probably get it to work.

Really rating low due to frustrating "bugs". I am finding issues with the voice chat in game, just to name one. Also the lack of free characters to play is a bit frustrating. Just a personal opinion, but I think a generic woman skin would be appreciated rather than having to earn it through paying. Other than that, fun game!

Not too shabby for a mobile version of CoD on the go. Reminds me alot of the barebones version of CoD Black ops on the Wii. The only thing is the intrusive purchase system they have that rubs it in your face about buying things but as long as you have proper parental controls in place and have self control, it'll be a nice little time sinker as pvp gun games offer lots of replayability. The controls take a bit to get used to but there is some controller support. Battery drain isn't bad either.

After playing a while I've seen some issues. While gun balance is still fairly decent, and it isn't blatantly pay to win like it used to be, certain gun skins locked behind pay walls offer far better iron sights than others. Another major issue is the removal of bot pool lobbies. Those really made sure that I could have fun, even if I was having a bad day and wasn't doing well in populated lobbies. Please bring them back.

Call of Duty Mobile has great graphics and gameplay. The controls are smooth and responsive, and the game runs well on most devices. There's a good variety of game modes, including team deathmatch, free-for-all, and zombie mode. The leveling system is fun and addictive, and there are plenty of unlockable weapons, perks, and skins to keep players engaged. The matchmaking system is also well-designed, with player of similar skill level matched together

When I shoot another player I have to empty the whole clip but they only shoot me 4 times then I'm dead. Sometimes it just looks like one shot then I'm dead. It's very irritating when I play multi player. There's also a problem with shooting its like the games lagging. Also when I play ranked matches I would like to choose which missions I take, that search and destroy is something straight from the devil and it seems thats the only thing I get to play. Great game but just those factors

Awesome game indeed, really good. And interesting, and the voice chat is awesome. Playing with people around the world making friends in the real world by talking to them straight in the game. Nice weapons, locations with nice views. Guns you can pick any of your choice, just play and win guns and buy more. But some time it has its own problems but though it's not a big deal am sure the support team updates the game every time we need more updates. Thank you Call of Duty : Mobile

Overall, a great game. I've been playing since it came out, and have to say, probably the best mobile game. Only reason I really stopped playing is that my phone is a POS. Only beef with it is the long loading times and occasional crashes. Though, that might be due to my pos phone. I still look with nostalgia at the first few seasons in 2019(especially the Western season). The game has changed so much since then.

The game is a very attractive game, the graphics are fantastic for a mobile game, and the maps are recognizable. Not to mention the great implementation of the battle royale mode. However, I do really wish there was a campaign mode. But otherwise, the game is great. If it weren't for the fact that it LOGS YOU OUT WITHOUT WARNING FOR NO REASON. I have been trying to get into my account for the past two days, but it keeps trying to create new ones.

Good game to pass the time but there is still a problem with lag & matchmaking. Don't think they care much instead of fixing any glitches they just add more and more to spend money on. Watch out on being a good player you may get banned and I'm sure it'll be hard to get your account back after trying to prove you're not a hacker. The first thing they'll ask is if you had streamer mode ON if not they won't help you. Imagine spending so much money on the game to just get your account deleted.

Probably the best game on mobile, & the best version of CoD multiplayer in a decade. It's a full fledged Call of Duty game, on your phone, for free. Seriously, if you connect a controller it plays just like the best games in the series do on console. Touch controls are top notch too. Microtransactions are everywhere but not pushed too hard and some (like the BP) are well worth the cash. Wish zombies would come back as a full time mode, but otherwise I have zero complaints. Switch release pls.

Great game, it brings me back to the black ops days. The game can get kind of boring in a sense of short games. The kill limit is way too low compared to the original and it doesnt allow any sort of "bounce back" if you start of the game with alot of deaths. Please implement zombies asap!

Great game. I like the maps, weapons, charachters and the camos are sick. Cool characters 😎. I would like cheaper weapon unlocks. That draw for a chance thing sucks. Over 50 bucks and didn't even get the gun. Sometimes alittle leggy. But way better than most games. And nice job on the updates for new characters and guns

Bought the season pass. Bit disappointed theres Lack of milestones to hit to level up a bit faster. - Even apex and fortnite season pass gurantees a Daily level up? I suggest we get more points when you rank up. This will help level up the pass quicker. Other than this. The game is solid. Hope the graphics improve even further. Quick and easy to understand and simple to play. Controls are very good. But at times i feel as if the buttons are not responding (e.g if your hipfiring to ads... Etc.)

The game is exceptional it has great features and a realistic game play & the infrastructure is awesome. The Graphics are on point and I find it exciting with all the different match modes it has. But I find a problem with the control's section it's just too packed up. It makes it hard to handle sometimes but overall the game is good.

I thought it was great! The only few things I would have to say is the multiplayer matches feel like your playing against bots sometimes, and I'm kind of unsure if I am. And also if you are in places with bad internet it rubber bands in matches (that is when the game thinks you are in two different places at once so it teleports you back and forth from the locations) But again I hade a great time with the game. Activision keep doing what you doing. Sincerely: Ben

I wanted to hate this game. I really did. I can't except for a few flaws and that is that the only good maps are firing range, hijacked, and nuketown. The rest suck and the matchmaking is already full of hackers. Also the battle pass is $10 with premium being $25. Suggestions: make killcams saveable/sharable, better anti cheat, and weapon progression is pretty slow. I haven't played battle royale but I played a bit of BO4 and i expect it to be similar. This game has potential though.

Awsome!! Better than on a console in many cases. Simply because you dont have people, HACKING OR AIM BOTTING THIS STYLE, like on the console versions. Plus it makes it easier for less skilled players to rank up and get wins too. Hope you guys look at that on the next round of shooter console games. Great game overall!!! Keep up the good work!!!

Great game, good controls, easy to get into a match from fresh load-up. Sadly gets 4 stars instead of 5 because it doesn't have controller support. Rare to see a FPS game done so well. Nice customization within the game, I was able to make it my own, as far as the button layout during game play. Good graphics, doesn't lag, fun gameplay. Best of all it's free to play. Playing on a Moto Z 2 Force.

The crashing has stopped for now. Other than that, it's still Call of Duty so obviously it's still a mid game. The only problem I have is with the matchmaking. I'm around level 59 and it matches me with players on level 150 which is ridiculous. Oh and I removed an extra star for removing my last review :). Update 2023, matchmaking is even worse as it now constantly matches me with bots on my team.

Good game. Needs alot of fixes though. Hit boxes are bad sometimes and so is the kill cam, it's completely inaccurate.. so inaccurate in fact that it can potentially make you look like a hacker...sometimes. because it'll show something entirely different from what actually happened.. I hate when I heads hot someone with a sniper and it doesn't register and they end up killing me.. also, all those glitches man, ooooof.

Call Of Duty: Mobile gave a different perspective of the Call Of Duty franchise, maybe even First-Person Shooters overall. Surely the game is a bit sticky at first, and controlling can be weird. Then you recognize you get the ability to tailor the game on how you play. Rewards aren't too substantial. Some of obviously cost a lot. Others don't cost at all. It's never a necessity though, as I see many players go without. Not to mention how they combine all of the COD franchise's story arc.

Really good game! Has most of the things from games like COD BO3, and has some pretty good graphics and a pretty large number of weapons to pick from. Only complaint is the button placement. It would be cool if you could change where and the size of buttons depending on your prefences. I always love to slide but the button is too small, and the shoot button feels too low. Otherwise great game!

Game is super fun. Simple and great graphics ! It can be glitchy sometimes though. I'd be awesome if there was a female player to choose..(girl power 💃)Although, it's an awesome app.... BUT...After the update I'm not able to get into the app. It is displaying a white screen .. 😦👎🏻 I thought maybe it was my phone but I'm seeing other people are saying the same about the white screen 😬😬

Best shooting game available for Android at the moment. The Battle Royale mod is yet behind PUBG, but it's still promising. The multiplayer mod is unbeatable. My only complain about it is on a very specific control setting limitation. There is this ADS and fire button that allows you to aim while shooting with the scope on that only works properly if you're used to hitting the fire button that is on the right side of the screen, which is not my case.

This is what I always imagined phone games could be. It's really as close to COD as you're going to get on a phone or tablet. I really hope they come out with a story mode. All around and amazing game. Also I like that it doesn't force-feed you constant purchase options, don't get me wrong their there but it's not every other screen like some games.

This game is SOOO fun! I've started playing this on christmas 2019 with my friends and we have so much fun. Yes we do get pissed sometimes when we get killed by an enemy but that's part of the game. Never thought of COD being on mobile, turned out pretty good. The only thing I hate is that when you get a new skin, it's basically a new gun, you have to upgrade it from lvl 1 again, which is where the microtransactions take place. Overall great game

Best mobile game on the market let alone best FPS. I was skeptical at first but was blown away. The graphics are amazing, gameplay is smooth and controls are fully customizable. Great graphics, great controls with time and practice it feels like your normal xbox ps controller. Great options. So much more to say! Endless fun. Endless. The premium way to play fps on mobile, with very few to nonexistent bugs. Server tick rate could use an improvement but what do you expect from a mobile game (let alone one that's only 3 months old). The tutorial is a babying, non-skippable experience that gets pretty tedious. Modes will be restricted until you're level 5 (zombies) and 10 (battle royale), but leveling up happens fairly quickly at the start. PS4 controllers are also bugged. Otherwise a 5 star experience.

Like a 6.2 out of 10, insanely good game, and fun to play. But you lose the original device or it gets destroyed and you might get locked out.

Without purchasing anything, there is still a tremendous amount of customization available. Additionally, joining an active guild will net you loot boxes, which will unlock new skins and characters free of charge. Definitely recommended for both the casual and hardcore players.

Call of Duty Mobile is one of the greatest mobile games ever created. Only complaints with the game are the controls and the leveling system. Leveling is also somewhat strange, with most weapons needing ridiculously high levels to unlock. Slight lack of content, due to the game just coming out. Not an issue though.

Battle Royale is super fun, it's complex, and unpredictable! I love that there's maps from all games like Firing Range, and Nuketown. Huge disappointment. While the TDM mode is pretty fun, the controls are crummy. Movement with any sort of speed is impossible. Just downloaded this game yesterday. I'm level 11 so far in multiplayer and so far the gameplay is great. So many people playing right now so there's fast loading matches. Five stars from a person who has never rated online mobile FPS games highly. Tip: The stock M4 is a really good gun. It is a perfect mix of accuracy, speed and ammo. Utilise it. Tweak it. The best game I have ever played on my mobile so far. Great controls, stunning graphics, many play modes so it is never boring. This is the definitive Call of Duty game for mobile. So far I'm loving it for the most part. The Multiplayer is a lot of fun, especially private lobbies with friends which brings me back to the times i had LAN parties with my friends a long time ago. My only two issues are: it didn't release with Zombies, which is my favourite mode in every call of duty game, and that the battle royale mode doesn't run nearly as well as the multiplayer mode. I get a steady 60FPS in MP, but barely 30FPS in BR.

Graphically well made. Although the slow motion recaps look pretty silly as choppy as they are, the environments look great, though! The weapon customization is very in-depth, and very satisfying. The cons of this game: you're meant to believe you're always playing against real people, when in reality, it's about 50/50 in an unranked match, other times it's AI enemies.

AMAZING GAME! I've been on COD mobile for every season so far and I'll continue to be part of it till I loose my fingers or die. Great graphics. Great maps. Love all the different modes and customization of weapons. Only issue I've been having as of lately is my phone keep cutting out randomly at any given point. Main menu, loading up a game, and the most frustrating one is in the middle of a battle royal or ranked match. Just wish I could get that figured out and it would get a solid 100%

Agree with the other person that sometimes it's so glitchy or takes so long for the game to buffer upon entering a match that the enemies aren't there or haven't loaded yet that you immediately get killed by someone that isn't there. Other than that, love the game and definitely the best FPS on the playstore

This is a fun and interactive game that has a bunch of potential. You have to fix the Big with the Renetti for the Quick Hands Option. It's not working properly! For a FPS on a phone it handles amazingly. It feels like they wanted to make a COD that plays like Black Ops 2, and they succeeded. The maps they chose were so slightly scaled to bring them to mobile for an incredibly fast paced, arcade style shooter just like we remember Call of Duty to be. The score streaks feel slightly under powered, but the specialist perks make up for that I'm most cases. My only criticism is that the games don't seem to last very long. Up the kill counts!!

For a mobile version of COD, honestly i think the game is great. All around pretty easy game to get accustomed to, and easy to catch on to the way things work. Such as how your phone becomes a gaming controller and what not. Players can edit the screen, to have the button configuration laid out to whatever suits each individual players needs best. I also really like the battle royal feature... Hope this helps anyone thats hesitant to download the game. Cause its worth a fare shot 🤘✌️

I played the game on my friends phone and the game was amazing! Thr hijacked map made me feel just like i was playing BO2 (Call of duty Black Ops 2) all over again! Very fun and smooth gameplay. I love how reminiscent it is of Black Ops 2 with the shared maps and zombie designs as well as the classic multiplayer game modes. The best fps available for smartphone use period. Familiar maps from as far back as 2012, realistic weapon characteristics and impacts. Pretty good for a mobile game. Passable translation of COD into a mobile format. It's solid for what it is.

There are two errors in the game, which I consider to be defects. 1. The battle royale map is bad and does not contain many buildings. 2. Gameplay and visuals are great along with the controls being easy to learn and use. I'm a console player myself but I would still play this game at work or school... Marvelous game, have no game breaking bugs that I have encountered. There is a few bugs that will make the performance of the game a bit worse however nothing major. No crashes. Love the game overall and would love to see where it goes in the future. However I have a suggestion, why not add a Campaign mode? I'm sure it would broaden your player base and lots of people would love to see it. Thanks.

A very awesome game. Smooth and great customizable weapons and characters. The sessions in game vary as in multiplayer, some missions you be going against rookies, sometimes pros, and sometimes people that have the same skill set as you. They team you up by rank rather than skill. It can really get annoying sometimes but it's still a fun game.

This game was amazing when it came out with bo2. I played the game as much as possible with my brother and friends and when I noticed Call of Duty came to mobile, I was one of the first to pre order. Beat FPS shooter on the mobile market, period. But it does have one major flaw...I connected my Facebook account to the game and I saw all my friends that are playing the game on the friends menu. A great mobile call of duty! If only they got rid of the premium packages itc.. but I guess they need to make money one way or the other.. Could use more Throwback maps, plus new & add Hardcore with a little more health on Core, considering it's at an Inbetween amount of Health now. That's why there's Updates!!!

I love this app. Use it all the time !! Ways to make it better are, stop putting us into games that have already started. It's really annoying having to skip everything.

I've installed and uninstalled numerous times since global release and I've not be able to get pass the getting game version info screen....what's going on the entire process keeps repeating itself over and over again, after about 5mins I would receive an error message. Updating my review because I dropped it and picked it up again briefly. The game eventually got stale because it was too easy, which is ultimately why I quit. I thought maybe some tweaks would have been made to make the game harder, but nothing changed there...still boring and easy. The primary feature I liked most was the Gunsmith. Customizing weapons visually and mechanically is a cool idea I wish more games had.

Good but not perfect. I love the Auto fire option but it takes way too long to fire when aiming down the sights. This is especially noticeable when using sniper rifles. I'll place my reticle on an enemy to defend the care package however it will not fire. it would be nice to have something you could do offline. Campaign mode would be great. 10/10 This game reminds me of Black Ops 2, in so many ways! (Not just maps), which is great because Black Ops 2 was my favorite and I can safely say that this is easily one of my new favorites. Not only can you run this on an old phone and it runs great, but the gameplay and options for controls are seemingly endless. Would highly recommend you download, even if you are on a phone from 2014. Thanks for creating an amazing game filled with endless good times.

4 stars because it's a great game, but I feel as though it's focused more for males..we need more female soldiers to choose from. Amazing! Graphics are about mid details settings on a console. You start unranked in close quarters, then you will eventually move to larger mission maps where you jump out of planes to deploy. Just started today and am lvl 6 in the first 3 matches IDk about bugs, that seems to be from people that played the beta, which bugs are expected. I am in US (North America region) so I have access.

Best mobile game experience to date! All in all, it's not perfect but it's pretty damn good. There is the occasional lag, but for the most part it has me hooked. However, when I try buying the battle pass I keep getting an error of some sort with billing support v3 or something of that nature. Is this fixable? It tells me I am not logged into my Google play store account which I am, so it's a bit disappointing that I cannot level up my gaming experience.

Such a big leap up from the other Battle Royale mobile games. Smoother, more intuitive controls, better graphics, more economical battery usage and an almost obscene amount of game modes totally outclasses TenCent's other game in the genre. Credits are hard to come by, though, so spend them wisely and don't play ranked matches with a spotty connection. You will get wrecked by lag.

The game itself Is well designed. There are a couple flaws taking into account that is a new game, but I've noticed during the BR mode there is not a very good indication that I'm being shot by someone. Your health goes down without the screen turning red are you flinching. In Multiplayer it is fine but please fix in BR. Another issue is that you add a little more animation from leaving the vehicle rather than teleporting. And last the grapple hook ability in BR is unpredictable when you aim it.

love it! was a huge MW and MW2 player..so couple maps are super nostalgic. FPS in mobile..have played plenty but this runs pretty smooth. On auto fire..it can be hit or miss at times. As if the enemy isn't picked up. Not a game killer though. Would like to see controller support back though. Controller support would be a 5 star rating from me easy.

Holy sardines Batman! This game gets it right, ads are completely optional, the content is plentiful, decent matchmaking, seasonal rewards, isn't pay to win, new modes added monthly, great gunplay, extensive player & weapon customization, good-great maps, wide variety of maps, over a dozen different game modes, ranked game modes etc... I do have few complaints, sometimes when you try to shoot at your enemy, your gun doesn't fire, there's a premium pass on top of the free pass. 9/10

This game has no need to buy anything. People complaining about that don't obviously understand that the guns are all the same no matter what rarity. The one to two perks are not a game changer. However, the emulators playing with mouse and keyboard are annoying as it is much more difficult to play on touch controls against them. Overall excellent game and Great job on the smooth gameplay! Maybe fix the area of damage too, direct hit no damage and missing sometimes hits?

The game is really fun,especially since you can play with controller,theres a variety of weapons,scorestreaks,and specials. The gamemodes are all really fun and unique,my favorite is rapid fire as that you get points faster,the comics for the season pass is also a cool small feature,while yes,there is currency there are 2 types,CoD points that you get by buying them,and credits,that you can earn in mp matches,the developers did a good job at this game

I personally love this game and have been playing it for years. The game play is nice, maps are good, and guns/skins are amazing. My only problem is the MASSIVE amount of storage that the game takes up. The download for the game is literally just to be able to get in. Then you have to download all the maps, skins, graphics, etc. With the amount of weapons and skins, along with all the maps, AND if you want good graphics, you're looking at around 10GB of storage.

Really entertaining game you can play for hours, but when using a shotgun & you come face to face with another player, the gun goes off, but you die instead of the "one shot, one kill" the shotgun is known for, even when you shoot first, gets frustrating. Also, on auto-shoot mode, you cant shoot trip mines or sentry guns, you can only do it & manual mode, which sucks having to change modes in the settings while in game..

I love Call Of Duty. This game is great in comparison to the video game console version. However, This game is awful with memory, increasing space usage nearly every upgrade, it is completely loaded with bugs and almost ALWAYS lags unless your have some kind of super phone. Lags are very awful and often. I have had COD MOBILE over 2 years and the lagging and glitches and freezing is increasing over time. So the Gameplay deserves 2 to 1 star. Also, luck draw is too expensive. Over $150 per box.

Review edited to 2-star. While it is currently impossible to play with a gamepad paired to with your phone, many are loading the game through an android emulator and playing with a mouse and keyboard. Pretty impressive to make a shooter feel playable on a phone, but this game needs controller support. Apparently controller support was removed shortly before its official release. They better bring it back, I keep hitting the little bit of screen next to the shoot button while at point blank.

Call of Duty Mobile offers an immersive gaming experience with diverse maps, engaging multiplayer modes, and impressive graphics on mobile devices. The controls are intuitive, providing a smooth transition for both casual and hardcore players. Regular updates and a variety of weapons and skins contribute to its lasting appeal. However, occasional connectivity issues and in-app purchases might deter some players. Overall, it's a solid mobile adaptation of the iconic franchise.

Here are some points before you download this installment of COD mobile. Pros - No pay to win. All guns have some way to get them. Whether it is through purchase or challenges which are easy to complete. - Nice graphics. Pretty good in graphics overall. - Variety of game modes, such as battle Royale, tdm, s and d, and more. - There is lots to grind for. Cons - Very hefty on your phone and storage. A 4 GB game in total. - Not too many maps. Though there are new ones coming in, still too little.

The game is great overall. But I do need to address the elephant in the room. The friggin microtransactions. You get very limited customization if you decide to not spend any money, even though the game tempts you alot to spend money with numerous popups every time you launch the game. I am giving 4 stars due to the flawless gameplay mechanics and the fact that the developers chose all the right maps and weapons.

This game Is outstanding it is unsafe for minors but a every realistic game me and my brother love the game the best thing about it is that you can choose whether you want to play with zombies, multiplayer, team deathmatch, or battle royal and many other choices it is a very great game if you like guns, defusing bombs, prop, hunting, and, sniping this is the game.

one of the best games I've played, and one of my favorites right under standoff 2. the reason its 3 stars is because of how the gravity spikes work. they shouldn't have area damage any mor than 1 body length this has become a very annoying problem. I could be running away from it and still get killed after atleast 2 seconds of running... IN A STRAIGHT LINE. I had a assault rifle yeah... but I had lightweight and a stock on so it should be somewhere around smg running speed.

Good game. But needs to fix some bugs in the new update 1- Sound glitch BR - cannot hear the sound of the enemy or own vehicle at some times. 2- BR game gets stuck at some times. At some times the game is not smooth, There was a lag for about 1 second. Please fix that. 3- The sound of the BR drone gets stuck after found an enemy. Sound keeps lagging. Overall the game is good. Only those problems i found with the new update. Kindly requesting to fix those bugs. Thank you!

If you liked Modern Warfare on X-Box 360, then you'll like this version. Controls are surprisingly responsive. Been enjoying the game for a while now, but wish the updates weren't so big. Guess that's what it takes to have this kinda graphics in a mobile game... Using an Xbox one controller, but it doesn't like my wireless headphones with the controller. Using corded headphones usually fixes this problem though.

Reloading timing needs to be sped up in my opinion. It takes to long to refill your magazine after the animation takes place a full on second to a second and a half later only does it refill I try to sprint right after a reload but I never finished reloading cause the animation was over but it never added the bullets. Would be five star but that's the only thing that bothers me. This is with quickdraw mags as well. Yes I do know its early stages but that's not what I'm judging here.

Amazing game. Probably the best shooter mobile has ever seen. I can't believe the plethra of game modes. The rank system is actually very fare in all aspects of stats. The only problem that I have with the game is the fact that in rank mode the internet speed that I have in my house is not sufficiant to keep up with the game play i.e. rubber banding effect, screen freezes, unexplained death, and things of that nature.

It's a great game but there's a couple of issues, I'm not sure if it's maybe cause it just came out or something might be causing the bug. The loading screen takes a long time or doesn't even show it's loading I usually wait a min or two for it to load and recently it has been telling me every time I try to log on that my internet isn't working. I already tried switching between WiFi and data but none of them worked, I do hope however that you guys fix these issues soon so I can play better.

The gameplay and nestalgia that comes with the maps really surprised me, the controls are good and the maps look great. My biggest complaint is getting bombarded with micro transactions as soon as the game opens. Iget it's a f2p game but with the differences in the battle pass and paid battle pass systems it definitly feels like you are at a clear disadvantage if you dont pay for the gold i wouldnt mind as much if it were more balanced.

The game is really good, but I can't seem to have fun sometimes. Consider the following. 1. There are lots of pay to win items, not players, items in the game. I can't go one game without having a ptw item in a match 2. I don't have good graphics and can't enable to have greater graphics. I know graphics don't seem to be important but they don't help in game play. When I play a BR match, the low graphics don't allow me to see enemies at far away distances, which makes snipers obsolete.

honestly, very fun and easy to play, you can set your control's size, where you want it to be and it can fit your hand type and comfortable-ness. it's very good for beginners, because with this game i actually learned how to aim, simple to play, has voice chat, you can but dont have to friend people, different weapons and doesn't lag (though that is more due to your device). graphics are very good actually, and all the best to this game.

Great game spend a lot of hours grinding out to get the achievements. Graphics are great guns a realistic for some one who is a gun enthusiast. Only thing I don't like is that you have to spend to much money just to get all items in one giveaway. I spent over $200 just to get one item I really wanted. But overall love this game. Wish it did not take up so much memory.

Since 2019, the game has been flawless and addictive. The gameplay is excellent and unparalleled by any other battle royale mobile game out now, and the graphics are incredible. However, battle pass doesn't always provide the best deals to those players who could potentially use this game to highlight a point, and then these deals often come out as ridiculous. Top players continue to use default skins because new skins, for instance, resemble clowns rather than being soldier-oriented.

its a fun game. you would think touch controls on a mobile shooter would be terrible. but the controller tutorial is like 6 minutes long and in 4 minutes you get insanely used to it. i recommend advanced controls because there is more control over how you fire your gun. for example in basic controlls. it fires for you if your aiming at people. if you have advanced controls you choose when to fire so you can actually pick who to shoot when there is a group. overall controls well. i recommend this

Bring the Long barrel back on my M4LMG. I have an ancient Galaxy Note with no space. The only problem i have ever had with the game is occasional lagging if I am in the middle of no where and get down to 2 bars or less signal .Usually i have zero issues. I Hate that the ranking system is reliant on constantly playing, because as much as I love the game, i dont have the option of playing more then once or twice a week, and when season starts over i cant play ranked with friends.

I love this game. But there are a few issues I would like to address. The main one is that since the most recent update,my game is crashing alot ,more specifically on BR.I start to run or shoot and all of a sudden it stays stuck and won't do anything. I have to log off and on again and by that time I've been killed and that is really not enjoyable.

Im a controller user and all i have to say is there is SO much work that is needed. The input controls are iffy, dont respond half the time, or it seems like the controller has a mind of its own doing 360s and 180s when you just want to look around the corner. When it does work its fun and awesome as we are moving to a stage of streaming games but sorry activision, microsoft has you beat.

Overall very good experience. The maps are great, the gunplay feels great, and overall it feels like a mashup of the best Call of Duties ever released (Black Ops 2, Modern Warfare 2). The only piece of improvement needed is the loot boxes. While not super important feeling, it sucks getting duplicates. I haven't bought any and just get the ones from the battle pass or other ways but getting duplicates is so 2019 and I hate it.

Good controls, surprised by that, even the number of options it gives. The downside is the balance, i have always gotten over 10 kills or even 20, other team mates sitting at 4..6..5..not sure if its because they using simple controls, and advance controls appear to have a faster firing start. Next, the weapons need balance...knife kills one hit, i can run around stabbing whole match, kill 10 easy. Snipers one shot it seems..again, easy. Just needs some tweaking...thats all. Pretty solid tho.

Definitely a good game. I enjoy it. I would pay if they would rebuild and do a single player campaign.... or a co-OP campaign. It already has the graphics needed. I'd said $8.99 for a good long campaign. Other than that, sometimes on multiplayer the system matches players that end up stacking it for a complete slaughter and not well balanced.

Update: the new Update really changed the gameplay👎🏼 Graphics were a bit better, but all the renaming of the add-ons sucks. Uninstalling. I'll try a different Battle Royale for a while. Really Like It! It's honestly a fun game to play! There's a bit of a learning curve with the controls but it's seriously a solid game! If you liked the Console or PC games you'll like this if you have a bit of patience.

This game is by far an E3 Mobile winner. I would not give this a 5 star rating, due to its delay of controls and its framerate. The lag is as annoying as getting a shard of glass in you back. What im also having another problem is the low level of items to use. Best thing to do is either put all items as useable in private and as well add a offline mode, or local. If you can add any or all of them into the game, you will lighten my heart. Keep up the great work! From Honors, SNiF Templar.

Great graphics and good game... but the cost if crates, draws and other purchasable items are far overpriced, especially the cost of the draws! What's the point? Make it cheaper and more people will buy... Also, bits are great for beginners, but after a few games, we dont want to see a single bot, ok? Especially when you put a bot in that gets MVP! Use people's profile names etc and turn them into bots... clever, but annoying...

It is actually cod for the phone it is really fun the ttk isn't bad were it is either too fast or too slow it is just right the controls are great as long as your screen is clean, although the score streaks have been downscaled but for good reason (or at least it feels that way) and Queue times are very quick my longest being 22 sec. (for domination) and the graphics and sounds are pretty good for a phone game and no ads, although they do try to get you to buy packs in game

The best game ive eve installed. Quike downloads and fast loading. Fun misiones, tasks, and challenges. Easy and very costumisable controls. And the guns/weapons are very detailed just like the characters and maps. Just perfect. The only problem is that almost all characters, weapons, or just items that you may want have sort of crates and banners that cost money to buy. Money which some people might not want to spend on a game. And a few minor glitches and errors. But most are quickly resolved

Is exactly what it says on the tin, CoD on Mobile devices.. with that comes all the horror of mobile gaming, particularly pay to win elements, progression feels really slow due to new perks and weapons being so spaced out through the levels. Controls are also not great, to play effectively youll need to adopt some sort of claw hand tactic and adjust the button layouts and sizes. All in all though its still good if you want the CoD experience for free. Would not advise paying for this though

First, some people said there is a glitch where it kicks you out, and by the time you get back, you are basically dead. This is true. I would give it a 4 in a quarter, but only if that was a thing. Other than that, please fix the game that I used to play. I am redownloading it to play it. It's fun! Just the bug needs fixing. Maybe more if suggested.

It is a great game. The ranked matches all thr way to veteran 4 is fine but at veteran 4 and higher it is impossible to win a single match. You get paired with rookies, and the other team is full with level 60 elites, that needs to be fixed, but overall great game. Also there needs to be a way to earn cod points instead of being forced to buy them.

The game is great, really good to play with friends and spend time. However the game is greedy, reaching some levels you get nothing but useless rewards ,only dumb camo and some points to buy useless things that no one wants, you need to pay for all interesting things such as guns and characters, and somehow if your friend doesn't have that character (didn't buy it) she/he can't see it. Need to be less greedy guys.

I was willing to allow some time to pass for the apps development. I realized that it would take time for the bugs to be worked out. The game quality did improve for a while. But the last two updates broke the game for me and my friends. The battle Royale was almost unplayable as a team. Voice chat stopped working, inability to see the contents of your backpack. Game freezes. I tried talking to the development team, but never even got any responses. My friends and I deleted the game. Don't play.

All in all this game is good. Not heavy on pay to win though it does have a little going on with multiplayer mode. I noticed the buttons are a press then release and not just with snipers or shotguns. I also do not like that button mode when sniping. I moved my scope button to the top left of the screen so every time I go to ADS my character moves forward automatically. Also when shooting in ADS it moves the screen up every time I hit the fire button and I'm not talking recoil.

I believe this is a 5 star game because graphics are amazing and the control is awesome. I just started playing recently and zombies was in but then due to the lack of usage I believe they took it out. It should be a permanent option. I love the rewards system but with that said I wish there were a lot more customization with characters and items, more battle Royale maps and more options than single & multi-player. This is work in progress but highly recommend & I love the controller option.

Love this game! It keeps me busy and passes the time. I started very docile and not really challenging people. But after a while of having it, I started to put myself to the test and challenge other players. I regret not doing so before! Only downfall is the expense to get a bad@ss character. I'd need to spend $50 usd to get one because I'd have to unlock everything before getting it and/or the mythical/legendary weapon.

For a Mobile Game, nothing less than excellent. Super good in comparison to 95% of other shooters in the mobile scene. Multiplayer is enjoyable and competitive to the point where ranked play feels good. I've heard numerous complaints that BR specifically crashes but I've never experienced this (I play on a Note 10). BR is fun and the classes make it rather unique. Time to Kill is relatively low in BR which is a plus for me. If I had to make a complaint, it would be the strafe speed on SMG's.

Controller support 🙌! Played this game a bit when it launched and found the touch controls a bit cumbersome. I came back after finding out about controller support being added and it's now a solid COD experience on the go! My Dualshock 4 controller would not register inputs correctly on my Android phone (not just this game) but my Xbox One S controller with Bluetooth works perfectly! A lot of nostalgic maps from earlier games are here and there's lots of challenges and modes to keep you busy.

Starting the app the first time took a while, but now not too long. Constant frame drops in multiplayer compared to the battle royal game mode which runs better? Controls takes some time getting used to, but you could change the layout of the ui and buttons which is very important with the default ones being kind of a pain to use. The game is an above average fps shooter for mobile with the usual Acitivsion greed, but you don't really need to buy anything to advance. Also mouse and keyboard users

Its an amazing game. ive been playing for maybe 2 years now and it hasn't had much downside to it but there are some problems 1) once every few months my stuff gets deleted. idk why, but it just randomly gets deleted. and when it does, my phone storage says i still have it downloaded, when i dont. idk if anyone else has this problem 2) my game crashes i would say at least twice a day, and its kind of annoying but not bad. Other than those 2 issues there really isn't anything wrong with the game.

This is honestly the best mobile game I've ever played it feels and looks like an old school cod game but on a phone sometimes you forgot your playing a mobile game and the best bit is that you dont even have to pay to win! Yes you can put money on if you want but you can progress just as easily for free it comes down to how much skill and time you put into it not how much money.

I am totally hooked on this game! I spent a lot of time looking for a shooting game that was exciting, visually striking, accurate and fun. But free. I wasted a lot of frustrated time with countless apps that failed or had me ripping my hair out with frustration with an unrelenting deluge of ads. Not CODM. You are not forced to watch a single ad! If you choose to, you will be rewarded with something you can actually use in the game. That's another thing I love, TONS of useful rewards!

Ok so I've been waiting at least a year for this to come out and then I get an ad for it. You gotta be kidding me. Also it takes forever to download. It also liked it when it was modern warfare style not black ops but that's ok, I have something else to play other than fornite which is pretty trash. Was soon as I saw the loading screen it was awsome!! In 4k 2. As a youtuber this is amazing, though the controls take a bit to get used to but everything else is really great.Im 🙂I can play anywhere

Game is an absolute blast, have always loved playing call of duty in the past. The only thing that would make the game 100 times better: PLEASE find a way to separate controller/PC players from phone users, it's not very fair going against a PC player, or maybe give an option to play cross-platform? I can see potential there with BO4.... would be pretty neat to cross-play although hard for some for sure.

So far so good. Typical Call of duty. It's good, reliable, and loot boxes. It's not super in your face with the p2w, with weapon variants giving a small boost to speed when respawning to get back into the fight, or increasing reload speed with every kill without dying. The touch controls aren't bad, it's responsive like a true call of duty game. All the maps are call of duty throwbacks, like hijacked and crash. Hoping this game doesn't turn into another bl4.

This game has leaderboards for everyone. Even individual weapons leaderboards. Its always got something new to enjoy. Still recommended. Also no ad spams at all. Thanks for that. Love it Now about the ads. I hate them. I watch an ad just to have a 10 second wait, to get a pic of the ad with a double arrow on it to press and exit. That brings me to another pic of the ad for 5 seconds to click the x and I'm made to wait again. Its More time trying to exit an ad then to watch it. What's with that.

Just wish there was also a story based missions options and not only just PvP. Otherwise it's awesome. I would also like to see an option in game that either pops up or is a clickable icon that displays what tasks have been completed or still needs to be completed whilst playing, instead of only being able to see which tasks have been completed or need to be completed once in lobby.

It actually feels like a legitimate call of duty game, featuring old maps from previous games. The controls are pretty fluid using just the touch screen. Multiple different game modes and you can unlock guns, gear, etc. Pretty easily just by leveling up. In app purchases allow you to get ahead a bit but I've fared just fine by simply leveling up without putting in real world cash into the app. I find myself actually playing on breaks at work too. 5/5

Who would've thought that out of all the FPS it would be COD to get it so right! It really feels like a modern console COD that has been ported almost 1:1 from the most iconic maps and gameplay from its main titles. The controls are very responsive and surprisingly accurate. And for the cherry on top, they added a Battle Royale Mode that is pretty solid! The only gripe I have are minor bugs, for example whenever you aim downsights and tap the map icon, it won't come up. Otherwise, fantastic!

Only got to play 1 match. Ever since then I go into a match and when the countdown timer hits 0 it freezes and then crashes. Every time. Please fix this so I can play the game and leave a better review *The game started to work for about a week and now I can't get past the first loading screen. Gets stuck on "Loading, Please Be Patient" and then crashes. Have tried restarting my phone, connecting to wifi, and uninstalling, then reinstalling the game. Please fix.

UPDATE: I have demoted my review from a 4 star to a 1 star. What developer in their right mind would release an amazing game add on like zombies to then remove it, and not bring anything better to fulfill its huge empty place. The ball has been dropped and you have done nothing to recover from it. Disappointing. Definitely needs more work on maps and movement/simple glitches. And nothings like playing on a console but definitely great for a mobile game. High definition phones have the advantage.

Possibly the best shooter out there for mobile right now! TONS of maps, different mode options, Battle Royale mode, and honestly there's waaayyyyy too much to list! I will say that it does support Xbox controllers, which makes for more of an Xbox-type experience, which definitely makes for an interesting game. There's Battle Passes, various ways to earn weapons and other cool things too!

Well, I'm changing my review to a 4 star from 5 star now. Reason is that even though the game has progressed so much in terms of content since it was released, after the recent balance changes we had, the game isn't as well optimised as it used to be, there's lag, frame drops, and sometimes connectivity issues for no reason at all. Please fix the issues.

The game is ultimately great. The graphics, controls everything are fine. But I'm having an issue with the gameplay. 1st of all it's lagging a lot. I keep on running on the same place many times and get killed. The 2nd problem is, it kicks me out of the game sometimes. Whenever I play more than 1 or 2 MP or play BR it whether kicks me out of the game or the 3rd problem occurs. The 3rd issue I have here is the Black Screen. As described before, I can't play more than 1 or 2 matches in a row.

Codm is surprisingly good. Better then I could ever expect. Gun play in good. You can be conpatitive with pay a single cent. A new gun and map every season. A lot of replayability. It takes up a lot of space. I got up to 5gb on my phone. So if your phone doesn't have a lot memory don't play it. Controls are hard. If you are fine with all the negatives, it's a must play.

Good job Activision, good job. This game is really good BUT I doubt low end devices will handle it. Maybe on the lowest graphics setting, but I still doubt it. Big game, lots of features, lots of fun. One downside is that it has a bit of hitbox issues, it isn't noticeable too much but sometimes you get hit even tho you are not where the enemy is aiming at, ofc the same goes to enemy players, I had ridiculous kills where I didn't see them but still got em, besides that it's a perfect game 👌

Amazing game, never gets boring. 10/10 for gameplay. However there there sometimes problems when buying in game currency and they removed zombies mode! Why?? But the main thing is the lag, normally its not enough to bother me but since the new update the game keeps crashing or kicking me from games and will corrupt any footage I try to record. Is also faulty for a lot of people I know but still works well for others. Good luck

This game takes a lot of data. If your connection isn't strong, or your phone doesn't run octacore, you may have issues. All that said, once you get in, it's freaking addictive. Exceptional graphics. No lag in game play. A little slow to load the next game, but it's an all around great game. A lot of people run map, speed, and aim hacks in ranked match, and reporting them does no good, so you may have to be good at coding to get anywhere fast in ranked match.

Besides the fact that the final kill cam shows wierd shooting and lagg this game hit it right upon its release date !! Everything runs smooth and the graphics are great!! It is cross platform between android and apple devices! This is the 1st game I've ever invested in for a season pass which benefits hard work !! Only thing I will say is that if the Call of Duty can't get rid of the hackers then this 5 star rating might change in the near future .. Keep it up!!

Although there are still a few bugs here and there, it's definitely worth it all! This could easily be the best mobile game I have ever played, but there's one more thing I'd like to see. For Halloween I was thinking for an easter egg, they change the thermal scopes to x-ray scopes, turning the world into a dark foggy place with maybe a couple gravestones. But here's the best part: people, instead of seeing them with thermal, would become skeletons turning the world into a fully spooky place!

Addictive..my cons are not being able to communicate through the mic in-game and sometimes in-game on battle royal when I'm running or walking..it seems to jump alot. I cant really explain it but it's very annoying. I even power my phone off then back on and it still doesn't fix the issue. These 2 reasons are the only reasons I'm giving it a 4 star. Other than that it will deff be a 5 star. Hopefully it'll get fixed

Really smooth, deals with inevitable latency relatively fairly given it's fairly new. At higher ranks in Multiplayer however, things get iffy. The delay, regardless of how good connection is on your side, is ridiculous, and unfortunately, that 94ms is the difference between a fair fight and waiting for death to catch up on your screen on elite and up. The weapons are also getting pretty tired(already), could stand for some additions, (no, re-skins dont count).

The gameplay itself is amazing, this is the best fps you can get on mobile platforms, but players with controllers or on tablets will have a massive advantage over the rest. The problem lies in the microtransactions, not only they're lootboxes but they're the most expensive I've ever seen in any game, ever. At least recent changes have been going in the right direction and adding a way to play for them. Still you're likely to only get trash.

It is a fairly nice game. But recently it start having problems. And it pisses me off so much. For some reason after my controller died once it will no longer work. It says that the controller is connected inside of call of duty inside of the settings it says that it's activated and everything. But it does not read the controls anymore. It does not move it does not turn it does not attack it does not jump it does not reload it does nothing. They appear to have had this problem for a long time.

Its was a lot of fun, even with all the glitches. But within the last week I haven't been able to access my character I've been working with up to level 33, then I couldn't get past the initial loading screen, it just kept loading halfway and then starting over in an endless loop. Then I tried reinstalling it, got to 100% download, but I cant open it from the play store and there isnt an icon for it in my apps. I want to give it one star, but it was fun when it worked.

As far as game play, it's the same stuff that's on a system. However, I keep getting xp taken away from my ranked matches bc their servers keep kicking me, my gun and controls will randomly disappear in the middle of games so I have to camp and hope they load bc I don't want to lose xp by leaving the match so it kills my kdr, my guns will randomly fire, I can be sprinting and it will sometimes randomly slowdown or get stuck and I can't stop bc my controls stop working, and so much more.

I've been playing this game a ton, best CoD in a long time imo. However, I just bought a controller only to realize that they took away controller support in an update. I'm quite upset about this. I will make my rating 5 when that and the following are fixed. Game crashes 2 or 3 times every time before finally launching. Reloading takes like 2 seconds longer than the animation and is far more concerning than trying to kill someone with a controller while I play touch... FFS

An excellent time, I've had this game for about a month or two now, although the game has bugs, like sometimes not being able to hear others in match lobbies or while in game both MP or BR (or your friends having the same issue vice versa). A rare occurrence but sometimes the app or my phone will just shut down automatically and people can sometimes kill you after you run around a wall they're not supposed hit (yes ik about penetration with some walls) love the game but definitely needs work.

Super fun, great thing to hear that this supports other controllers/devices that we can use in this game! This game is not boring at all, no cheaters I found, no donkeys, and overall, this game is a badass, I recommend this. I don't care if it takes more shots to kill an enemy! I seen other reviews about this and I don't understand what about it, you'll think it takes more less shots for you to die but more shots for you to shoot at the current enemy as you see but it's actually equal.

The game is decent. Graphics are good, maps are good but this won't be anything special in the near future. Team matches are full of bots that do nothing but provide kills to enemies. Sometimes it all of a sudden lags (although I have a very good phone) and in the middle of a fight you will be all of a sudden looking at the sky while while the enemy enjoys killing you. The range of weapons like gunshots is just absurd, u gotta be right beside the other player to kill him, etc etc... Not enough

There is some things they should fix. Like climbing because you can get stuck in the windows in Nuketown. So if you could add a button to climb instead of just clicking jump that would help.
