But other than that good graphics and has all the best favorited maps from call of duty Black ops 2. And crash from mw or mwr. Anyway if you like gun games or you like call of duty this game is for you!!!! Get it for free!!!

I've played Call of Duty for years, and if you want to get the true call of duty experience you lost definitely have to try it on controller. I use my Dualshock controller a lot, but it's not like console. I know it's hard to make it turn and like console, but is there a way to make it more reactive. Quick scoping isn't the same, but I got to say you definitely make it feel like the real call of duty, with a mobile experience.

(BR ONLY) This mode has been in the shadows for as long as I can remember. It has never gotten any sort of love, not even any big changes, just tiny additions over 2 years. Blackout has currently released, and the entire BR health system and gameplay got a revamp. So far BR is great, but I'd have to play more to get a full clear review, but so far 4 stars is what I'll give it.

Only problem I have with the game is it kicks me out of the game whenever it wants to. How do I fix this issue so please. Also the 10v10game mode is the best game mode ever. Lots of kills every game. Bombs.ect. Please help me and thanks very much. The rest of the game is excellent only lags time to time again. Due to maybe my wifi connection, possibly kicking me also, not sure. Says I'm full bars 100% wifi signal connected. But maybe roams and drops signal then connects real quick again. Thanks.

COD Mobile is one of the greatest games for smartphones. Not only is it free to play, the loot boxes do not signify a 'pay to win' experience. The new update really completes this game because there is now something for every type of player to enjoy (Zombies, Multiplayer, Battle Royale). While the gameplay and graphics run smooth, your internet connection has to be consistently top notch or you will experience lag in firefights and waiting time before being placed in a match.

It is a great game to play. I love it. But please fix the bugs in the game. BR and multiplayer. I keep seeing players stuck in the walls and out of no where you can empty two clips in on a player and they dont die. But it says you killed them. But they are still running around and kill you. Its almost like the game has been hacked or something. But there are a lot of bugs that need to get fixed. Please fix them

Great game - The fact it's on mobile has slowed the gameplay ever so slightly due to the controls, but this is platform related and certainly nothing wrong with the game. It seems to lean slightly towards sniper gameplay due to the ever so slightly decreased lace, but sniping is by no means overpowered. EDIT: Lost a few stars to matchmaking. At level 40, you're suddenly paired with people level 100+, which is a whole different game. It's a very sudden change.

this is one of my favorite games! it's very nice, the graphics and gameplay are great, i'd give it 5 stars but it takes up way too much space. i wish there was a lite version or something, i had to delete 10 apps bc it needed that much space, which is kind of ridiculous. needless to say, i don't play that much anymore bc of it. if it took up less space i'd play it a lot more

Really fun nostalgic COD feeling However....... I have seen two issues that really bother me. 1st being logging in. Its very annoying that i have to close like 4 ad windows to even get to the main screen. 2nd being the free rewards box doesnt work. I go to it and watch the ad then when its done i get told the box is in my mailbox. No matter how many times i do it there is never a reward box. Im basically watching ads for nothing. Please fix this!

Flawless! Really like it being cross platform so I can play with my iPhone friends. Good maps coming from the COD series. Wish Terminal comes sooner or later. No controller support tho. Was hoping to use my dualshock and make my phone into a portable game console. *** (2020 UPDATE) For some reason I can't add friends as they are "on different servers". I am also unable to invite friends to join the clan as I used to.

The game is fun, but poorly optimised. You can barely play without frame drops, overheating, crashes, etc. BR has tons of lag, but used to be super fun. Balancing 1000% needs to happen, since persistance and k9 are ruining everything fun. I have been playing since s1 and don't want to see the game die out, so hopefully what I say changes at some point soon

I've been a long time player of around 3 years, and I can safely say that this is one of the best mobile games out there. Only downside I can really think of is the space it takes, a whopping 20gb if you download it in its entirety. The graphics are great, and the game keeps getting updated with content. I wish they would dial down on the cosmetics, as that is where the majority of the storage space lies. Roughly 16 of the 20gb are purely cosmetics--expensive ones at that. Overall, decent game.

To be fair, I don't think CoD was ready for mobile devices. Screens are just a little too small for the gameplay, let alone the controls, making it an essential to have used a controller for playing this. Graphics are okay at best if you dont want to bork your phone's temperature, and the home screen looks like if I downloaded malware onto the local library's public computer. Not to destroy the dev's though, I really think this concept is great! I just don't think mobile is best for CoD.

One of the best mobile games. If you dont have a phone with 4gb ram it just wont work. People need to understand that you need a decent phone to play smoothly. I read other review complaining about the controls and that you NEED a controller. That is not true this is just on you abilities as a player. I can use all the button slide shoot and aiming. If you are not good at mobile games, have stiff fingers and your phone isnt good then dont review or at least review honestly. This game is great!

This game is arguably the best F2P fps shooter on mobile. It has the smoothest controls of any mobile shooter, the content is constant and interesting, and it's just pretty satisfying. Unfortunately, lag and freezing happen a bit too often for my liking, and it tends to happen in a life or Death situation. It's also not P2W, so that's a bonus.

It's alright... it rarely crashes,and there aren't many gripes I have besides one thing... controllers. It's nearly impossible to get into a game without someone using a controller,which wouldn't be that bad if it was a PC game but... it's a mobile game. As someone without an Xbox controller,this tends to be annoying. But besides that,pretty solid game. Battlepass is a bit ridiculous tho.

It's ok, once you get past all the menu bs and the in-app purchases then you get a decent game. Once you start playing the controls are pretty easy after and smooth. The only noticeable downfall is with the cheaters in the game that pretty much doesn't make the game fun anymore. You can clearly see who cheats by the stats and when you're playing for example people have infinite killstreaks as soon as the match starts or they dont take damage. After all that still a decent game.

It runs really well, and there's a lot to do, you can play short games like gun game, Frontline and such, or you can pay a long game like battle Royale. It's super fun, and there's something for everyone. I really enjoy attack of the undead, and I wish it were a permanent game mode. Also I wish that the Reaper operator wasn't so loud, I love the skin, but it's not good in ranked

This is a very good game, it's one of the best! But there is one thing I am waiting for, the armor and head gear! If you go to change your backpack, it shows both armor and head gear tabs but theres nothing inside of it! But overall I like the game, perfect, amazing, satisfying, fun, adicting, action-packed, all words that describe this game! And its easy to level up at a lower level! So I highly recommend please download.

Really good game with many modes and features. Follows the Battle Pass structure as other games on market now, has a minor system for loot box, but it doesn't seems to be a focus, only serving to give smaller prizes for mission and ads (sprays, skins and gestures) Just like other Tencent games, it wants to make itself an esport game. And for now I don't have anything to say against it's market strategy.

The game is legit. 5 stars for motivation, cuz y'all doin the right thing. More emphasis on bugs and the leave-app resume fix. I'm updating for 2nd Season now. I already know it's gonna be better than before cuz y'all are on the right track. Recommendations: Zombie Mode. I grew up playing that. 4 player Team against zombies on a barely functional bus was soo much fun. Anyway, keep up the good work.

I love the game, it's the best Battle Royale on mobile. The controls are easy to grasp. And the graphics are so much better than other BR games I've played. My complaint is the newer rocket launcher class. It is near impossible to fight against. It's got hommimg missiles and kills in 1 steike. It gives the play a huge advantage against those that can't play that class yet. As it has anti-aircraft missiles, it should not be able to home in on individual people.

Honestly one of the best fps mobile games. I really like the ability to link a controller to the game via bluetooth but its still fun to play even without one. I doubt they actually matchmake me against other players with controllers because I see no diffrence in game play but 🤷‍♂️. I do miss zombies though, which is why its a 4 star right now. Zombies was alot of fun to play on mobile because you could pause and save the game to play for later. I hope they add it back.

This game is a really fun game for long time fans of call of duty. It doesn't have the weird jet boost thing from the other games and runs on almost any phone with graphics at the same level as an Xbox 360 (good for mobile) I don't like some of the microtransactions but you have to appreciate all the work and effort the developers put into this game. 4/5

As far as COD on a mobile device goes, its what you'd expext. The gunplay is good up until you start encountering SMGs, and then its just a game of "who can tap fire faster". Snipers dominate long range maps, and auto-aim is as much an issue as its always been. The game itself can be very enjoyable, and then it can be utterly unbearable. I imagine using some sort of phone controller would lend a lot to the game. Graphics are nominal, lag is.. Well, lag. Overall, better than expectes. 4/5 stars.
this is the most mind blowing game I've ever seen in my life. I always choose this game ro relieve my stress and its so wonderful.

I love everything about the game but if you add more guns to choose from, and an easier way to get the guns the game would be way better. Also ask in different missions and challenges for different items. You could even add a prestige so when you get to a high enough level, you could spice it up a little and restart from the first part of the game. Also add a campaign for when you get tired of playing online or with bots.

I love how much you can do on this game. It's one of the very few that you don't have to ptw. Most games limit what you get if you don't p2p as well but this one does not hinder anything. Yes if you want to speed things up you can pay. But if you dont no worries you just grind harder and play a little longer but you will get what you want. Fantastic phone game and I love the ability to add a controller as I have the series 2 elite from Microsoft and it works flawlessly and quick. Fantastic.

I am absolutely astonished at the level of FPS made for mobile devices. There are so many maps to play in. The guns are really fun to use, VERY smooth gameplay. I also love that there are so many modes. Like capture the flag, domination, frontline and so many more. Even limited modes! I would definitely recommend this game to anyone. Literal perfect FPS.

Call of Duty mobile is easily the best app out right now when it comes to games. It is literally a fully functioning Call of Duty game with multiple modes to choose from multiple customisations and many more features that make it fun and addicting. There could be a few improvements but with the recent edition of controller support which I'm excited to try and zombies not to mention the free battle pass challenges I am very into this game right now.

Neverending Fun! I have been playing COD for years, and this is BY FAR one of the best games I have ever played. It has excellent graphics that don't lag your phone, tons of different game modes, and is in no way a "pay to win" kind of game. I only gave it for 4 stars because of some recent issues with the game. Those included are: 1. Voice chat only works sometimes in BR 2. Not calibrated well for a controller Other than that, keep it up Tencent!

It lags some times even with good wifi. There are times when you would be in the middle of a game and it would kick you out. And yes iv checked my storage, wifi, and all that iv had to uninstall it only for it to do the same and not change that's why I'm giving it 4 instead of 5 stars. There is also a something with storage, its taking up 10GB and I dont even know how fix that aside from not being able to download anything else while i have call of duty installed.

The game was nostalgic, It was as if I just gotten home from school, put my backpack down and just turned on my Xbox 360. The boys are online, we hope onto a match of team deathmatch on BO2. There's not a care in the world besides that swarm the enemy just called in. Its exactly what it felt like, the maps are so good, the guns are great too, and overall, keep up the great work and I hope zombies comes out even better!!!

I've played for a few weeks now and I got to say it's just great. You can hook up any bluetooth controllers easy. Kinda clunky, sometimes the controller will cut out mid fight for a few sec gets super bad when the battery on the controller is low. if you run the graphics at max then the phone gets kinda hot. Pro tip: (You can put your phone/tablet on a ice pack to keep it cool just use a washcloth or something) Mobile has a bunch of different modes just like the COD on console. Definitely a must

I love the game so much and think it is cool 😎. The only problem is that I've had to delete the game a few times due to storage and every time you download it again you have to do the update again if you've already done it and it takes a million years. Also there's people who cheat and then if you don't have cheaters it's bots.Also they need to bring Zombies back cause that was one of my fav parts about the game. Other than that though the games awesome.

The game is fun when it works. It only works on wifi so everytime it starts on my mobile data it gets stuck on finding version info. The bar goes to 100% pretty quickly and then restarts. It never goes past that screen. When I play on wifi it lags really bad. I have unlimited 4G LTE and unlimited high-speed wifi. So I dont know what the problem is.

Please bring zombies back with random box of weapons. That game mode is better than having to survive with zombies in a van or truck. Second is I hate how you can be shot through walls. That needs to be fixed. Very annoying. Third is allow a profile picture change not based on Facebook please. What happens if Facebook disables your account then your stuck with the picture you have set.

it's cool because when I downloaded it I needed to get rid of pubg so I could play this game and I found it has a battle royal also. It also deserves 5 stars because the graphics are good, it has the call of duty black ops 2 maps so It helps in TDM and other fun matches cause I know the maps so I can strategize a little better, and everything all around is just great. I say give it a shot plus it's free!, Leveling up is pretty easy to.

As for me, the fps is high, the game is not crashing, not lagging, not freezing etc. The only downside of the game is the painfully arcade shooting mechanis, that's not giving the Player anh challenge. All the bullets are going straight to the center, sometimes even not on ADS, thus the game is, unfortunately, boring. BR is another story, when you can revive a dead teammate, heal both you and your team-mates using some magic, AND there is no fall damage.

It's a very good game, but there are some problems like the enormous amount of battery consumption it's just abnormal and all the time I'm there in the middle of a gun fight and the character doesn't shoot then I realize it's because sometimes the walk button is pressed instead of the fire button the walk commands should be fixed and not change depending on where you click.

Obviously MTX heavy, but great without purchases so far! I normally don't like mobile games at all, nearly every one has lost my interest pretty quickly, but this is legitimately pretty fun. Matches load quick, and unlocks come frequently enough make it rewarding to do well. Bugs you to buy cod point to buy "tiers" which is honestly one of the worst things to happen to multiplayer games. Maps are cool, aiming mechanics are interesting, sound is meh. Over really enjoyed it.

OMG. Once again, I re-installed this because it's so fun when I'm bored and need to pass time. And once again, it updated and takes 10 mins to open the app from "downloading dynamic resources", then needs 30+ mins of more downloads to play the game with full items. And this happened twice within a week. This is not a console game, nobody has time for that. I'm done.

Battle royale still needs some love. The map is far too big for a mobile game. It would also be nice to have things like buy stations and contracts, similar to warzone. The new zombies event is nice, and they should keep doing them but it would be fantastic to have the classic maps and round based horde mode back. Multiplayer is great but there seems to still be a glitch when you select "play again" where you end up stuck in the same game mode rather than cycling through the modes you selected

Summary: The game itself is pretty decent fun. A mix of elements from various CoD games, though it seems most heavily influenced by Black Ops 2(which is rather overrated imo). Being rather amatuer to mobile controls, I can't really give an honest opinion about the gunplay. What I can say is that the game does have it's flaws. Servers seem laggy, netcoding is messy at times, to the point where the "shoot first, die first" moments occur regularly, and the game crashes once in a while in BR mode.

It's Call of Duty, but the map design and basic gameplay is just not good. The on-screen controls are atrocious; you're better off running around with the one hit knife as your opponents try and aim at you than you are actually engaging them with a firearm. The controls are that poor. Outside of the abysmal funnel/tunnel map design, if you could play this with a controller it would be a competent shooter. Not worth the bandwidth to download or play.

It's a shame that this game force-quits as often as it does. It's a great take on the Call of Duty experience and certainly one of the best mobile shooters to ever be made. Controller options needs deadzone configuration options and a little better low-spec graphics options, but If you have a good gamepad, this game is top-of-the-line in mobile gaming.

Game is awesome..! I could notice that some of the opponents when use the trickster class they are not look like holographic, they look like real characters , they are not blue as usual, but only some of the opponents doing like that, So how they do that? Can anyone please explain.And the Auto Firing(Simple Mode) is Not Good,Auto firing guys guns will shoot automatically while running time also,even they didn't notice where enemy is,and every one should play the game with manul controls/buttons

It's a pretty good game, tho I do have a problem with the ranked system, mostly for BR. You don't get many points for one and it doesn't seem to rise at all when you get decent matches (+10 kill games). I noticed this when I was playing with a Squad and purposely didn't pull my weight until the end. As far as Multiplayer It's pretty much the same case as BR. I also feel a FFA(Free for all) mode should be introduced later on for those days we just wanna test our selves and not rely on others.

It becomes laggy in the next update and I can barely played it. Often, the game freezes and there are times when I think it looks like I played a shooter game with 30 frameskip, which is killing the animation itself and running around feels like teleporting. It got worse when I found enemy, it doubles the lag and I have no choice but to stop playing. I'm quite disappointed but I believe the dev will do something about this and solve it ASAP.

Would've given a 4/5. But there's a lot of issue coming up whenever I open the game. All my internet connected apps are running perfectly but when I start the game it says "download configuration failed. Make sure your device is connected to a network and then restart the game". Yeah it starts eventually(!) but sometimes it just takes forever to start the game (like right now) Apart from this everything else is fine and good to go and hoping for fixing minor and developmental issues.

Great game. Good graphics. Great updates. No pay to play action. Only bad thing is the auto aim and shoot. If the person you are shooting at is laying in the prone position, it will not allow you to shoot them in auto fire. I have complained but, nothing has been done in about 6 months. I also quit spending money because of this issue. If not for this issue I would have gave 5 stars.

It's call of duty on your phone, controls exceptionally well using just the touchscreen which suprises me since most mobile shooters don't control that well. Support for a controller isn't ready yet on android, I'm not sure if I'll use it when it is because it controls that well. Did I mention the controls are excellent? I cannot stress that point enough.

It really feels like what it says it is, cod on the go. The execution is really good with some minor mishaps. For example, some guns are under powered and some people get wiped out due the fact that the match making system needs some work to level out the players levels. Because some times, people will hop into a game, and one person will be ridiculously over leveled. Besides that, A pretty great game overall.

Game looks great and plays very smoothly. 2 stars because your crates are absolute BS. They cost like $30+ to get all of the items out of just the smaller ones and 9/10 I just get a duplicate item instead of a new item, which in turn only gets you like 30 credits which is NO WHERE near as many credits as the items are worth considering it costs a ridiculous amount. Absolutely broken and a rip off in that area. I can understand spotty game play, but that is just pure greed and cash grabbing.

This is the F2P Mobile FPS you've been looking for. You are able to unlock ALL upgrades, and weapons of the base game for free, by playing, and the better you do, the better you'll be rewarded. The weapons you pay for do not make the game unfair. Use headphones, and beware the players in white. Lastly, for new, or returning players; TURN ON SIMPLE CONTROLS, TURN THEM ON! At least until you've mastered movement, and become confident enough for advanced controls.

I love the game, how it looks, and all the different guns you can get and all the micanics you added like the NUKE but I don't know if it is a glitch or just my internet connection but I would join a multiplayer game and most of the time if I get shot at and killed I start lagging like crazy and sometimes I can deal with it and other times it makes that match unplayable for me.

Solid gameplay and really fun on the go. The only drawback of course are the micro transactions. I hate that there isnt an option to purchase the "full" version to do away with all the offers and content walls placed within the game. Gun play is excellent after you get adjusted and matches have that classic quick and hectic cod feel.

Way better than I expected. Obviously it doesnt have the graphics or gameplay of a console version, but its significantly better than any other 1st person shooter on the play store. Good handling (not great), fast matchmaking, lots of gameplay choices (though I wish the ones available were open to all maps, maybe in the future). If you like COD then pick this up. Edit: Gameplay still great, but the game constantly crashes at the end of games and it's really annoying..lost a star for that alone.

No Bluetooth controller support, I got a buddy who has an iPhone and he can use his Xbox controller to play this game yet it's not supported on Android. What gives? I don't really play shooters on mobile but when this came out I was excited. I tried to play with on screen controls but I find it very difficult. I read that the game had Bluetooth controller support during the beta but once it officially launched it was not supported anymore. One star, less if I could give it.

This is one of the only games I actually felt compelled to leave a review on. Okay so this brings back what I felt when I played black ops 2, one of the best of cod in my opinion, not only that but once you get the hang of the controls it's actually really simple! I'm super excited for when the zombies comes out what other new content for the games comes!!

Everything and more than can be expected from call of duty. !!! AWESOME!!! only thing that i didnt like auto shot hate games with auto shot, theres no skill to it anyone can do it.... 😝 Other than that everythin is just what a game should be. Graphics, gameplay, controls, experience in game, and the new mode pub awesome... Great job guys !!!LOVE IT!!!

I have been playing Call of Duty Mobile since Season 1. I've bought every gamepass, and they are all awesome, filled with awesome gear and guns. Battle Royale is fun to do. You can do short film movies in a Private Battle Royale map. Zombies is really good. But when you make the special zombie called Brutus mad he runs at you at high speed. So that might need a fix. Settings and controls are adjustable to your liking. Ranked points are hard to get. That was my experience from Season 1 to now. 👍

I have tried many other shooter games but in my opinion, it's the best. Let me tell you its reason. Actually i have to say reasons. First of all, it has a plenty of game modes which PUBG doesn't have. For example; team deathmatch, domination, search and destroy etc. Probably my favourite is domination. There are also a few modes which are added every week/month. You can customize your weapons, characters, even the vehicles and your parachute in battle royale. In conclusion, play it.

I am so mad I didn't find this game sooner! ! ! I love, LOVE COD! The only reason I didn't give it 5 🌟 is because of the game sticking in the middle of battle where I can't shoot it move or if in mid sprint it just keeps running. Nothing like getting killed because of the glitches! Extremely irritating! I do love playing the different games within the games. Get tried of battle royal, go play capture the flag or kill confirm! Just love the variety! Would like a more feminine looking avatar.

Fantastic, I'm loving this awesomness. Pros: This is the closest I've seen to console level graphics in an Android game. It has a very slick interface that easy to get use to, and great features. The maps and mission are great too, especially Zombie Hardcore Raid and Survival. Looking forward to future game modes like Prop Hunt and Sticks & Stones. Cons: I was docked a total of 60 xp due to connectivity and freezing. Something that I am not in control of. I have emailed them, but no go.

Super fun game, it takes a LOT of storage in your phone and if you do not have enough storage the game will not work, it'll lag or will not let you play for long. Other then that they keep up with trends, holidays, you can connect with friends and play, very strict on swearing over mics, keeps the game clean, once you move up levels the people get better and better as opponents. My least favorite part will be that the zombies isn't like the original zombies on Xbox, or anything else.

I only give this a 3 star because of the crashing. In recent updates with the game my screen will randomly go dark and I have to exit the app and restart it to finish out my game. While this happens I'm normally in battle royal, and we all know how you have to stay frosty. Its caused me some deaths. The newest update has been causing my phone to go dark screen in multiplayer mode too. I've noticed this really only happens when I've been on the app for awhile. But all in all I enjoy this game.

Absolutely love this game, I just have one problem. It's with ranked multiplayer match making which is lacking for controler users. I don't like having to switch to my fingers just to get ranked tasks completed. It really deturbs me form playing. if that could be attended to I would have no issues. Plus I would like to experience Natiz Zombies matchmaking I hear that was fun. For all of those how paid to play zombies I understand how they would feel robbed in some way as well.

Needs. Bluetooth. Controller. Support. I love this game, I love this series. I'd love to have a serious COD experience on the go, which means the option to be as close to the console experience as possible via a controller. Let those who want to play on-screen do so, but allow die-hards the option to enjoy with a controller. .

Knives seem to work fine if you're holding them as a secondary, but if your secondary is anything else, and you get the knife icon to appear near an enemy, you might as well not even press it. Pressing that icon gets you killed 7/10 times. There seems to be a delay after pressing it, to where if it was equipped, there'd be none. Second is Shotguns, when using advance controls, pressing the fire button aims the shotgun but hardly ever fires it, I find myself having to press the button repeatedly.

Exceptional gameplay on a mobile device!! I spent about 20 minutes reading through the negative comments about this game. Reconnecting....lagging...issues of that sort. I had the same issues from time. They are all phone, service, and/or wifi related, in my opinion. I recently moved, updated my phone, and got better wifi service and I have not had 1 single issue since.

Graphics are good not great (it's mobile🤷🏼‍♂️), gameplay is fun, a few times my taps wouldn't register in a game and id get killed, knifing is a no go, too easy to miss. Overall a GREAT mobile game with different game modes and old school COD maps. Super enjoyable experience I just started today and haven't been able to put my phone down for longer than 30 mins. Addicting! They really took their time to get their mobile version out there and it shows because it's so good. 10/10 would recommend.

Graphics are great for a mobile game! The controls are amazing I usually don't like shooters on a phone but this game is so easy to master! Battle Royale is amazing being packed into a phone. Was hype for this for months so I am not disappointed! Definitely recommend. No server issues for me I saw some people were having some though.. But all around a great experience! Has a battle pass if you are into or not into that. It's $10.

Amazing! But bring back zombies!!! The gameplay and graphics are incredible but we really need a zombie hunting mode and easier way to play multiplayer with your friends. Also please add a feature where you can customize where you put buttons! Because it's hard to move and aim down the site and fire at the same time because all those controls are on the right side of the screen. When you're aiming down the site please add an option to move where youre looking to the left side of the screen!

Mostly really enjoy the game but there are a few things,I've noticed that almost every if not every other match it looks like there are people who look to use aim boys or aim assist tools because all the sudden someone will make a 180 turn around and kill someone. Also, like most, loot boxes are, Really bad! I thought, sure I'll get one for the fun of it and it Gave me next to nothing and the drop rates are deceiving... Not to mention a "uncommon gun" is $10 Also controller support would be nice

This is the best mobile shooter game I have ever played! It may take awhile to download in this rural area, but it's phenomenal. And if you download the high resolution graphics, pure enjoyment. So many different modes and if you like zombies, there is a mode for that too. I have only one issue, tho. It's when you turn on your mic for the game. It disables lowering your volume all the way. I could actually only bring it down to 2 notches above mute. Other than that, very good game.

I really love this game. The only probyis when I get on it, my screen starts to lag and it started to freeze again. It made this weird noise and it bothered me so I decided to delete it. I was gonna give this a 4 ⭐ but I realized how good it was. If you fix the freezing, glitching, and lagging issue. I will download the game.

I grew up playing Call of Duty and was really excited when I found out they were making a mobile game so I downloaded it and it took over an hour to download but after a downloaded seems pretty fun to play except for the slow progression in weapons and how sometimes when you're trying to just look around you end up shooting but other than that great game overall. Would have given 5 stars if it wasn't for the control issue

I LOVE THIS GAME! This is the best FPS on the Play Store, the controls are involved and I'd recommend the use of a mobile gamepad or PS4/XBOX controller, but the on-screen controls can be mastered (get finger sleeves). If your device and connection can handle the requirements, it's pretty close to flawless. If you're a longtime COD player you're going to love the classic maps, takes me back to my youth! No pay to win, just pay to get cool characters and camos.

Game is awesome, brings back old school CoD feel, yes there are a few bugs, lag is an issue and there are already mod hacks for it, but that still doesn't take away from the over all experience. The micro transactions help you level up faster but are not needed and dont give an advantage in game play. I have yet to try the battle royal part, but the multiplayer is addictive and a blast. More maps hopefully in the future!

I didn't have high expectations when downloading this. I thought it would be impossible for a touch-screen mobile device to host a Call of Duty game which looks and feels authentic to the franchises major console titles. Needlessly to say, I was wrong. My phone is over two years old now, yet game play runs flawlessly and controls are very comfortable. Much to my surprise, I'm not being inundated with third party ads either. This game is exceptionally good value (well, it's FREE) and impeccably designed. Getting a head-shot on a mobile is just as fun as landing the same on console.

When I played this game 4 months ago it worked like a dream, it was smooth and gameplay was great. The menu was easy to navigate. But NOW currently... It is laggy and buggy. The menu freezes and I don't understand why when my phone has nearly 6gb of RAM. FIX THIS PLEASEEE... In the Marine corps when I have down time this game is a great time killer...

It's a good time burner and you don't really have to pay to play which is nice for a change. The flaws are the controls, not having enough fingers for the buttons no matter how I configured it. I can't look, run, aim and shoot at the same time but other than that I enjoy it. Bots are on the early stages but as you rank up you will find many tough gamer humans.

The game is awesome, between all the FPS available in the Play Store this is by far the best. The graphics are good even on low settings, the controls are responsive (most of the time) and there are lots of free rewards monthly. There's one thing that I noticed though, when I play Battle Royale the performance drops noticeably, the frames seem to fall down and it's not that smooth. I guess is because of the huge map and all that so maybe its normal. Overall, really fun. Thats all that matters!

Excellent mobile adaptation of a classic gameplay loop. Matches are engaging and fun, as well as quick enough to hop into one during any moment of downtime. The variety of weapons, maps, and game modes provide an incredible amount of content for a free mobile game. Microtransactions are totally optional and do not provide any significant gameplay advantage. Despite that, I have purchased the season pass and haven't regretted it one bit.

Absolutely great job Tencent. The controls are easy to get and the overall experience is much like the past console versions of this game. If you guys could change a few of the settings so we can edit more controls like the controls for vehicles. I have trouble driving because I can't edit the buttons so they're farther apart. It's not too much of a problem but it does make me feel cramped and I would like it fixed in a future update.

As someone who loves playing video games, I was hesitant when I found out there was a COD Mobile. However, I downloaded it. And, I am extremely impressed, it's not perfect, but it's extremely well done. Graphics are great, controls are great, nothing really to complain about besides the fact that when it shows the final kill you take like 10 shots and non of which actually hit them except on a RARE occasion but other then that, great game. ❗

It's great, brings me back to the original modern warfare 1 and 2. The controls are amazing for a mobile game, though there are little discrepancies (cant ADS and not fire full automatic, can be hard to ADS and look all the way to the right). I have gotten the black screen, having to forfeit the BR match I was in. It was after changing my settings to high res, so that might be what triggered the bug. The matches are a perfect length, and matches can be very competitive and fast paced.

Despite the bugs, I would give this 5 stars for making this awesome. But, there are bugs. For example, mine just froze suddenly while an ADS. I could hear everything properly, but the screen kept stuttering and I couldn't move. Minimized the game and opened again and now the screen was blank, still able to hear everything. Had to close it and open again, but luckily was able to rejoin the game.

This game, so far, truly is great. I personaly am not a fan of the gameplay Black Ops III and IV. This game has the best parts from BO4, such as some of the maps, characters, and special weapons, but makes it easy to win like in BO2. Everybody loves winning. The Battle Royale mode definitely has some kinks to work out but the app is in early stages. Multiplayer mode is nearly perfect and simple to understand and quick to learn the controls. I wouldn't recommend if you have a small screen, though.

The constant stuck at the loading screen crash has been completely frustrating, I would love to give this game a 5 star rating but I'm constantly crashing or stuck at the intro loading screen. I know the game was just released and there may be a few bugs here and there but the "dev's " might need to speed this one up, and personally, for me of course.

So... its very cool and it works well... when it works that is. it doesn't work often after launching the game a second or more times. it is a very common and app breaking issue that makes the game completely unplayable. the screen flahes and crashes, or the screen goes black and crashes there isnt much in between looking at someone and shooting then crashing. this is an issue that needs to be fixed. once it is resolved it will be spectacular.

I don't like the fact that players are limited to only 2 loadout classes for quite a while, or that guns are unlocked via battlepass. The game has great graphics, great controls, and good concept on what a Call Of Duty game is, but there are a few things that just stick out from other COD games which throw some of us off, but also take quite a bit of time to get used to and progress forward

You know I would've never thought black ops 2 would come to mobile devices. The graphics aren't bad or blurry. Emerging runs smooth on my device. Obviously the controls are bunched together but you kind of have too on a phone. It would be cool to hook up a Bluetooth controller though. Nice game I can play while at work when I don't have my console. Keep up the good work. Just waiting on zombies mode now

Surprised, to say the least! I didn't expect as smooth of an experience with a mobile fps, and other than the lack of physical buttons causing the controls to be sloppy it's like playing on console with lower quality graphics. Load times are smooth. I've only experienced lagging when service wasn't very good. I figured battle royale would be a nightmare, but it handles the amount of action that happens like a beast!

Awesome! Great gameplay, very addictive. The interface is a bit confusing at first, but you'll get the gist of it pretty quickly after playing a few rounds. My only gripe is that the movement controls sometimes lag or don't register. I also tend to aim for the head and it works well. And then I get killed and the kill cam shows enemy sniper shooting me in the leg and killing me instantly. That's a but frustrating :)

It has to separate the PC from the phone aspect because the PC has way more advantage over the phone. I remember not even shooting yet and the guy had already shot me numerous amounts of times because of the reaction of the mouse on a PC is faster than the buttons on the phone. I think hey should be separated into 2 separate categories because of the unfairness between the two of them. Other than that, I think the app is really great. Just had one issue with it!

Since Black Ops 1 and 2 arent remastered for PS4, I havent been able to play them. This game is actually really nostalgic for me, and also really fun to play. My phone is about the same size as a PS3 controller, luckily enough. The maps are just great, the game is fantastic.. My internet is bad, so it is a pain to last through a good few matches, but I guess it's not the games fault.

Amazing, well rounded game! As long as you have a decent phone, and good connection, you won't have lag or dropped game problems that some people have mentioned. The game play is exciting and consistently getting better. If anything were to be changed for multiplayer, I'd hope that they release a lot more maps and put a separate button for knifing instead of switching to it when you get close to someone. Lastly, for the Zombie gameplay, it would be great if there was a more challenging mission.

The game is very fun and challenging. The game hangs in br on occasion. Generally you can reconnect to the game, but sometimes you will not have coms with teammates and other times you won't be able to see teammates on the map. This is extremely frustrating, especially when trying to grind out ranked levels, or towards the final circle, then boom game froze. You pray you can reconnect before the zone kills you or someone else does.

Amazing experience. Feels almost like the PC version. Very smooth graphics and controls. One critisism I have is that the maps are unnecassarily small. Like the barriers lead into sections that are unaccessible. I get confused sometimes because I think I can go to a certain part of a map, but the map's boundaries are too small. Maybe they'll expand the maps, I have no idea.

I upgraded my phone with an SD card, as well as getting a hardware upgrade with my phone. Even with the worst of internet, this game is playable, and has classic maps, as well as new ones with every single game mode you've played on a console Call of Duty. I would like to adjust the placement of the fire buttons though pre-match, as my thumbs continuously miss the spot on the screen where they are. Otherwise, great mobile port of the Call of Duty franchise in a neat little package. Well Done!

I downloaded this game because I heard the graphics were very good, and they are! The only thing is the app crashes and closes itself every time I click the "loadout" button after completing the tutorial. I have reinstalled several times in hopes it will fix itself but to no avail. So I've never actually gotten to play the game, but the graphics raise it's score to two stars.

Game play great but plenty of glitches to tick you off. There are so many good things about this game that keeps me coming back we all come back for close to the same reasons. The bad mics don't always work regardless of what you do. Playback shows you screwing off, even if emptying a clip in the enemy in front of you, but shows you shooting off in another direction. Loop running/Loop skipping; game makes you run through the same here in a loop either forward or backwards.

After a couple of recent updates the game has become very hard and heavy. The fluid movement is gone. It feels like a struggle, both in mobile and emulator. It feels like the characters carry a lot of burden. I have tried several settings, even putting my setting into the lowest except the framerate to the max, but yet it doesn't work. I run the game in a decent setup with core i5 and external graphics card of 2GB memory and 20 GB of RAM, and guess what, still it's a struggle.

This is, without a doubt, the best fsp by far. You can actually advance without having to spend a dime, believe it. Complete control of your button layout, lots of setting. Cod mobile has a really tunable interface with lots of options that are relatively easy to adjust. The firing controls used to be amazing, they are still good but the original way was better. It's a great game! The only part of the game that could you an improvement would be a more interactive environment. More real.

Great experience for a mobile platform! This has become a must game as long as it keeps playable for my phone. There are too many buttons at the beginning but after playing it for days (I stopped working and eating) it's easier I just needed to adapt my fingers. I tried to use a Xbox 360 wired controller but it didn't work. I might buy a Bluetooth controller on Amazon or something like that. But it would be nice if you say the best compatible controllers. I feel it confusing with many gifts etc

Great game! The graphics and game play are awesome. However, at times it glitches starting you off halfway through a match, or freezing everything then comes back with you're dead. Another thing that would be nice is matching people not just on their COD level, but on their equipment too. I'm a decent player, but it's not fun when somebody can kill you with 2 bullets, but I need to empty my clip into them.

Great game. Such fun. Really recommend it. Has a game mode for everyone and there is a definite good feel about the game. I love it and can't stop playing... The only issue with the game for me is that low end androids can only access the lower graphics settings so it is a bit of a downfall. I have also recently noticed that the game struggles to connect to WiFi and I disconnect quite a bit (not loads but more than I'm comfortable with)

Very good experience for a mobile game. Varied selection of maps from throughout COD history & different game modes to keep things interesting. Most notable issue is the 'black screen of death' where screen goes dark. Though you remain in game, you cannot control your character at all and will most likely die. Most often encountered in the Battle Royale mode. Otherwise the game is fun & doesn't require long wait times for matches. A mixed bag mode with different game types should be considered.

The mobile experience for this game is actually easier and more enjoyable than I thought but there is definitely a bunch of calibration issues with the aiming and the shooting. I found myself in multiple matches aiming at an enemy on the advanced settings and it doesn't even shoot and when I'm looking around over start randomly shooting but it's not enough to take me out of the gaming experience but it is something that does need to be addressed. Overall it's fun

If this game even costed money, I would buy it in a heart beat. On its own it's just a shooter, but the leveling up, battle pass, and rewards are constantly given to a point to make you get in and stay in without getting bored. Only the best characters, maps, and guns made it to this game from the others in the series. The controls are fluent, customization options are large but not overwhelming, and match making is always less than a minute. Good job tencent, you made a great game.

I have been playing since the release and I love it. Graphics are amazing even for phones that aren't as upgraded for gaming. Controls are extensive and easily understood, as well as setting. There's been bugs and cheaters of course, as with most good multiplayer games worth anything, it's a given. The options to win skins, guns, and etc are easily attainable if you put in the time. I wish they'd bring back the zombies that are more like console versions are, but they'll do. Recommended.

Great game. My main gripe is that those who spend real money on upgrades seem to be able to run quicker in game, which gives them an unfair advantage. It's also unfair that a game designed for mobiles allows you to use a controller so some players have a huge movement advantage and can jump and spin and move while shooting while the rest of us are hindered using touch screen controls

I love the call of duty franchise. I played on Xbox quite frequently until it unfortunately broke. Playing all the way up until WWII and I am in love with the mobile experience. I cannot wait for zombies and the great things in store. Yes the game may lag at times but it isn't too bad. I love the fully customizable UI and the overall fine tune I can put into my controls and settings. I would and still do recommend this game to all my friends. Always trying to get more soldiers on my roster.

The game overall is amazing. A change that could be made is that you should be able to connect through your google games account. The controls are great once you get use to them. The graphics for a phone game are amazing. The game so far isn't pay to win. I hope to see how zombie mode turns out. Also for the future zombies release, make sure it's a 3 or 4 swipe down because remember it is a phone game. We can't be as good on here as we are on console.

Brilliant game. Love it to bits. I am definitely addicted. I have to play at least once in the day. I love all the game features and modes. Only thing is though after playing it for a while I feel Battle Royal needs a new map. One should be able to choose the map as well. Also for featured games as well we should be allowed to pick our maps. Somethings I get the same map 5 times in a row and that's really annoying especially if it is a map you don't like.

The gameplay itself is a 5-star experience. Really fun/balanced play with friends, and a year ago, I would have put 5-stars for this game. For me, the problem lies with the menu (especially if you redownload the game). There are menus within menus within menus that need to download content as you go. Also, you are constantly bombarded with pop-ups as new updates are launched. It is just no longer an easy pick-up-and-play kind of game, so everytime I redownload, I never get past the main menu.

Worked great at first...but not so much now Samsung Galaxy S10+ The game starts, I start running and suddenly, I'm 20 feet back where I was prior, then back to where I was before I "jumped". It just goes back amd forth. I can't navigate the maps now which renders this "unplayable" for the time being. Giving it 3 stars because day 1....it was AWESOME! Graphics and controls are markedly better than a lot of other games out there. I hope Activision fixes this bug because I absolutely love this game.

Insane level of setting customizations, well optimized, great nostalgic COD feel, and good graphics. Overall a good and fun game. Too bad the buttons aren't that responsive, in the heat of the moment you need to reload with one of your guns so try switching and you have to hit the button multiple times for it to actually work. Plus, there are times when you go to use movement joystick and actually moves your camera angle instead.

If you like call of duty, this is the mobile game for you. It's the gameplay of the console but in your hands. The controls are easy to adjust to and its not hard to level up. I've been dealing with a force close bug lately though. If the app developers can get that and the amount of storage it takes to fully enjoy the game, I would rate 5/5 ⭐ all day!

This is a great game with excellent graphics. I do wish it had slightly better decals for things like the grass, and an increased resolution for textures. Please cater for higher end devices! You can use both a PS4 and Xbox controller via Bluetooth (second-gen Dualshock 4) which is really nice. I would like a much cleaner main menu interface, since I don't really care about all of the offers and microtransactions. Anyways, I really enjoy playing the game!

For an online shooter, this isn't that bad. I was expecting with terrible controls, graphics, etc. It wasn't. Now, I'm not a shooter fan for mobile, but this one I'll probably play when I'm on the go when I don't have Apex for Xbox or PC to play. Why try this out? It's interesting, good challenge, there are about 4 or 5 maps that you can choose from. There are customizable weapons and attachments. And if course there is a battle royale feature and some of the popular game modes.

Honestly it's a better FPS in the app store compared to most. And it's fun, as long as you ignore the lag. The issue with hackers is a problem. And why hasn't the graphics been upgraded yet? You can only use a low setting and it's messing things up. Would be nice if you could earn the second type of currency for free through some sort of challenge but i doubt that will ever happen.

It's ok for what it is. I like the fact that there's modern guns on all types of different maps and that it's basically a full fledged call of duty on the go. It is however filled with problems, ironically enough unlike the console versions it has nothing to do with time to kill or anything of that nature, instead there's just a bunch of bugs that a lot of other mobile games have, the main one is that the sound never stays on for me since my second game I played. All in all it's ok, not great...

Overall is excellent, just as good as playing on a console! Probably the best FPS app you can have on your phone. Only a few gripes. Needs more maps, especially some of the classic popular ones such as Sideshow and Ruins. Give us a campaign mode! Also takes up too much storage space. Still crashes too often. And we should have the option to later get any skins we want, and exchange skins we don't want with new ones.

Was registered since forever and after all this time... They Nailed it! This is unlike any mobile game I've played. Fast paced, easy controls, and maps that take me back to the classic console experience. Enjoy the customization of guns, the controls (they've allowed for the user to fit what's comfortable to them) and different modes available. The king of shooting games is back...and this time it's available on the go. Must play! Get on it now!

It's not fair that I have to lose to players who are higher ranking than I am and deduct points. In Scrapyard it is hard to shoot out the windows with the window tiles. They literally get in the way of the bullets when aiming at the enemy. And another thing, The game keeps glitching. It keeps pushing me back to where I was standing previously. In Zombies, I get stuck in the floor and then I'm not able to move. I then die. In Battle Royale my vehicle controls keep getting reset. Please fix it!

I've spent a lot of time playing this and have for the most part enjoyed it. The mechanics work well, the gameplay is smooth and it looks good. Ive docked it a star though because the prices of the microtransactions are ridiculous. I usually like to support a dev and make a couple of purchases if I've played a game for any length of time. But the price of a season pass is something like £25. Considering that the season changes every 6 weeks this is mental.

I have been playing since the release, and it's great! But there are several issues. The connection is super slow and laggy, especially when I have full bars on my WiFi. This should not be happening. I hate how the characters are pay-to-win, and all of the guns are as well. But, seriously. Bring back the console like Zombies. The new version is super laggy. I can't even finish the Nightmare mode so I can get completionist camos. Other than that, it's a pretty great game.

So, I have played this game for years. I played almost everyday for years straight. It has changed a lot since the beginning, but it's not bad. Gaming experience is good, you can chat, make friends, in-voice games. Guns and skins and all that jazz is good. Still coming out with new and cool guns. Downfall is there are a lot of bots in BR and MP, which sucks. It's easier, but we want a challenge right! It lags a lot now too, a lot of storage space taken up, per the norm. Get it tho, no regrets.

Awesome as hell game! Just a few minor issues, but otherwise it's an awesome gaming experience, that I would HIGHLY recommend you download NOW!!! The only reason it doesn't get a full 5 stars from me, is that it glitches constantly for me, in the middle of matches, and especially every time I try to play Battle Royal mode... It will suddenly disconnect from the network, and crash my phone, so that I have to log back in, and continue from whatever point I died at.

The nostalgia hits in all the right spots. The graphics are great, controls are a little problematic at times, the knifing is a little weird in a close quarters situation, but overall it's impressive. I'm having the problem of loading the game, but there's no loading indication whatsoever. It just stays on the Call of Duty intro screen. I wait a few minutes or I'll restart the game and nothing changes. There's times where it'll work, but for the most part it's the same thing over and over again.

Downloaded it. Got to lvl 7. Jumped into a Battle Royale match. After 5mins into the match the game crashes and now it will not open at all. It loads the publisher/developer splash screen then crashes to the home screen every single time. I can't play at all. Fix this! *EDIT* Nope. It's not the graphics settings. Could be memory, but whatever it is it's highly annoying having to clear storage every time I want to play!

I really appreciate the ability to adjust button size, placement, and opacity. I feel as if MOST issues I face with the game can be solved by tweaking those. Sometimes the connectivity isn't the greatest, I'd almost prefer it to not ALLOW me or other players to connect if we don't have a good enough connection. Granted, some people don't have WiFi access, and don't have 4g speeds, I think it would make the game as a whole more enjoyable, though slightly less accessible.

It's actually a pretty solid gameplay. Graphics are a bit low, but its understandable, is a mobile game and in order for it to run as smoothly as it does, we cant expect much more. Controls are good, my only issue is that sometimes I shoot by accident, while aiming (I shoot manually). Too many controls on right side. If I don't shoot, I crouch or jump and it gets annoying, but overall, the game is a pretty good experience, definitely worth giving it a try. Have a good day. Thanks for reading.

CoDM is a great game. Lots of characters, gun skins, maps, and game modes. It is also not a pay to win game although I would recommend investing some money. However, the reason I rated it 3 stars was because it takes up a TON of space and memory on my phone. It also lags when I am playing and occasionally the screen will just go black. I do have a low budget phone though. Overall, I would definitely recommend this game to anyone that has a good phone.

Not that this changes anything but i figured I'd speak my piece. The game is great, full of good content and great competitive fun. The downfall however is so frustrating it makes the game hard to play. The freezing and server connections are so ample that the game is ruined. I will die before even seeing the enemy draw the corner. I freeze and die when trying to gain kill streak or win the game. It's almost unbearable and reporting a bug solves nothing, like the company doesn't care.

This is by far one of the best f2p action game on the play store. My only reason for giving 4 stars is that with every new season you have to redownload everything! It's really annoying and unnecessary. Please fix the lagg and desynchronization issue. Also offer a "lite" version (just the basic skins) of the game for those who don't have high end devices. Thanks for the awesome work and the enormous amount of effort you have put into this game. You guys are amazing!

Game is ok-ish in my opinion. The controls need to be adjusted first as at least for me was impossible to play like default. There also seem to be a sort of laggy on the inputs and they also feel really "clumsy" and kind a hard to move and aim... Not to smooth... The best part is indeed the graphics, they did a really good job with the visual details

After playing for a while I've grown to like this game. But one major problem for my experience would be the controls. I'm not sure if anyone experiences this, but often my normal sensitivity would go from fast-paced to an extremely slow and smooth sensitivity. When this would happen, not only is it extremely slow but it's unresponsive when I try to press the shoot button or even when I'm trying to run. I guess the controls are quite buggy. It kinda ruins my playing experience tbh..

This is simply the best game I have ever played. Perfect graphics, perfect transitions, modern weapons. Only two issues: 1. The music when the player is not in a match is boring after a while. Borrow a leaf from Euro Truck Simulator and allow players to add their own music. 2. It is extremely difficult to get CP. Please have it possible to even get a few at a time as rewards.

Quite a good game overall, but I've got a few complaints. The br maps feel a little barren in some places. The game keeps crashing on me every time I open br, and having downloaded more maps, the same is happening for search and destroy and frontline. It's very difficult for my device to stay connected, and I don't know whether or not this is a client end issue. If you've got the phone space and dont mind the occasional crash, give it a try.

So the game was getting a bit stale, it was lacking depth but since the new s9 update the game has gone from 1 to 100. It's so much more interesting! Battle royale is interesting now, although it could do with a new map and not just things added to the existing one. It still runs very smooth on budget handsets (2 GB ram) with a good internet connection. I'm very impressed with the direction thois game is going, it gets better and better.

Great game, great time-comsumer if you ask me. I was able to play non-stop during the weekends and would do so until I find it boring --to which will not be happening anytime soon. Overall, the gameplay is pretty smooth but it lags everytime I get a notification. I would like to patched, but the solution is easy but bothersome. Again, great game. Would love to see new gamemodes and weapons.

Good; but not great. So, i love this app, I love call of duty in general, having grown up playing non-competitive and competitive call of duty, I can with confidence say, this game is a blast, from the nostalgia of the franchise, to the little things! But, I do have one major issue, the controls. I believe this game needs definitions and little help tools defining each of the settings options, brief explanations of what each setting does to the game. This would really help the community! <3

Since the last update, I have been having CONSTANT issues with my audio. It's constantly getting warped, gets super quiet or even goes out all together. The issues are 100 times worse while playing zombies. Aside from that, I am always fighting against my own aim reticle. As soon as I start to fire, it drift to the side by itself. This makes fighting the boss monster near impossible to do. The game is fun but not being able to hear and fighting to aim right is dampening the experience a lot!!!

I never thought I'll play call of duty because I couldn't pay for it and I always looked back at people who were able to play it, but when I saw call of duty mobile was FREE! I instantly fell in love. The controls are easy to master, the graphics are great, and it keeps you entertained with events and updates. But I seen I glitch that let players shoot through the top of a wall so please fix this.

Almost everything about this game is great the controller's takes a little getting used to due to the fact that the reload button is right next to the fire button you find yourself reloading when you really trying to fire from time to time other than that everything about this game is entertaining fun good way to pass the time very engaging the graphic is beautiful the seamless gameplay is awesome. So far I have no regrets of downloading this game.

As a long-time Call of Duty fan and a well experience mobile fps player, I can say that this game is phenomenal, but there are a few things that would make this game much better and feel more like an actual CoD experience. There is a slight delay when turning/aiming with the screen which interferes with precise shots. Trying to fire at an enemy from close range is pretty great, but when the enemy is medium/long range it just becomes a joke. I have more to say but I've reached max characters.

The experience that I had with this game was good I feel that as a call of duty player that it is a good mobile adaptation to the game. I never thought I'd see ruin on rust or any of the other iconic maps. Yes I have experienced some lag spikes and frame drops but it's nothing that can't get fixed. I hope to see a return of zombies soon. Otherwise 4/5

Fast and fun gameplay. Smooth graphics. Lots of fun for COD fans. Multiplayer has many options. Battle Royale is chaotic but with a large map and multiple drop areas, there are many options to choose from for your style of gameplay. Close up battles and sniper battles make the gameplay a diverse experience. Edit:dropped from 5 stars to 4 stars. The lagging issue is getting insane. Seems to lag out or lose connection to the server a lot more than it used to and I have been playing since the BETA!

You know what? I misjudged this game. It's actually really good but it just doesn't work on all devices. It's really cool but i was looking forward to playing zombies mode to find out that it was removed, I'm currently updating the game now, so i hope it's back. It would also be cool if you could pick different versions of maps. There could be a third tab when choosing gamemodes that says "version" and it'll show the different versions of the map if It's available. Maps like nuketown, you know?

The controls are tight and the gameplay has near to no frame rate problems. The only downside I'd say is the button for firing is a but of a bugger to hit if you're panicking/adrenaline fueled but that's really a problem on my end. Only thing I can think to fix this would be to do something similar with the changing the position of the firing button like with the movement button but within a smaller radius. In the end I'm loving the game!!

Um... Personally I dont think the game is bad. The Multiplayer mode is actually decent and pretty fun to play! But the battle royale mode is not that good. The only downside of this game is that its too buggy! I cant get through the first loading screens most of the times and sometimes when I do, i get reconnecting server errors! This is really frustrating!

The game looks and plays well. Some of the controls will mess up from time to time, find setting that are comfortable. Graphics are great, gameplay is great, plenty o maps and modes, no advertising, download and play!The few things I have issues with, lag or net code is a big issue, snipers hit boxes are massive, weapon stats dont match in game play. Need anti-cheat sw. This game is really fun, despite the issue, and they do not happen every game.

Call of duty mobile is a game where you can play battle royale with multiplayer features. There's one bug that kept on bothering me as that I cannot see the other players character they have chosen. They have been seen as a default character. This is the issue I have. The update is good. Gameplay is smooth with a few glitches now and then but yeah. Controls are simple and easy. Graphics are up to standard too but otherwise i Rate it 5/5.

Almost perfect... Only issue is that it fires automatically when it's aimed at the enemy.. Instead of manually shooting the enemy. Kind of defeats the purpose of having any skills to a game. Sure you can move around but that's stupid how they make it "Easier" for you. Issue, sometimes behind a fence or something it doesn't detect the enemy and doesn't shoot. Critical ops is a good example of good skills required (manually shooting). Check that game out.. Btw this game has awesome graphics..

I havent played the zombie part yet. Although I think the creators should bring it back. Edit: As for the game it's amazing. I love it. I've been playing it for over a year faithfully. It's not pay to win, but you can still buy some cool stuff. The only issues are glitching in battle royale and the constant upgrade of space in phone storage

It's a brilliant game and takes me back to some of the old school maps which is quite nostalgic. It is very easy though, I'm coming in top position nearly all my matches and it's kinda boring when you win over 85% of matches but that is down to the other players, not the developers. I did run into a slight issue while playing BR mode. When in ADS, the scope was off centre massively but swapping weapons sorted this issue out straight away. Just waiting on the Zombies game mode now, hopefully soon!

It's a great game. I gave it 3 stars because I have perfect interntet, but I still get disconected. The FPS is beautifull! It has an awesome map, and it has great mechanics and movement. Another reason I gave it 3 stars, is because the PS4 Controller doesn't work, and it has the wrong buttons. But the game is great, and I think the Battle Royale Mode is stupidly awesome! (Please fix the PS4 Controller buttons)

Downloaded this expecting to be disappointed if I'm honest, fairly big fan of CoD for a few years I was expecting it to be the usual half arsed mobile version. I was wrong - the graphics are excellent (for a phone), the gameplay is as good as ever, the only slight downside is the controls are a bit awkward. Nobodies fault as such, damn near impossible to get a phone to behave like a controller I imagine, more a limitation of the device. Excellent work everyone involved, genuinely impressed!

Great mobile version of the console classic, as good as you can ask for a free game. My only concern is the controller support, you would think a title coming straight from console would have console-controller support out of the box, but it feels very rudimentary and lacks much refinement. Mainly, the sensitivity settings are horrible, to me. Having to manage 3 different sensitivities, without an option to sync between them, and having an X/Y setting for each scope distance as well

Great.... when it works. This recent update is REALLY buggy. Freezes on startup, freezes opening the "loadout", freezes starting a game, freezes at the end of a game, (mostly in zombies) .... you get the idea. I've loved playing, but I'm so tired of force closing every few minutes, and relaunching the game, just to do it again, a few minutes later.

Needs a few touches on the fire and aim controls. I use a "claw" style grip and it tends to glitch out when I'm using two or three fingers at the same time. I know 100% this isn't error on my side. Maybe add an option to put a static second joystick for looking controls? Also if there weren't so many popups all over my screen on startup it'd be quicker to get a game queued up. Great game otherwise and I can't wait for zombies.

Sure, it does play well on mobile devices and controls well. However, after playing it for five days, it has gotten insanely boring and repetitive. Sure, it's okay, but there just isn't nearly enough to it to keep me interested. Very few maps, and the battle royale mode has way too many bots (or people playing as poorly as bots) to keep me coming back. Pros: controls, graphics. Cons: few maps, few collectibles (aside from cosmetics that don't interest me), and too many bots throughout the game.

Been playing about 2 weeks now, and I can't stop! It's such a fun time killer when your on the road or late night and don't want to use a PC. Would Highly recommend. Only issue I have is the in ability to customize where the buttons are on the screen. I'd like to be able to adjust them for my self as the preset I a little too close for my liking

I have played this since its release. I like the dynamics of options and variables for gameplay. Lots of customizations. The old zombies was the best by far though. The new versions of zombies and the story lines are trash. They try too hard to make it a story. Just bring back the waves and old style with a final boss. It would be more fun if tanks could be stolen from other players while they were in it. The jets have little purpose. Either build a full war game or focus on tactical skirmishes

Best online shooter period!! Tons of modes and unlockables. Fun and fast action. I would have given it a perfect score but when you connect a controller the game play gets iffy. Sometimes it plays perfectly but most of the time it's glitchy, lags and drifts out control and won't go in the intended direction. I use a brand new Xbox One controller and get this issue.

Perfect controls that can be tuned to your exact specifications, top tier graphics that won't overheat your phone (and can be turned up and down if necessary,) immersive sound with or without headphones, and the really well done and satisfying character progression I always loved about Call of Duty Modern Warfare & CODMW2. It's the perfect package, lots of different game modes to choose from as well! The only issue I have is the ads that pop up, but they keep the servers running so it's all good!

Fun enough to waste a bit of time on, but I found myself uninstalling it before long. Repetitive maps, hectic game modes, and a pay to win feel tends to drag it down as you progress. It doesn't matter how hard you grind, you're still gonna get shot by the guy willing to drop thirty bucks on virtual guns. Kinda takes the fun out of casual gaming. Or maybe I'm just cheap. Surprisingly, the connectivity is better than the new Modern Warfare, with less lag and teleporting than you get on console.

I rate it 5 🌟 because, 1. "Exceptional gameplay that keeps you hooked from start to finish." 2. "Impressive graphics that enhance the overall gaming experience." 3. "Diverse multiplayer modes providing endless entertainment." 4. "Engaging storyline with memorable characters." 5. "Seamless controls and smooth gameplay mechanics." 6. "A must-play for both solo and multiplayer enthusiasts."

Honestly I expected this game to be bad, but it's almost great!! The graphics, gameplay and over interface to me is good. I don't like skipping 6 advertisements each launch of the game. I also don't enjoy the left hand controls. I hope in later versions you can remap your controls. PLEASE DO NOT ALLOW CONTROLLERS. We don't need any uneven playing field. This is a new interface, GET GOOD. Finally, I really hope they can throw it back with some old mw2 (possibly the expansion maps) on mobile.

A lot of times in any mode, it won't register that I click FIRE so I end up getting killed and throwing my phone. While in Battle Royale, it will glitch bad forcing me to close the game and reopen it. After opening it, it asks to reconnect to the game and when I click yes it will give me a voice chat connection failure so I can't talk to or hear my teammates. Those are the biggest bugs that I have noticed and after they're fixed I think it will be enjoyable. Easier with a controller.

This is a great game. With great looking maps especially for a mobile game. The controls feel smooth and there's lots of guns and loudouts. But there could be improvment, first, we need sliding to be fixed. Instead of feeling like you're sliding you feel like you're sticking to the ground and moving. zombies mode needs to be added back, but with more content. If you bring back zombies with more perks and maps. Zombies could be way bigger.

Been playing since the game started and love it! As someone who's been playing the game the whole time I can say I have no problems with this game except for rendering distance, in br (battle Royale) I always have problems with getting shot at by some player out in a field and I can't see him so if there was an option to change rendering distance added in that'd be greatly appreciated!

It's a good game, it has different modes of play for different players. Battle Royale is more slow and Multiplayer is fast-paced. Recently, I encountered an error in the lucky draw milestones. I clicked to claim them and all of them showed blank space where the amount of points would show. I never received any points and my points stayed the same. Now I can't claim them again since it says they've already been collected. Hope there's a fix for this.

Multiplayer runs great and is fun to play! Battle royale is really rough around the edges, it crashes at least once a game and I thought it was just me but other players reported the same problem. It didn't bother me much until it became the reason I died a few times. It gets a little annoying. Other than that its a solid CoD game and I can't wait for zombies!

It's a wonderful game all round and the multiplayer is really my favourite. But i think in the "Hard point" game in the multiplayer, in all the maps, the hardpoints follow a specified flow or pattern, and once studied, it makes it easy for a player to detect the next hardpoint without strive and i think this shouldnt be, we all should be naive about the Hardpoint's location. I hope this is looked into. Besides that, i love this game so much

Runs surprisingly well for a mobile game. Has decent controls, aside from the overly complicated knifing mechanic, and the complete inability to hip fire. My main problem is the game having more microtransactions than maps. Or guns, if we really go for it. Seriously, I am COMPLETELY unable to get into a match without 10~ popups purchases that I gave to dismiss first, which also lags out the main menu quite a bit. Otherwise, it's a good game to play in your downtime.

I was blown away from day 1 of install. Once you get used to the controls it is amazing. Speaking of controls however...after playing for about a year now, I noticed that in simple aim mode...you cannot target lock enemies in prone. Also, supply crate smoke masks targeting capabilities.
