And even in advanced aiming mode, you cannot knife an enemy who is prone very easily. I've managed a couple from behind after several attempts and a couple while running rambo style but needs work.

I LITERALLY LOVE THIS GAME! The quality is AMAZING, the graphics are GREAT, the controls are easy to use, AND IT'S JUST AMAZING! The idea is great, the revival sequence idea is cool, and there is NOTHING NOT TO LOVE and NOTHING WRONG WITH IT! NO ADS EITHER! I would say sometimes it is a little sad when you cant be the jump leader because you are not first in, when you would've been first in if your connection was a little bit more stable, but I don't really mind it because, as I've said, SUPER!!

Possibly the best cod in 5 years. It runs good enough even on a cheap phone like my A10, the graphics are amazing, the gameplay is fun and the multiplayer works fine. It's annoying that every time you open the game, there are like 5 popups to close asking you to buy the stupid battle pass. The main problem, I think, is the reload time/animation, it doesn't feel like COD standard, takes too long to reload, sometimes the animation is already done but the ammo doesn't add up.

Great game, great features. Plays like a full-fledged CoD entry. My only two issues is that popular game modes like gun game and free-for-all are not available at all times. These are a staple of the franchise and seem to be expected. My other issue is that Battle Royale seems to crash a lot, in the middle of matches. To be more clear. I'm using a Stylo 4 and BR is basically unplayable. Again; fantastically designed game. Applaud the effort put forth not to force me to purchase anything. Thanks!

Very good graphics, gameplay elements and multiplayer features. Players can still enjoy the game without paying any money. Overall a nice game. The only issues I notice are lagging in certain gameplay modes and problems with installing and starting the game. It would have been better to develop a more streamlined, efficient update service.

Good, smooth gameplay, but I'll give 5 stars when controller support will work. Right now, with the PS4 controller, it's not working. It detects the controller, but the buttons aren't working Edit: PS4 controller is now detected and works better, but it's still far from perfect. Sprinting is not working and you have a big delay while using it, making the game unplayable with a controller.

Fix BATTLE ROYAL!!! JUST DO IT!!! I literally can't play a full game without it crashing three times or more per game. I love playing that game mode. It needs a better server or something to hold the amount of info for each player. There needs to be a zombie mode BTW C.O.D always had one. Multiplayer mode has no hick-ups that I've noticed. Solid on that one.There needs to be more customization for troops, weapons and contracts for in game currency.

So....I'm not able to download the update. Uninstalled and am trying to reinstall, but it quits in the middle of it. I know my Note 10+ is compatible and I don't have anything else downloaded on it. Otherwise, I was absolutely addicted before all of this happened. Edit: 4/26/20 ^^That has happened twice. More recently though, the mics don't work 2/3 of the time and the game freezes or kicks me out to title screen every single game.

The basic controls feel too clunky. COD is originally fast paced and this port doesn't live up to it. It's always a chore to switch weapons or equipment. It's a pain to use all your ammo with your customized gun and not be able to pick up ammo from a gun off the ground, but instead swap guns. This game could really use Bluetooth controller support. I think that would be the key feature to separate this from other mobile shooters. Besides that it's nothing special.

Great game. Controls aren't TERRIBLE but I'm probably going to stop playing if the 3rd party controller setup I'm getting isn't compatible. There are lots of similar games that DO have that support and don't require you to only use an $80 controller from Sony or Microsoft. It's way too hard to intuitively play the game on a phone because you can't tell what button you're pushing on a screen. Every phone is different.

Great game. Best multiplayer first person shooter on mobile, many modes, guns, the full call of duty experience, lots of fun but battle royale could use some optimizing for mid to low end devices. Edit: Latest update brought in great content but with some performance issues; the game lags and freezes for a few seconds in the heat of battle, which ends up costing a lot.

So far, it moves, controls, looks and feels like any other COD game out there. The controls might take some getting used to. Personally I find the "Advanced" controls are a lot better at taken down your opponents then using "Simple" mode. Doesn't seemed to ask for so much net speed like some mobile shooters need. I like that you can't pay to win, only to glamor yourself with colors and design. Only thing to remember that it's a mobile game and earning awards take longer to achieve then normal.

If you like shooters, I'd recommend you to play this great game. One of the best FPS games on mobile. I, myself been playing COD on PC. I seem to perform much better on mobile (idk why). But, there is a bug I would like to be fixed; for some reason, players' model (horizontal axis) is usually looking slightly off compared to where player is actually aiming at (it makes movement look awkward, and a little hard to tell where player is heading at) - and no, it is not ping related issue. Thank you!

Very fun, amazed at the speed of game play and lack of latency, HEAVY microtransactions. However, my main issue is the controls, it is hard to fire while trying to control the direction you are shoot while strafing. Had to move back to simple controls which also has its downs do to about a 1/2-1/4 second delay before shooting. While that can be annoying it has killed enemies running in my line of sight that I would have otherwise missed. That said still fun and spawn campers still suck.

Pubg v2. This game is everything I'd want in a mobile fps. The controls are perfect and every button can be placed wherever you want. There are plenty of different types of matches to choose from including ranked and a battle royal mode. I really like the progression system also, I always feel like I'm unlocking new stuff without paying any money. I am level 60 or so and haven't spent a dollar. You have the choice to watch ads for in-game currency which isn't bad either because they short.

I got to level 38 and soon after the game started to have bugs. I would go into the match, and after the loading screen when it shows you the players from both teams, it got me into the pregame where it said something like "waiting for 1 player". After a few seconds of being alone on the map the game said "Unable to connect to server(5)". It now happens every single game and i tried everything to fix it, but it still has that bug. (I even got penalty for ranked because i "left" the match). Help.

Best game. 10/10. Amazing. And now with the release of zombies, there is something to talk about. The zombies is fantastic. It ranges with a lot of guns, perks, and the additional perks. If I need, I can spend my useless credits to get some money for the box, or a wall weapon. It's very smooth. The whole game in general feels updated. Graphics are better and performance, gameplay, and certainly hitboxes are improved. You guys did a fantastic job. Also, great job on Modern Warfare.

This game is really fun when your playing it on the go or at home. But only one major problem, the game requires no challenge and no skill. What I mean by this is the fact that everyone in this game is easy-to-kill even if they have a high lvl. The graphics are disappointing but the gameplay is really good and provides different game modes like Deathmatch or Search & Destroy and the controls are really easy to master which makes up for the graphics. This game is good but plz add SBMM.

Really fun game, but takes up nearly 4 gigabites of storage, and for people like me with little phone storage, that's a fourth of my storage. It forces you to download so many texture packs, and the game always takes an insanely long time to load. Also there are always constant updates you have to deal with getting or you cant play and they take up more storage. And finally, when you log in every time, you get bombarded with pop up ads for in game purchases. But still 4 stars because it's so fun

Fun game. Very addictive. Looks good and plays pretty smooth. It does need some further optimization for better gameplay and visuals to complete with the quality of PubG, but for a game that just released, this is an amazing effort. My biggest gripe is knife icon replaces the shoot icon when close to an enemy. It leads to unnecessary deaths becaues im forced to knife the enemy. Should be my choice whether to shoot or insta-knife kill. Lastly, sometimes I get stuck on the environment.

Awesome game. There are a few things I'd like to see, though. The loading screen when you're entering a match should be the overview of the map you're about to play like it is in some other COD games. Half the time I can't tell before I've already picked my class. Second, there need to be more options for aesthetics that you can buy with regular in-game currency, because so far there are like 8? Also winning in BR doesn't seem to award that much XP compared to coming in 2nd... or 10th.

I have been having a great time with the game, but my phone can't seem to handle it anymore. I tried to email where it said developer contact but... I was told by an automated email that that was only for notifications. So I'm trying to get ahold of someone for help. Then I'll change the rating to a five star. I've already brought the graphics down, deleted the cache, but still the game crashed. Then your system penalizes me because it thinks I just left the game. Please help. Game is great.

I love the new update, it makes the game 100 times more fun than it already was. Also, please make rapid fire for more maps. So far rapid fire is by far my favorite game type. One issue I noticed is the game can't open if you have a Bluetooth headset connected. You have to disconnect the headset, open the app, and then reconnect. I've tried with multiple different brands of headsets and it happens for all of them.

This is my new favorite fps game on mobile. It plays just like a call of duty game should, with fast and intense gameplay and fun overall combat. However, there is no option for controller support yet. I understand that this is probably for balancing reasons, and not giving people unfair advantages. The touch screen controls are okay and fairly responsive, but I'd prefer to use a controller so I could have something closer to the full cod experience.

Honestly it's as good as I could imagine possible. I don't play many large games on mobile due to touch controls but they tried some interesting ideas with them and it really seems to pay off. Matchmaking is quick, levels and gun progression seems to have depth yet isn't overwhelming. The micro transaction stuff is a lot but nothing too scummy. Love the choice of maps; picking some favorites from past games. Worth a try!

I 100% recommend! The graphics are good, the skins are cool, and overall everything else is good. Allthough, theres this tiny problem, whenever Im in the middle of a game, it kicks me out and when I go back to the app I have to log into my account again. It usually starts off with a black screen. I know its not my internet because its often really good but I dont know. Overall, everything else is good! I hope youbcan fix this tiny bug.

Love this game. A lot of fun and a great way to kill time. Just super annoyed that my Ps4 controller is not working correctly with my game. Entire right housing isn't working. Can't aim at all. Just walk back and forth and it's delayed. With the xbox controller it's slightly better except when I am using the advanced mode. My right stick constantly drifts downwards but is fine when I use the simple mode. Really frustrating.

Have had this game for a week or so and it's been a really enjoyable experience to play CoD again. Zombies and multiplayer have been lots of fun. While battle royal is broken, now when I say it's broken it's not that its "unfair" or anything like that. About half the time I play BR I get a black screen crash during the game and its usually after half the people are eliminated. Now I don't know if it's the game or my phone I use a galaxy s9. Everything but the display works when it happens.

It's pretty fun! A couple campers, but pretty good over all! Maybe a campaign mode would be nice, but I understand that this is a spin off game, so I wouldn't be mad if that never happens. Edit: I've dropped a start due to how this app needs practically all your storage, even though it's a really fun game, you need to delete everything that isn't necessary apps.

Games alright I have a lot of problems with it that won't change ever so I won't list them. I hope the new "bug fixes" includes falling through the field and having an alarm go off at you for it. Also hope the bug fixes include hit boxes being inconsistent.. Kinda weird getting shot around the corner of a building 🤔🤔🤔🤔 also hope they fix dying before you actually spawn on the field. I've been playing for a long time on and off and lately have just been going hard and it's enjoyable

Controls are really good (even though I never jump lol). It also run EXTREMELY smooth, even for my laggy phone. Although the main reason I downloaded it was for zombies, then realized they took it out of the game. I guess the reason they took it out was because "it didn't reach their quality standards." In my opinion, I don't really care if it doesn't reach their quality standards, I would still play it as long as it runs decently smooth. All in all a good game, I recommend it. Good job 👍.

This is a true Call of Duty experience. It is similar to CoD Online (which, I believe, was China-only). It is a remix and greatest hits collection of Call of Duty's past and present with similar movement to Black Ops 2, but with a slide instead of dive. Progression is addictive as always, and it is very possible to play for free without feeling limited. My suggestion: hook up a controller and jump right in!

I've been playing for over a year with no problems. However, since the newest update (season 2 2023), my screen goes black as soon as I encounter an enemy. I can still hear all the action as im being blown away, but the screen is black. It's isolated to COD because other fps games work normally. I removed and re-installed the app. Same problem. Overall it's a great game though, I'm coming back when I upgrade my phone.

It is really really really fun! There is tons of weapons, skins, maps, ect. In general, it is a very good game whether you are just starting or you've been playing for a while. There is a couple of annoying glitches and sometimes the br mode is really laggy though, but I've never gotten a black screen or anything like that. Graphics aren't bad and gameplay is awesome... G r e a t g a m e ...

Thank you SO MUCH for this game! I live paycheck to paycheck and haven't been able to afford a new game system in over 10 years. I have really missed Call of Duty. It is just how I remember but shiny and new and FREE! Controls work well and are very customizable. Most micro transactions are for various skins and emotes, definitely requires a degree of skill, not pay to win. Sometimes there is lag but not often. I never do this but I purchased a bundle to show support for the team! Thanks again!

This game is really fun...it's like a compact, modified version of all of the console CODs. I've played this for a while but just recently there was an update making things much more complicated. Every gun can have like 3-5 different variations for a single upgrade, and way too many options. The menu is cluttered with advertising for buying packs and spending money for guns, and with buttons providing all sorts of different things. I want a simple game. I am sad it has gotten like this.

Can't complain for a free COD game, however, since it just released, it has lots of crashing issues. Especially in the Battle Royale mode, I don't know what it is but that game mode is laggy and it crashes often. If this game could fix their servers and fix the crashing problems then it would be just fine. I do suggest sending them crash feedback so they can figure out what the problem is and how to fix it faster, rather than waiting for them to find out later how to fix it later. Great game! 🔥

Loving the game, the graphics are definetly on par with that of newer console COD games. No, I'm not saying their BO4 or MW level but definetly up there with WWII and MWR. The gameplay is very smooth, no lag issues on higher graphical settings and a great amount of customization for graphics and controls. That doesn't mean this game is perfect by any means, some issues I'd like to see addressed: Controls will randomly not register and I'd like the see more console esq audio options.

Ok, so Call of Duty: Mobile is a great game and all, but it's extremely annoying for the fact that the game requires you to redownload every asset after 2 seasons. The bots are pretty annoying and I feel like they should be removed from the playerbase at a level, like level 30-ish or so. As of everything else, the new season is fairly balanced, great battle pass, so I'd say the season is fine. If you can, I would like an explanation for these things, but if not then it's fine.

I never really thought I'd like any of the COD games, gave one a shot a few years ago and didn't like it. Very glad to say COD Mobile is absolutely incredible. The graphics are like something you'd see on a console (even the lower graphics setting!) and the frame rate is very high and consistent on my Huawei P20 Pro. All of the controls/aiming is simple and fun. The only changes I'd like to see are options to turn the subtitles off, and more graphics settings.

Was good, now it sucks. I have been on it since it came out. They've made some good changes, but they've also made some poor decisions. First, PLEASE BRING BACK ZOMBIES! idc if the devs thought it wasnt good. It was so much fun! Second, give better rewards for things. I can get to level 150 (highest level), and all I get is a gun and a new frame. Some other random things: more female characters, change price of drawing, etc.)

I like the game as an overall game, especially with zombies just released. There are really only 2 issues. The app will freeze and crash during the middle of matches and I get a penalty for it. The graphics in battle royale are bad. If you try to turn them up, it starts to lag really bad. Other than these, it's an amazing game.

Call of Duty: Mobile has the best first-person shooter controls on mobile to date. Sniping is actually functional, without connecting a controller, with hold to zoom and release to fire (which is thanks to the ADS). Unfortunately, there are still MANY kinks to iron out after each update. Respawning has also become worse, with the game spawning you right next to the enemy instead of a location where you won't immediately get gunned down by two other players. Battle Royale also tends to freeze.

It's been many years since I play Call of Duty. Since I've gotten back in the game. I have to say this is pretty damn good. Of course I wonder how they're going to solve the cheating problem if anybody does decide to cheat or use mods? Just rule of thumb. I also wish that you reinstate the striker damage. Thanks

Call of Duty: Mobile (CODM) is a fast-paced, action-packed first-person shooter game that brings the iconic Call of Duty experience to mobile devices. It offers a variety of game modes, including Team Deathmatch, Battle Royale, and Search and Destroy, along with a wide range of customizable weapons and operators. Players can compete in multiplayer matches or dive into the expansive Battle Royale mode, where they battle it out in large-scale, tactical combat across different terrains.

With the economy the way it is, I can't really afford a gaming console, but Call of duty mobile has really came through for people like me. The settings are so customizable, that game play is almost just as legit as the console versions. Especially if you hook up a console controller via Bluetooth. They keep the game updated & it's free! So thankful for this game.

If u have seen COD in any way shape of form buy a console but if u don't have the money then this I the best game possible. There's only one BAD thing about the game and that's the graphics. Not the greatest of all games but what do u expect for a mobile game.

Its great to be able to play a console legend as a phone game, but it come with some draw backs. It consumes a lot of battery power fairly quickly and can over heat your device. So if your not near an outlet you should probably choose another game. most content(aside from playable content) is locked behind microtransactions, but with a cod title if you can reel em in more power to you. I rated 3 stars because of the overheating and high battery consumption issue and due to the pop up "buy me add

Another fps that could be incredible with controller support. Unskippable intro, what if I have played COD since the PS1? I have been skipping them since the launch title that shipped with the xbox 360. Maybe I am just not your target market. Uninstalled it in less time than it took to download. Make this same quality of graphics with a controller and Id pay near console prices to play that on my phone. Two stars vs one as it could be great ok if you like screen controls and forced tutorials.

So far so good. Controls are good, graphics are great, haven't had any instances of lag during playback so far over wifi, once I try network play will see if there is a difference. Haven't decided on if I like the micro transactions yet. I haven't made a purchase yet, but if this becomes a pay to win game like others my rating will drop. UPDATE: No lag on network play. So a bump to 5 stars for now... Still waiting to see if it falls into the pay to win category.

One of the best games available on mobile. To the creators, the game itself is wonderful. Unfortunately certain players dont like to be play by the rules. So if possible, could the developers find a way to eliminate those who are using cheats and assists. Other than that, the game is totally amazing. It would be nice to have a zombie mode with the old school black ops II maps.

It's a must play mobile shooter I think everyone will love. There a two concerns of mine I'd like to bring to the the floor. The TDM is way too fast and I'd like to see the required points to win to be at least 75 for players that are use to the old ways of playing the iconic shooter. Also I'd like to see the skins to become a little more easier to acquire especially for our veteran players other than that the game is one of a kind thanks Activision

Boring after a while, no real innovation, most maps are 10+ years old. Battle royale is the only mode that's actually entertaining. That being said, the battle royale becomes boring too after some time since it hasn't changed much, other than cosmetic changes, it's the same from release. Graphics aren't everything, get some new mechanics and vehicles, the game has been stale for quite a while now.

Fantastic game. I have never played a call of duty title before and I was surprised how enjoyable this game is. Graphics are spectacular and look decent on less powerful devices which is super. There is plenty of in game content with new seasons every month, new weapons, maps, modes, scorestreaks and operator skills. Controls aren't one of the strong points for the game but they're useable which is just so so. Overall this game is fantastic in almost every way and I definitely recommend.

Great visual graphic. Smouth controls, great assortment of weapons, and up grades, the only thing is that not that much of extras, assortment of body armor, headgear! ect. Also it lag when your phone heats up! Everytime a new season comes up! you have to go through the process of down load every arenas, every weapon, accessories, wing suit frag, so forth an so on! By the time you down loaded everything, you used up 3gbs! Everything else I'd recommend to gamers family an friends!

I've played this game on the betas before released so I was excited to finally get it launched in the USA. It feels solid and fluid and if you are really good with a controller you will get used to touch controlls and then its like shooting fish in a barrel. Don't mess with gyro controls. Only use the shoot while aiming stick and dont mess with the second shoot button unless you play claw. just play aggressive and know when you aim you waste some ammo. Trust me it gets easy it just takes time.

Used to be in love with this game mainly for BR. Since the season 8 update, I can't stand to play it anymore. Graphics are totally destroyed, the new health system is the dumbest thing I've ever seen, the overall smoothness has been massively downgraded and the random ping spikes to 200ms on fast and stable wifi is just ridiculous. I've been a player since the very first season but I guess this is the end of my journey.

I love this game, been playing it for a couple months now. I haven't been disappointed. I do wish that all guns were naturally earnable instead of paying for it. Since they are paid for and they do directly affect people's gameplay, than this game falls under the "pay-to-play" category and I wish it didn't. Although the game makes up for that slight disappointment in gameplay, controls, and graphics. It is very satisfying to see a mobile shooter done well and this earns all it's recognition.

Honestly, I'm running it on a oneplus 7 pro so that alone makes the game look amazing, feel amazing, and just overall play amazing. I've seen and played many games like modern strike, however this game is very much so call of duty and aswell as the game being very responsive, no lag, awesome mobile graphics. However on a very rare occasion the game will fight me to open it, it will open and crash but when that happens it is for one second and it happens only very rarely so over all 10/10 5 star

One of the BEST mobile games EVER. Advanced control settings, to me has the game aim and shooting control. Love that I can play Team Deathmatch, Search and Destroy and even Domination. The games load up quick; has never taken more than 10 seconds. Love all the features you see in the actual game: score streaks, UAV is so easy to read. Love it and definitely recommend. Look out for more content on farmhousegaming via INSTAGRAM.

I loved it but its just gone too far downhill. The game has uneven stats in the epic and legendary skins whether the skin has too high or too low stats. As cool as the ASM10 (AN94) is, does it really need to STILL be overpowered? Another problen is that the skins are low effort. The game has been really buggy and the servers are having issues too. I'm so sad to leave the game and I miss it a lot. I will not be returning until the quality returns to the game, which sadly might be never.

I dislike movile games, because i cant feel the buttons but this game has great aim assist which helps with that. Its the only game I've kept on my phone and it's the only one i play. HOWEVER, i would say that the upgrade system for weapons is a bit dumb. You can either use all your XP cards to Max out a weapon, or you can use them 1 by 1 with a notification popping up each time you use just 1. This makes upgrading tedious, if you don't spend actual money on the game

Overall a seriously good game. With zero pay to win which is amazing. Runs great, looks great, and is surprisingly well balanced. How ever I do have a few points for improvement. There is no where near enough customisation available. The weapon upgrade points are useless and pointless (why spend in game currency when I can get all attachments in 4-8 games ) I'm not saying that I dislike the fact you get them so quickly just that the cards used to get them quicker are useless. Controls can be bugy

Considering this is a mobile game. It's a pretty balanced and good game. Though, I wish the game would tell me who are bots and who aren't. And give me the option to opt out of play with bots because these players are too bad. The game gets updates consistently. Like, making camos replace rare variants of weapons. Since they do the same thing. Plus, this prevents players from using a gun you don't unlock until later. I do very much wish they would bring back some variant of the zombies mode.

I use wifi and still lag every game I enter. I looked at support and it said that the problem could be the power saving thing, but I had it off. I've tried everything to get it to stop lagging, but nothing worked. I'm uninstalling until it's fixed. Lag just started, but before hand, it was a great game. It's possibly the recent update

Had my doubts about the game/app but grew to love it, I can see why it took so long to release. I have some issues with battle royal, game crashes time to time. For example I get into vechile/heli game crashes sometimes not constantly. Overall game has a season pass and easy to accomplish, amazing perks, stunning gameplay , feels like you have a call of duty in your hands but no tv or console to go with it .

This game is absolutely amazing and it doesn't get much closer to the real deal, I've been playing this since it first came to mobile and it continues to keep getting better, it does get a little expensive if you want certain players or weapons but that being said you don't have to spend one dollar and you can remain right at the top, this is not a pay to play or win game you do have to buy certain players but I can't complain this game is awesome either way

This is a hardcore shooter games dream...the controls are slightly annoying but the gave is a joy to play. I want to see more options to modify and upgrade weapons without having to spend tons of money doing so. The shooting mechanics, sound and impact are as real as can be my only gripe is the targeting, it's a bit flat and unresponsive when you do a quick tap pro shoot with multiple tangos. I am a hardcore modern combat, and Pubg fan but Call of Duty miles ahead for the core shooter gamer on mobile...downside is you have to purchase a lot of the stuff you need to make the game better

Amazing game. The graphics are good. I would add a suggestion to make an offline mode. It should be like a call of duty Black ops 3 Black ops 4 mode with bots. The Battle Royale and multiplayer modes are really good. Also for the Battle Royale mode you should maybe add a couple of maps like two or three. Besides that the game is amazing the graphics are good. The sound quality is really good too. Can't wait for the zombie mode to come out!!!

It's very fun and easy to play. You don't need to be good at it because of the skill based matchmaking. You can unlock different operators and weapon wraps. in this game there's a battle royale mode and Team Deathmatch mode which is very fun. I highly recommend and good job to the creators definitely one of the best mobile games you can get.

The most fun game I've played. Similar experience to PC/Console. Only one complaint I have to make is sometimes the connectivity gets wanky, running and jerks you back a few frames and constantly does that. It's happened to me 2 times in the past 2 or 3 days I've played. The guest account doesn't go away even if you uninstall and reinstall(even clearing cache) which is good thing in case you lose your account. If this gets fixed id update to 5 stars.

1st of all, it gave me the best gaming experience on Android. Excellent graphics & designs. And, it gave me a good & constant fps on this kind of heavy gaming. I would definitely give it 5 star but, giving it 4 because it uses lots of storage after you download the essential downloads and, character & maps. If it would use little less storage, it would be great to use. The second reason is, sometimes I fail to login. Even after trying for more than 10 times. Please check this guys.

It's amazing! I enjoyed playing this game, but I wish there was a way to earn CP coins and get exclusive skins from the store. Additionally, the new Gunsmith system is cool but it can be worked upon. Instead of levelling up the guns, you can covert the Gunsmith into a store for buying components for guns. Other than that, I thoroughly enjoyed the game and I'd like to thank the creators of CODM for such an awesome game.

Playing this game since January, I've really enjoyed it in the beginning, but since the last update I don't enjoy the game at all. I mainly played BR, the health and armour system is trash, and guys...there are so many cheaters. Just a quick example. Click on leaderboard, BR, kills per match, server, and check those guys out, especially the "legendary" ones. One of them (not going to name him), started playing since this season, and already have on nearly every match 20-30 kills...

Its amazing! Honestly I didn't expect much out of a mobile game, however, this has been my go to game now for over a month! The game plat is great, the graphics are amazing and I couldn't be happier. I do get the occasional freeze in battle royale but luckily I can close put of the app and re open and pick up right where I was. Just kinda annoying sometimes!

Decent game, but definitely has some bugs. Freeze's, glitches all the time while playing. Get killed all the time because my guy will freeze and won't move. Enough already. Just fix the problem. Too busy trying to be better the pubg. Then to pay attention... Pro's... definitely fun. Good guns. Can do alot. Has the power to be better then pubg. Just gotta fix things alittle. Don't like that Season 2 came out and restarted me at rookie. I was elite. Emailed them and heard nothing.

Pretty cool, connections are kinda laggy at times even on the best networks. No matter how many times I disable push notifications in my phone's settings, this game always seems to be able to send them anyway. Also dislike that I have to click through 20 laggy pop ups before I even get to the main menu. Other than that, neat game.

CODM has a larger player base. This means that there are always people to play with, and that you can find matches quickly and easily. CODM is frequently updated. New content is added to the game on a regular basis, including new maps, weapons, and game modes. I really loved the old maps I cried because of the memories on those maps..

This is actually a very fun and enjoyable call of duty app man!! In my opinion the controls are great and simple enough to get used to and the app runs really well for the amount of content the app offered. Great customizing opinions just like in an actual call of duty game on console. It's been well made for a call of duty mobile game app. Most of the games content is from Black Ops 2 with some other COD maps in there to. It's a great app for the small screen I would recommend!!

Honestly for this being new and free it's really good. The gameplay is smooth, the maps are spacious (and Originals from the other CoD games), the weapons have a good variety you can choose from. The only thing i can complain about as of now is the account access, you can either pick a guest account (and hope your data saves) or use a facebook, hopefully down the road they'll add other options (IG, microsoft, google play, etc)

Definitely the best shooter on mobile yet. Controls are fully customizable, and if you have any questions, activision's customer support is excellent. This game does have its downsides, such as the nearly impossible chances on the crates, making you spend 100+ dollars on the advertised skin. Other than that, this game is amazing, and one of the best that I've seen for mobile.

Way to much space for cosmetics and very little bug fixes. You can tell the game has more than a few obvious problems and barely worked on. From the matchmaking, server drops, game modes not working and animation drops its a pain. Even the rules for zombies was changed and now it's even worst than before. This game is to big to be this buggy. Fix it please! This game was so awesome.

Solid adaptation from the console game, good and bad. Heavily dependent on connection which determines the fun factor. The only other factor to contend with is the greediness of Activision with it's in game currencies. There is no way to earn the currency required to purchase attributes that actually make a difference in the game. Cod Credits are easily earnable, but offer access to purchase cosmetic items only.

Fun when it actually works, I recently updated my phone (LG Stylo 4) and now the game no longer opens at all, freezes at the loading screen and crashes. I pretty much avoid Battle Royale because, without fail, the second I land the game freezes, crashes and freezes my phone. I have to force quit the app, reopen and rejoin the game and most times a player already found me and killed me. I was having a lot of fun in multiplayer but since the game no longer opens for me, I had to uninstall.

As good as it gets for mobile gaming. If the controls aren't to your liking the layout is customizable, down to the opacity and size of the buttons. The maps are some of my favorites from multiple versions of the console saga. There are sadly still glitches but they get patched up as they are found within a timely manner, such is the life on any platform. Gun customization is definitely a great updated feature, and there are plenty of in game skins and camos to be as unique as you can be for $.

Great cool yeah but... It's glitchy, lags (expected) I hate the fact that camos & weapons of the same type are separate, and you must also earn attachments separately. Battle Royale crashes every game I play, minus maybe 1. I'd give it 5 stars just if the weapons and camos were fixed and/or the crashing was fixed. Multiplayer works fine it's BR that needs a server update. Great game otherwise👍👍👍

The game is best FPS multiplayer and if not, one of the bests Battle Royale game out there. Controls are amazing, gameplay is amazing and it will run smoothly on almost any device. No bugs, no connection issues and good graphics (could be great depending on your device). Battle Pass and offers are MORE than enough affordable. And no waiting-in-the-lobby problem, it finds match as you click. Lobby is just simple and good, to wrap up, I love everything about this masterpiece.

Id'e say best shooter in the playstore. But gosh, the lack of a real controller factor!!! ; Those who have played similar games, played on consoles which have real controllers.... Screen controllers are problematic and your hands get in the way of the screen. Also there isn't much to hold onto anyhow. Besides that it's a sweet multi player shooter ! Battle field sized teams and maps would be awesome!

I honestly enjoy the game alot, but that is only when it's not lagging and I don't get disconnected from matches. I would enter late into a match, I would be stuck on the loadout selection screen, The game would literally run on 1-5 fps and this can last for almost an entire game, if not then I either get disconnected or the game exits. My device is a Redmi 9A, it's not good enough but the game played smoothly before. I have to create a new account to be able to play the game.

First of all I would like to say Ive been playing this awesome mobile game upon it's release. This game's pretty addicting & strategic. Nonetheless, one problem is that it tends to lag every now & then without prior notice. In most cases, it's a frustrating situation to experience as a gamer when you're in the middle of a match. Hopefully, they can fix these bugs & glitches over with their monthly updates. Nonetheless, it exceeded my expectations for a mobile fps. Update: Call of Duty Stopped

As a person who has been grinding ranked multi-player its quite aggravating. Please fix your gun balancing. It's crude and unfair. Ranked Hardpoint spawns are horrible, they'll spawn on the enemy's side giving them a free chance to camp it. All I'm asking for is gun balancing and helping for a better ranked experience. It's been 3 or 4 days and I've went from a Rookie 1 to a Pro 1, the game is starting to get a little bit un fun now. Fix your dollar tree aim assist. It doesn't even work.

Much like any other Call Of Duty, satisfying short rounds of shooter action. Docked 1 star for the payment model; it isn't "pay to win" as there is still a lot of skill to the gameplay, but it takes a lot of effort to get to certain weapons without a battle pass or buying virtual currency. Luckily, the first two guns - unlocked pretty quickly - are an assault rifle and sniper, which both cater to the two most common play styles. The gyroscope aiming is much more fun to use than default style.

Since the last update, it got very hard to connect to any room. From 10 times I try to connect, 7 times it gives me an error that my connection is not stable, or that the timeout is out, or whatever, and it log me off so I have to enter my credentials once again.. it's very frustrating. Any of this wasn't happening on the previous versions, I can't believe there have been more than 3 weeks since the update and this hasn't been fixed.

Great and I mean a great adaptation of the Call of duty we love being brought to mobile! From classic multiplayer to blackout and soon zombies this almost feels like a console quality game. There are only 2 issues I have from making this a 5 star game. 1. No controller support as of right now. Honestly the main thing keeping me from playing most mobile games (especially shooters). 2. Bots in multiplayer online games. I want to play actual people!

Classical call of duty game. It is probably one of the most annoying call of duty games. You can place online but the amount of campers is frustrating and it seems like your team sucks most of the time. The score limit for game is too low too. Whatever happened to the 75 to 100 score limit. Also the zombies are absolutely TRASH. one zombie map and the boss concept is EXTREMELY stupid. I wouldn't waste my time on this trash. I only give 3 stars for effort. U guys dont deserve 5.

This game is amazing but i have one issue, I don't know if its the game or my internet. But it only happens in BR. I get vompletely disconnected and have to close the game and open it up and half the time i die because of this glitch. Also, please update the damascus on some guns to have more coverage (Mainly locus) and there is a few more. If those 2 were fixed/added it would be 5 stars. It is still an amazing game great job🙂

Its cool for what it is. Graphics are good for phone gaming. The controls are cool in MP matches, but in BR the ADS lags and loses targets sometimes which gets old after awhile. The crates though are so trash. You literally can spend $100 and get the same stuff (normally unwanted items) 5 times!!! Come on man, if we are gonna spend money then let us reap the benifits of it. The aimbots are as annoying as Frans's voice. The ads are starting to get annonying but thats neither here nor there.

I recommend you getting the game! I love the game! Its an amazing game, but I wish you could really fix & add the following: 1. When we are down, I think we should be able to use the first aid kid. 2. It'd be nice if we had more time to get the dogtag. 3. It would also be nice if they added more girl skins.. which leads to number 4. I think I'd be nice if we could get more challenges to win more cool skins or even weapons. •Please and Thank you!

Loving the nostalgia trip this game is giving me, I stopped playing Call Of Duty at black ops 2 so it's been a while but Mobile is a very good recreation of some of my favourite maps. Playing is just as fun and frenetic as I remember it being, this isn't a cash grab, it really is a Call Of Duty game. Level ups and unlocks are not slowed down by the free to play model either. Any FPS player will be able to pick this up and have fun. Solid game.

This game is great..but i was quickly matched with much higher level players. I was level 6 placed with a group of level 40s. This is a new game so i'll chalk it up to ongoing developement. Other than that, the game is outstanding. I smile everytime i level up and all the equipement i unlock is an added bonus. I usually dont play fps' but CODM has everything i love in a RPG with a higher pulse rate. Im hooked. Activision you knocked it clear out of the park!

This is the type of FPS I've been looking for on mobile. It doesn't have weird mechanics, it's not a rail shooter, or some weird turn based card collecting game. You drop into a 5v5 (or battle Royale if that's your thing) and have a classic TDM style match. A great game to kill some time if you like FPS style games with as close to a console feel that your going to get on mobile.

Edit; when i first started the app everything was fine. The only issue i had was with my premium pass which they fixed in a speedy manner. The points where rewarded but wasnt showing up on my side. I didnt stop the transaction or request a refund because they could see it was just a allotment issue. For all of you who might have this problem just wait a day for them to reply to your emails. The team was helpful and the game is running fine. It took only half day for me, maybe a full day for some

An extremely good replication of a mish mash of all the Black Ops games in CoD. I thought PUBG mobile had it good but the controls in this are the best I've seen in a mobile shooter, and I've played many. PUBG mobile's net code was atrocious and you would spend a whole 40 minute game lagging sometimes and that drove me away. I experience lots of desync and lag in this as well, and that's what's keeping it a 4 star, but it's still better then most. Really good game.

Tried to get back into this, I'm almost pro rank in BR and i still haven't come across one single real player. All filled with bots. Absurd. I don't care if i have to wait for five minutes to get into a game, BR isn't fun if every single enemy is a bot with the worst AI I've seen in any game. Same with multiplayer. I'm level 28 and have only ran into ONE other player. You need to add options for players that want a challenge. The game isn't fun or COD when all I play against is target practice.

Really enjoyed the game it is Great. You can have voice chat with other players and make friends. The voice chat is helpful in Battle Royale .Can have issues new update Samsung phone.. Can have errors of downloading part of the patch and take up space 2 GB on the phone until the full patch is installed. Overall really love the game. sometimes spend too much time on it.😀😀😀

Very amazing game, unbelievable graphics and really really lovely guns, some are too expensive but you can still do the trick with the one you're able to afford, however I didn't give 5 stars because of one reason, this game used to be a 3rd person shooter but all of a sudden it reversed to first person shooter and despite all my efforts to change things back to the way they used to be, it wouldn't go back and is really annoying because I prefer 3rd person shooter games than any other!!!

Good evening, The game downloads normally but when the main screen with the 5 characters appear, the game just "pause" itself, and in a couple of seconds after it just say I don't have connection and it would restart. I've tried everything, downloading again the game, re start the cellphone and also, my internet connection but it is problem of the game because my connection is fine. Hope you can fix this soon.

It's a good game, I'm better on mobile than I am console. I've spent money on the game and tbh it's not worth it. I'd give 5 stars but every time I buy a box or something from the event I always get an item I already have and it's annoying and not worth it. And you have to wait 24hrs to join a clan after leaving one! Other than than the game, graphics and the different modes make it a good game.

A great game with very weird choices. We're talking about my favorite gunplay, and FPS concept in all mobile gaming. But by FAR the biggest issue is the bots. I understand how new players need some type of training so adding a few bots as enemies is helping them. But there needs to be a damn limit. COD is popular.. one of the most popular games. Don't just force your players to be against mostly bots. This shouldn't even be a problem.. I wanna have consistent, good enemies/allies. It's so boring

I'm very new to first person shooters on a phone. And black ops 2 is the only FPS I've ever gotten good at. So I might not be reliable reviewer, but this is awesome compared to pubg. That game made no sense and the controls were hard. These controls make so much more sense. Also, it runs cooler than pubg and Madden. On note10+

I had the game a while ago and just got it again, I do like it although it's just to much space, not to mention you have to download even more stuff once you get into the game. It's a bit much don't you think? Just maybe remove something, maybe some maps or the comics, post the comics somewhere else like Twitter. I don't know just know that it's way to much space for a phone.

Good fun. The odds favor one side more than the other during matches. I've had games where I've gotten triple digit kill numbers, and everyone else got single digits. Then I've gotten 2 or 3 kills and others 2 or 3 times more. The ridiculous aspect of the players sliding, bouncing around and wiggling is silly. Don't care for a combat game where skill is based on how well you can mash buttons and manipulate the system. That's what pinball games are for.

Ok so yes there are a few bugs here and there but I mean its a game that has multiplayer and battle royal and soon zombies. Its expected to have a few bugs but honestly I expected more bugs. I've been a COD fan for many years and this is by far the most ambitious move. It runs so much better than PubG mobile. From all the reviews on YouTube I've seen, you can run this on most old phone and internet connection helps but not required. I love it, this is the year to get back into COD.

Great game, Iove playing it, real COD throwback. I don't have a games console, but I have played it many a time at my friends. To be able to play it on mobile and it be very similar to Xbox is really nice and nostalgic in a way. The gameplay is great and the graphics are impressive to. It's an all around great game.

I used to play PUBG, but its same thing, different day. With this, you get battle royale, multiplayer, and with the new update, zombies. It can get boring at times, but that's usually right before the next monthly update. I personally recommend playing on a 5G phone (like a samsung galaxy, iphone, etc.) to get the full experience. I play this on two devices, one being low-end, and the differences are huge. Better phones you can actually see where the bullets go. But either way, i recommend this.

This game is hands down the best mobile FPS on the market. There's a large selection of weapons/attachments to use, and as a player you get a lot of freedom to choose which gamemodes/maps you want to play. What makes this a 4/5 is the predatory monetization. While the monetization for the most part is purely cosmetic, the fact that you have to pay around $150 for certain characters/guns is ridiculous. Players are drawn in by the chance of getting it cheaper, but it's basically just gambling.

Great game, just have issues with 2 things. There's a pretty big latency issue a lot of the time, recommend play with WiFi instead of data, but even then there's an issue with it. It's still fun to play but playing competitively it makes it more frustrating most matches because even the kill cams don't reflect how a person is killed. The other thing is that they need to balance the weapons more. The only available playlist for multiplayer are Core matches, but the weapons kill like hardcore.

INSANELY THOUGHT OUT AND WONDERFUL GAME! TRULY! Here's a tip to make it surpass Pubg GET RID OF BOTS! Besides that, I would keep this game on my phone forever just because of how well they did in terms of bringing all the past COD experience together. Even Battle Royale and Multiplayer Modes are INSANE! SO MUCH FUN TO PLAY! BUT TRULY, PLEASE! REMOVE BOTS FROM BATTLE ROYALE. (I understand this is for matchmaking purposes, I have a solution for that too, but I reached max words) HMU!

I grew up playing call of duty and i was so excited to learn it has become available on mobile. Imagine my disappointment when i finish downloading the game and then after 10 minutes of waiting for it to open, it gives me the following message "Download configuration failed. Make sure your device is connected to a network and then restart the game"

Cod mobile is definitely the best shooter on store of all time. Amazing skins, so many game modes, and so many guns to choose from. There are hardly any lag issues and no game crashes. I will only give this a 4 star because recently, there is an issue with the deleting maps off of my storage that I typically don't play. I use the deletion option by downloads, and after doing so, it asks to restart the game. after doing so, it kicks me out of the app and doesn't delete the files. please help!

This game became unplayable, full of bugs, lagging, FPS drop, and doing things that you even don't want to, like example switching weapons, start to healing ADS stuck,ads not working and so on... Thank God I didn't spend too much money on this game cuz I will for sure regretting!!! And it's not about my phone or my internet. And I see many pro players they have same issue Narco and Miltos!!

Gameplay is same as in any Call of Duty, but mostly centered around like Black Ops II. The controls are very easy, aiming down in sights is easy, running and looking around is easy, the automatic shooting is great. The graphics on my game are set as "low" but they're very good for "low" graphics. The reward system is also nice and easy to progress. The game is easily playable, and fun when nothing else to do. Disclaimer to anyone reading this: The game can run your battery down down, beware.

Excellent Game, This is the first Game I really enjoy playing. Yes you can buy stuff, but with coins you collect but there's no big option of inventory. If you are willing to pay money yes then the limits are endless. Unfortunately I don't spend cash on games so I miss out. Maybe you guy's can look into this and give us non-spenders something more. great game, fun and anyone can be good at it. i just wish it was easier to get skins for characters like ghost. Also, I would really like to be able to play offline. This is the third time I take my time to change my review. No words, this game is absolutely the best competitive fun game you can ever found in the existence of Android. One of the best fps games to EVER hit ANY gaming platform, Call of Duty Mobile stands right beside its bigger brothers to be without a doubt the best game on any mobile device. Way to go guys! A very solid, fun and F2P friendly FPS (IAPs are mostly cosmetics and those that aren't only let you unlock some weapon attachments/upgrades early without grinding for them). While Single Player content is basically non-existent, there's an impressive variety of maps, modes and weapons, and a lot of them are very fun to play with. Thanks to the game being regularly updated with new content and balance updates, it's very highly recommended if you're looking for a fast-paced multiplayer FPS.

Everything about this game is as expected. The gameplay is simple and easy and its competitive. My only complaint is the zombies mode is nearly impossible. I've been in matches that have gotten up to the double digit rounds and the zombies are impossible to kill. I've unloaded full clips from an RPD, that's 100 rounds, and they still don't die. The ray gun isn't as powerful as it is in the console versions. They've made it so difficult to get to higher levels I lost all enjoyment.

Why did you delete zombies, we still want to play it! Most people stopped playing it because it's not infinite and ends at a certain point but we still want to be able to go back to it! New update is epic as! Finally, zombies........... And that's the fact older generation wireless controllers are yet to be compatible with the game. If you have a new gen PS4 or Xbox controller then your fine, but I don't! Other than that, a unique and epic game of mass proportions !

Honestly don't know why there's so much hate on this game for hackers or slow loading or saying its pay to win etc cause I've been playing for a little over a year now, mainly battle royale, and this is by far my favorite way to pass the time when I can play. I never though the fps genre did well on the mobile platforms, but this one really blows that perception away.
